works.author: al-Tabrīzī (compiler); Capt. A. N. Matthews (English translator)
works.description_en: A curated edition of Book XXIV (Kitāb al-Faḍāʾil wa-al-Shamāʾil) from Capt. A. N. Matthews' historic 1810 Calcutta translation of the Mishkât-ul-Masâbih, devoted exclusively to the noble person, physical appearance, sublime character, speech, and humility of the Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ. Presented with the classical Arabic text and contemporary reading aids.
works.source_en: Arabic text: the Mishkât of al-Tabrīzī (Book XXIV: Kitāb al-Faḍāʾil), classical and in the public domain. English: Capt. A. N. Matthews, 'Mishcât-ul-Masâbih' (Calcutta: T. Hubbard, Hindoostanee Press, 1810, vol. 2, pp. 651–707), 100% in the public domain worldwide. A modern simplification in present-day English appears beneath Matthews' text as a reading aid.

sections.heading: The Preeminence & Sacred Names of the Prophet ﷺ
sections.note: Matthews' Book XXIV, Chapter I (printed 1810, Calcutta, pp. 651–664). The narrations establish the Prophet's ﷺ election above creation, his unique privileges, and his blessed names (Muḥammad, Aḥmad, al-Māḥī, al-Ḥāshir, al-ʿĀqib, Nabiyy al-Raḥmah).

units.ar: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «بُعِثْتُ مِنْ خَيْرِ قُرُونِ بَنِي آدَمَ قَرْنًا فَقَرْنًا حَتَّى كُنْتُ من القرنِ الَّذِي كنتُ مِنْهُ» . رَوَاهُ البُخَارِيّ
units.en: Abū Hurairah said, A. G. S. 'I was sent from the best generation of the children of Adam, age after age, until I came from the generation from which I came.'
units.en2: Abū Hurairah narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I was chosen from the best of the generations of the children of Adam, era after era, until I appeared in the generation from which I emerged.'

units.ar:
وَعَنْ وَاثِلَةَ بْنِ الْأَسْقَعِ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَى كِنَانَةَ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَاصْطَفَى قُرَيْشًا مِنْ كِنَانَةَ وَاصْطَفَى مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ بَنَى هَاشِمٍ وَاصْطَفَانِي مِنْ بَنِي هَاشِمٍ» . رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ
وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ لِلتِّرْمِذِيِّ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَى مِنْ ولد إِبْرَاهِيم إِسْمَاعِيل وَاصْطفى من ولد إِسْمَاعِيل بني كنَانَة»
units.en: Wāthilah-ibn-al-Asqaʿ said, I heard his majesty say, 'Verily God elected Kinānah from the children of Ismāʿīl, and elected Quraish from the children of Kinānah, and elected from the children of Quraish, Hāshim, and elected me from the sons of Hāshim.'
units.en2: Wāthilah ibn al-Asqaʿ narrates: I heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say: 'Verily Allah chose Kinānah from the descendants of Ismāʿīl, and chose Quraysh from Kinānah, and chose the clan of Hāshim from Quraysh, and chose me from Banū Hāshim.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: أَنَا سَيِّدُ وَلَدِ آدَمَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَأَوَّلُ مَنْ يَنْشَقُّ عَنْهُ الْقَبْرُ وَأَوَّلُ شَافِعٍ وَأَوَّلُ مُشَفَّعٍ ". رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ
units.en: Abū Hurairah said, A. G. S. 'I shall be the best and greatest of the children of Adam on the day of resurrection, in every description; and shall be the first raised up from the grave; and I shall be the first intercessor, and the first whose intercession will be approved of.'
units.en2: Abū Hurairah narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I shall be the leader of the children of Adam on the Day of Resurrection, the first for whom the earth splits open, the first intercessor, and the first whose intercession shall be accepted.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَنَا أَكْثَرُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ تَبَعًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَقْرَعُ بَابَ الجنةِ» . رَوَاهُ مُسلم
units.en: Anas said, A. G. S. 'I shall have more followers than any other Prophet on the day of resurrection; and I shall be the first who will knock at the door of paradise to enter into it.'
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I shall have the most followers among the prophets on the Day of Resurrection, and I shall be the first to knock upon the gates of Paradise.'

units.ar:
وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ:
" آتِي بَابَ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَأَسْتَفْتِحُ فَيَقُولُ الْخَازِنُ: مَنْ أَنْتَ؟ فَأَقُولُ: مُحَمَّدٌ. فيقولُ: بكَ أمرت أَن لاأفتح لأحد قبلك "
. رَوَاهُ مُسلم
units.en: Anas said, A. G. S. 'I will come to the door of paradise on the day of resurrection, and will ask to have it opened; and the keeper will say, Who art thou? And I shall say, I am Muḥammad. And the keeper will say, On your account I have been ordered not to open the door for any one before you.'
units.en2: Anas narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I will arrive at the gate of Paradise on the Day of Resurrection and ask for it to be opened. The gatekeeper will ask, "Who are you?" and I will reply, "Muḥammad." He will say, "For you alone was I commanded not to open for anyone before you."'

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَنَا أَوَّلُ شَفِيعٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَمْ يُصَدَّقْ نَبِيٌّ مِنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ مَا صُدِّقْتُ وَإِنَّ مِنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ نَبِيًّا مَا صَدَّقَهُ مِنْ أُمَّته إِلَّا رجل وَاحِد» . رَوَاهُ مُسلم
units.en: Abū Hurairah said, A. G. S. 'The comparison between me and former Prophets is like a well-made house with a place left for one brick; and people are astonished at seeing its goodness, except the place wanting one brick: then I filled up the place. Then the building was completed by me, and the Prophets are completed by me.'
units.en2: Abū Hurairah narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The parable of myself and the prophets before me is that of a man who built a house, perfecting and beautifying it, except for the place of a single brick in a corner. The people walked around it admiring it, saying, "If only this brick were laid!" I am that brick, and I am the seal of the prophets.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5744 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ كَمَثَلِ قَصْرٍ أُحْسِنَ بُنْيَانُهُ تُرِكَ مِنْهُ مَوضِع لبنة فَطَافَ النظَّارُ يتعجَّبونَ من حُسنِ بنيانِه إِلَّا مَوْضِعَ تِلْكَ اللَّبِنَةِ فَكُنْتُ أَنَا سَدَدْتُ مَوْضِعَ اللَّبِنَةِ خُتِمَ بِيَ الْبُنْيَانُ وَخُتِمَ بِي الرُّسُلُ» . وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: «فَأَنَا اللَّبِنَةُ وَأَنَا خَاتَمُ النَّبِيِّينَ» . مُتَّفق عَلَيْهِ
units.en: Abū Hurairah said, A. G. S. 'There is no Prophet but was given miracles, which when the sects saw, they believed; I mean their miracles were particularly confined to their own time: and my miracle is the Korʾān, which was sent to me, and will remain for ever. Then I am hopeful of having more followers than any of the other Prophets.'
units.en2: Abū Hurairah narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: 'Every prophet was granted signs by which people believed; but that which I have been given is divine revelation that Allah revealed to me, so I hope to have the greatest number of followers on the Day of Resurrection.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5745 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَا مِنَ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلَّا قَدْ أُعْطِيَ مِنَ الْآيَاتِ مَا مِثْلُهُ آمَنَ عَلَيْهِ الْبَشَرُ وَإِنَّمَا كَانَ الَّذِي أُوتِيتُ وَحْيًا أَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَيَّ وَأَرْجُو أَنْ أَكُونَ أَكْثَرَهُمْ تَابِعًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ» . مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ
units.en: Jābir said, A. G. S. 'I have been given five qualities which no one was given before me: I have been given victory by throwing fear into the hearts of my enemies at a distance of a month's journey; the whole face of the earth has been made pure for me to worship upon; plunder has been made lawful for me; former Prophets were merely to their own sects, but I have been sent to all men; and I have been granted intercession.'
units.en2: Jābir narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I have been granted five privileges given to no prophet before me: I was aided with awe inspiring fear across a month's journey; the entire earth was made for me a place of prayer and pure; spoils of war were made lawful for me; each prophet was sent solely to his own people while I was sent to all mankind; and I was granted intercession.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5746 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar:
وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ:
" فُضِّلْتُ عَلَى الْأَنْبِيَاءِ بِسِتٍّ: أُعْطِيتُ جَوَامِعَ الْكَلِمِ وَنُصِرْتُ بِالرُّعْبِ وَأُحِلَّتْ لِيَ الْغَنَائِمُ وَجُعِلَتْ لِيَ الْأَرْضُ مَسْجِدًا وَطَهُورًا وَأُرْسِلْتُ إِلَى الْخَلْقِ كَافَّةً وَخُتِمَ بِيَ النَّبِيُّونَ "
. رَوَاهُ مُسلم
units.en: Abū Hurairah said, A. G. S. 'I have been given superiority over the Prophets in six things: I have been sent with Jawāmiʿ-ul-Kalim (concise words of immense meaning); I have been given victory by awe; plunder has been made lawful for me; the earth has been made pure and a place of prayer; I have been sent to all creation; and the Prophets are concluded by me.'
units.en2: Abū Hurairah narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I was given distinction over the prophets in six respects: I was given comprehensive speech (Jawāmiʿ al-Kalim); I was granted victory by awe; the spoils of war were made lawful for me; the earth was made for me a mosque and pure; I was sent to all creation; and the line of prophets was sealed through me.'

units.ar: وَعَن أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَتَى وَجَبَتْ لَكَ النُّبُوَّةُ؟ قَالَ: «وَآدَمُ بَيْنَ الرُّوحِ وَالْجَسَدِ» . رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيّ
units.en: Al-ʿIrbāḍ-ibn-Sāriyah said, A. G. S. 'Verily I was in the presence of God the seal of the Prophets, while Adam was yet between water and clay. And I will inform you of the beginning of my affair: I am the supplication of my father Abraham, and the glad tidings of Jesus, and the vision of my mother which she saw when bearing me.'
units.en2: Al-ʿIrbāḍ ibn Sāriyah narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I was recorded with Allah as the Seal of the Prophets while Adam was still kneaded in his clay. I shall tell you of my beginning: I am the supplication of my forefather Ibrāhīm, the glad tidings of ʿĪsā, and the dream of my mother when she gave birth to me, seeing a light that illuminated the palaces of the Levant.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «أَنَا سَيِّدُ وَلَدِ آدَمَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَا فَخْرَ وَبِيَدِي لِوَاءُ الْحَمْدِ وَلَا فَخْرَ. وَمَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ يَوْمَئِذٍ آدَمُ فَمَنْ سِوَاهُ إِلَّا تَحْتَ لِوَائِي وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ تَنْشَقُّ عَنْهُ الْأَرْضُ وَلَا فَخْرَ» . رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيّ
units.en: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī said, A. G. S. 'I am the master of the children of Adam on the day of resurrection, and I do not boast; and in my hand will be the banner of praise (Liwāʾ-ul-Ḥamd), and I do not boast; and there will not be a Prophet on that day, from Adam and others, but will be under my banner.'
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I am the leader of the children of Adam on the Day of Resurrection, without boast; and in my hand shall be the Banner of Praise, without boast; and there shall not be a prophet on that day, from Adam onward, except that he shall stand beneath my banner.'

units.ar: وَعَن ابْن عَبَّاس قَالَ: جَلَسَ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَخَرَجَ حَتَّى إِذَا دَنَا مِنْهُمْ سَمِعَهُمْ يَتَذَاكَرُونَ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ: إِنَّ اللَّهَ اتَّخَذَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيلًا وَقَالَ آخَرُ: مُوسَى كَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ تَكْلِيمًا وَقَالَ آخَرُ: فَعِيسَى كَلِمَةُ الله وروحه. وَقَالَ آخَرُ: آدَمُ اصْطَفَاهُ اللَّهُ فَخَرَجَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَقَالَ: «قَدْ سَمِعْتُ كَلَامَكُمْ وَعَجَبَكُمْ أَنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ خَلِيل الله وَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ وَآدَمُ اصْطَفَاهُ اللَّهُ وَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ أَلَا وَأَنَا حَبِيبُ اللَّهِ وَلَا فَخْرَ وَأَنَا حَامِلُ لِوَاءِ الْحَمْدِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ تَحْتَهُ آدَمُ فَمَنْ دُونَهُ وَلَا فَخْرَ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ شَافِعٍ وَأَوَّلُ مُشَفَّعٍ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَلَا فَخْرَ وَأَنَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ يُحَرِّكُ حَلَقَ الْجَنَّةِ فَيَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ لِي فَيُدْخِلُنِيهَا وَمَعِي فُقَرَاءُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَلَا فَخْرَ وَأَنَا أَكْرَمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ وَالْآخَرِينَ عَلَى اللَّهِ وَلَا فَخر» . رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيّ والدارمي
units.en: Kaʿb-ibn-Mālik said, A. G. S. 'Mankind will be assembled on the day of resurrection, and my sect and I shall be upon a high hill; and my Lord will clothe me in a green mantle, after which I shall have permission to speak, and I will say what God pleases I should say; and that is the Praised Station (al-Maqām-ul-Maḥmūd).'
units.en2: Kaʿb ibn Mālik narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'The people will be resurrected on the Day of Standing, and I and my community will stand upon an elevated height. My Lord will clothe me in a robe of green, and grant me leave to speak, and I will utter that which He wills me to say. That is the Praised Station (al-Maqām al-Maḥmūd).'

units.ar:
عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعَمٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ:
" إنَّ لي أَسْمَاءً: أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَنَا أَحْمَدُ وَأَنَا الْمَاحِي الَّذِي يَمْحُو اللَّهُ بِي الْكُفْرَ وَأَنَا الْحَاشِرُ الَّذِي يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ عَلَى قَدَمِي وَأَنَا الْعَاقِبُ "
. وَالْعَاقِب: الَّذِي لَيْسَ بعده شَيْء. مُتَّفق عَلَيْهِ
units.en: Jubair-ibn-Muṭʿim said, I heard the Prophet say, 'Verily I have names: I am Muḥammad, and I am Aḥmad, and I am al-Māḥī (the eraser) by whom God effaces infidelity; and I am al-Ḥāshir (the gatherer) at whose feet mankind will be gathered together; and I am al-ʿĀqib (the last in succession) after whom there is no Prophet.'
units.en2: Jubayr ibn Muṭʿim narrates: I heard the Prophet ﷺ say: 'I have several names: I am Muḥammad, and I am Aḥmad, and I am al-Māḥī (the Effacer) through whom Allah erases disbelief, and I am al-Ḥāshir (the Gatherer) at whose feet people will be assembled, and I am al-ʿĀqib (the Successor) after whom there shall be no prophet.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5776 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَن أبي مُوسَى الْأَشْعَرِيّ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يُسَمِّي لَنَا نَفْسَهُ أَسْمَاءً فَقَالَ: «أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَحْمَدُ وَالْمُقَفِّي وَالْحَاشِرُ وَنَبِيُّ التَّوْبَةِ وَنَبِيُّ الرَّحْمَة» . رَوَاهُ مُسلم
units.en: Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī said, 'The Messenger of God named to us many of his names; some of them we remembered, and some we did not. He said: I am Muḥammad, and Aḥmad, and al-Muqaffī (the follower), and al-Ḥāshir, and the Prophet of Repentance, and the Prophet of Mercy.'
units.en2: Abū Mūsā al-Ashʿarī narrates: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ recounted to us his names: 'I am Muḥammad, and Aḥmad, and al-Muqaffī (the final follower of the prophetic line), and al-Ḥāshir, and Nabiyy al-Tawbah (the Prophet of Repentance), and Nabiyy al-Raḥmah (the Prophet of Mercy).'

units.ar:
وَعَنْ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ يَأْتِيهَا فَيَقِيلُ عِنْدَهَا فَتَبْسُطُ نِطْعًا فَيَقِيلُ عَلَيْهِ وَكَانَ كَثِيرَ الْعَرَقِ فَكَانَتْ تَجْمَعُ عَرَقَهُ فَتَجْعَلُهُ فِي الطِّيبِ. فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ مَا هَذَا؟» قَالَتْ: عَرَقُكَ نَجْعَلُهُ فِي طِيبِنَا وَهُوَ مِنْ أَطْيَبِ الطِّيبِ
وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ قَالَتْ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَرْجُو بَرَكَتَهُ لِصِبْيَانِنَا قَالَ: «أصبت» . مُتَّفق عَلَيْهِ
units.en: Sahl-ibn-Saʿd said, A. G. S. 'I am your leader to the fountain of Kawthar: whoever comes to me will drink of it, and whoever drinks will never thirst again.'
units.en2: Sahl ibn Saʿd narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I am your forerunner at the Heavenly Basin (al-Ḥawḍ). Whoever passes by me shall drink, and whoever drinks from it shall never thirst again.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5788 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

sections.heading: The Physical Form, Appearance & Fragrance
sections.note: Matthews' Book XXIV, Chapter II (printed 1810, Calcutta, pp. 664–674). The classical Shamāʾil portraits detailing his noble height, luminous complexion ('like the sun and moon'), hair, beard, palms softer than silk, fragrant sweat, and the Seal of Prophethood between his shoulders.

units.ar: وَعَن عبدِ الله بن سرجسٍ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَأَكَلْتُ مَعَهُ خُبْزًا وَلَحْمًا - أَوْ قَالَ: ثَرِيدًا - ثُمَّ دُرْتُ خَلْفَهُ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى خَاتَمِ النُّبُوَّةِ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ عِنْدَ نَاغِضِ كَتِفِهِ الْيُسْرَى جُمْعًا عَلَيْهِ خيلال كأمثال الثآليل. رَوَاهُ مُسلم
units.en: Anas said, 'His majesty was neither very tall nor very short, nor very white like chalk, nor very brown; nor was his hair very curly, nor very straight, but between the two. God made him a Prophet in his fortieth year; and he dwelt in Mecca ten years, and ten years at Medīnah; and God caused him to die at the expiration of sixty years, when there were not twenty grey hairs in his blessed head and beard.'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was of medium height, neither conspicuously tall nor short. His skin was neither chalky white nor dark, but luminous. His hair was neither exceedingly curly nor lank, but gentle waves. Allah commissioned him at forty, and he stayed ten years in Makkah and ten in Madinah. When Allah took his soul, there were not even twenty white hairs in his head and beard.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5780 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْ أُمِّ خَالِدٍ بِنْتِ خَالِدِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَتْ: أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بِثِيَابٍ فِيهَا خَمِيصَةٌ سَوْدَاءُ صَغِيرَةٌ فَقَالَ: «ائْتُونِي بِأُمِّ خَالِدٍ» فَأُتِيَ بِهَا تُحْمَلُ فَأَخَذَ الْخَمِيصَةَ بِيَدِهِ فَأَلْبَسَهَا. قَالَ: «أَبْلِي وَأَخْلِقِي ثُمَّ أَبْلِي وَأَخْلِقِي» وَكَانَ فِيهَا عَلَمٌ أَخْضَرُ أَوْ أَصْفَرُ. فَقَالَ: «يَا أُمَّ خَالِدٍ هَذَا سِنَاهْ» وَهِيَ بالحبشيَّةِ حسنَة. قَالَت: فذهبتُ أَلعبُ بخاتمِ النبوَّةِ فز برني أُبَيٍّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «دعها» . رَوَاهُ البُخَارِيّ
units.en: Barāʾ-ibn-ʿĀzib said, 'His majesty was middle-sized, his shoulders broad; his hair reached the bottom of his ears. I saw him in a red striped garment, and I never saw any person look so handsome as the Prophet.'
units.en2: Al-Barāʾ ibn ʿĀzib narrates: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was of medium stature, broad-shouldered, with hair flowing to the lobes of his ears. I once saw him in a red striped cloak, and I have never seen anything in creation more handsome than him.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5781 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar:
وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَيْسَ بِالطَّوِيلِ الْبَائِنِ وَلَا بِالْقَصِيرِ وَلَيْسَ بِالْأَبْيَضِ الْأَمْهَقِ وَلَا بِالْآدَمِ وَلَيْسَ بِالْجَعْدِ الْقَطَطِ وَلَا بِالسَّبْطِ بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً فَأَقَامَ بِمَكَّةَ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ وبالمدينة عشر سِنِين وتوفَّاه الله على رَأس سِتِّينَ سَنَةً وَلَيْسَ فِي رَأْسِهِ وَلِحْيَتِهِ عِشْرُونَ شَعْرَةً بَيْضَاءَ
وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ يَصِفُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَبْعَةً مِنَ الْقَوْمِ لَيْسَ بِالطَّوِيلِ وَلَا بِالْقَصِيرِ أَزْهَرَ اللَّوْنِ. وَقَالَ: كَانَ شَعْرُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ أُذُنَيْهِ
وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: بَيْنَ أُذُنَيْهِ وَعَاتِقِهِ. مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ
وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ لِلْبُخَارِيِّ قَالَ: كَانَ ضَخْمَ الرَّأْسِ وَالْقَدَمَيْنِ لَمْ أَرَ بَعْدَهُ وَلَا قَبْلَهُ مِثْلَهُ وَكَانَ سَبْطَ الكفَّينِ. وَفِي أُخْرَى لَهُ قَالَ: كَانَ شئن الْقَدَمَيْنِ وَالْكَفَّيْنِ
units.en: Qatādah said, 'I asked Anas about the grey hairs of the Prophet, whether he dyed them. He said: He did not reach the need of dyeing; there were only a few grey hairs upon his temples, but Abū Bakr dyed his hair with henna and katam.'
units.en2: Qatādah narrates: I asked Anas ibn Mālik: 'Did the Prophet ﷺ dye his hair?' He replied: 'He had no need to dye it; there were only a few white hairs near his temples, though Abū Bakr dyed his with henna and katam.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5782 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar:
وَعَنِ الْبَرَّاءِ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَرْبُوعًا بَعِيدَ مَا بَيْنَ الْمَنْكِبَيْنِ لَهُ شَعْرٌ بَلَغَ شَحْمَةَ أُذُنَيْهِ رَأَيْتُهُ فِي حُلَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ لَمْ أَرَ شَيْئًا قَطُّ أَحْسَنَ مِنْهُ. مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ
وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ لِمُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: مَا رَأَيْتُ مِنْ ذِي لِمَّةٍ أَحْسَنَ فِي حُلَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ شَعْرُهُ يَضْرِبُ مَنْكِبَيْهِ بَعِيدٌ مَا بَيْنَ الْمَنْكِبَيْنِ لَيْسَ بِالطَّوِيلِ وَلَا بِالْقَصِيرِ
units.en: Jābir-ibn-Samurah said, 'His majesty had a wide mouth, with reddish-tinged white in his eyes, and lean heels.'
units.en2: Jābir ibn Samurah narrates: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ had a wide mouth (an attribute of eloquence), fine red strands in the whites of his eyes (a sign of beauty), and lean, well-shaped heels.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ضَلِيعَ الْفَمِ أَشْكَلَ الْعَيْنَيْنِ مَنْهُوشَ الْعَقِبَيْنِ قِيلَ لَسِمَاكٍ: مَا ضَلِيعُ الْفَمِ؟ قَالَ: عَظِيمُ الْفَمِ. قِيلَ: مَا أَشْكَلُ الْعَيْنَيْنِ؟ قَالَ: طَوِيلُ شَقِّ الْعَيْنِ. قِيلَ: مَا مَنْهُوشُ الْعَقِبَيْنِ؟ قَالَ: قليلُ لحم الْعقب. رَوَاهُ مُسلم
units.en: Jābir-ibn-Samurah said, 'I saw the seal of prophecy near his shoulders, which was like a pigeon's egg, in colour like his body.'
units.en2: Jābir ibn Samurah narrates: 'I saw the Seal of Prophethood situated between the Prophet's ﷺ shoulder-blades; it was an elevated mark like a pigeon's egg, matching the noble hue of his body.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ قَالَ: رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ أَبْيَضَ مَلِيحًا مقصدا ". رَوَاهُ مُسلم
units.en: Anas said, 'I never felt any silk or satin softer than the palms of his hands; and I never smelt any musk or ambergris sweeter than the fragrance of his noble body.'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'I never touched silk brocade softer than the palm of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, nor did I ever inhale musk or ambergris sweeter than the scent of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5785 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ: سُئِلَ أَنَسٌ عَنْ خِضَابِ رَسُول الله صلى الله عَلَيْهِ وَسلم فَقَالَ: إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَبْلُغْ مَا يُخْضَبُ لَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ أَعُدَّ شَمَطَاتِهِ فِي لِحْيَتِهِ - وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ: لَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ أَعُدَّ شَمَطَاتٍ كُنَّ فِي رَأسه - فعلت. مُتَّفق عَلَيْهِ
units.en: Anas said, 'Verily the Prophet used to come to my mother's house and take a midday nap. She used to spread a leather mat for him; and when he perspired, she would collect his sweat and put it into her scent bottles. His majesty awoke and said: O Umm Sulaim! what art thou doing? She said: I put your perspiration into our perfumes, for it is the sweetest of scents.'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'The Prophet ﷺ would visit our home and take a midday rest. My mother, Umm Sulaym, would spread a leather mat for him, and when he slept and perspired, she would collect his perspiration and place it into her vials. The Prophet ﷺ awoke and asked: "What are you doing, Umm Sulaym?" She replied: "We mingle your perspiration with our fragrance, for it is the finest of all scents!"'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5786 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَزْهَرَ اللَّوْنِ كَانَ عَرَقُهُ اللُّؤْلُؤُ إِذَا مَشَى تَكَفَّأَ وَمَا مَسَسْتُ دِيبَاجَةً وَلَا حَرِيرًا أَلْيَنَ مِنْ كَفِّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَلَا شمَمتُ مسكاً وَلَا عَنْبَرَةً أَطْيَبَ مِنْ رَائِحَةِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ. مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ
units.en: Jābir-ibn-Samurah said, 'A man asked: Was his majesty's face like a sword (for brightness)? I said: No, but it was like the sun and the moon, radiant and circular.'
units.en2: Jābir ibn Samurah narrates: A man asked: 'Was the face of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ sharp and shining like a sword?' He replied: 'No, but radiant and luminous like the sun and the moon, with a noble roundness.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ: صَلَّيْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاةَ الْأُولَى ثُمَّ خَرَجَ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ وَخَرَجْتُ مَعَهُ فَاسْتَقْبَلَهُ وِلْدَانٌ فَجَعَلَ يَمْسَحُ خَدَّيْ أَحَدِهِمْ وَاحِدًا وَاحِدًا وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَمَسَحَ خَدِّي فَوَجَدْتُ لِيَدِهِ بردا وريحاً كَأَنَّمَا أَخْرَجَهَا مِنْ جُؤْنَةِ عَطَّارٍ. رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ
units.en: Jābir-ibn-Samurah said, 'I said noon-day prayer with his majesty, after which he went towards his house, and I went with him. And some children came before him, and his majesty began to touch the cheeks of every one of them. And he stroked my cheek also; and I found his hand cold and fragrant, as if he had just taken it out of a perfumer's chest.'
units.en2: Jābir ibn Samurah narrates: 'I prayed Zuhr behind the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, then he walked towards his home and I followed him. Some children met him on the way, and he tenderly stroked the cheek of each one. He stroked my cheek as well, and I found his hand delightfully cool and so fragrant it was as though he had just drawn it from a perfumer's casket.'

units.ar: عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَيْسَ بالطويل وَلَا بالقصير ضخم الرَّأْس واللحية شئن الْكَفَّيْنِ وَالْقَدَمَيْنِ مُشْرَبًا حُمْرَةً ضَخْمَ الْكَرَادِيسِ طَوِيلَ المَسْرُبَةِ إِذا مَشى تكفَّأ تكفُّأً كَأَنَّمَا يَنْحَطُّ مِنْ صَبَبٍ لَمْ أَرَ قَبْلَهُ وَلَا بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ. رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيُّ وَقَالَ: هَذَا حَدِيثٌ حَسَنٌ صَحِيحٌ
units.en: ʿAlī-ibn-Abī-Ṭālib said, 'His majesty was neither tall nor short; he had a large head and a full beard; the palms of his hands and feet were solid; his chest and joints were broad; his hair reached his earlobes. When he walked, he leaned forward as if descending a steep slope. I never saw any person like him, before him or after him.'
units.en2: Sayyidunā ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib narrates: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was neither tall nor short; he possessed a dignified head, a full beard, sturdy palms and feet, broad shoulders, and hair reaching his earlobes. When he walked, he stepped firmly, leaning forward as though walking down a slope. I never saw anyone like him, before him or after him.'

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ كَانَ إِذَا وَصَفَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَالَ: لَمْ يَكُنْ بِالطَّوِيلِ الْمُمَّغِطِ وَلَا بِالْقَصِيرِ الْمُتَرَدِّدِ وَكَانَ رَبْعَةً مِنَ الْقَوْمِ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ بِالْجَعْدِ الْقَطَطِ وَلَا بِالسَّبْطِ كَانَ جَعْدًا رَجِلًا وَلَمْ يَكُنْ بِالْمُطَهَّمِ وَلَا بِالْمُكَلْثَمِ وَكَانَ فِي الْوَجْهِ تَدْوِيرٌ أَبْيَضُ مُشْرَبٌ أَدْعَجُ الْعَيْنَيْنِ أَهْدَبُ الْأَشْفَارِ جَلِيلُ الْمَشَاشِ وَالْكَتَدِ أَجْرَدُ ذُو مَسْرُبةٍ شئن الْكَفَّيْنِ وَالْقَدَمَيْنِ إِذَا مَشَى يَتَقَلَّعُ كَأَنَّمَا يَمْشِي فِي صَبَبٍ وَإِذَا الْتَفَتَ الْتَفَتَ مَعًا بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ خَاتَمُ النُّبُوَّةِ وَهُوَ خَاتَمُ النَّبِيِّينَ أَجْوَدُ النَّاسِ صَدْرًا وَأَصْدَقُ النَّاسِ لَهْجَةً وَأَلْيَنُهُمْ عَرِيكَةً وَأَكْرَمُهُمْ عَشِيرَةً مَنْ رَآهُ بَدِيهَةً هَابَهُ وَمَنْ خَالَطَهُ مَعْرِفَةً أَحَبَّهُ يَقُولُ نَاعِتُهُ: لَمْ أَرَ قَبْلَهُ وَلَا بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسلم. رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيّ
units.en: ʿAlī described his majesty, saying: 'He was neither toweringly tall nor short, but of medium stature. His hair was not tightly curled nor limp, but wavy. His complexion was white with a reddish glow; his eyes wide and intensely dark with long lashes. Between his shoulders was the Seal of Prophethood. He was the most generous of people in heart, the most truthful in speech, the gentlest in nature, and the noblest in companionship. Whoever saw him unexpectedly stood in awe of him, and whoever consorted with him loved him. Whoever described him said: I never saw anyone like him, before him or since.'
units.en2: Sayyidunā ʿAlī described the Messenger of Allah ﷺ: 'He was neither toweringly tall nor stunted, but of dignified medium height. His hair was neither crisp curls nor lank, but with gentle wave. His skin was radiant white tinged with pink. He had wide black eyes, long eyelashes, broad joints, and the Seal of Prophethood between his shoulders. He was the most generous in heart, the most truthful in word, the gentlest in temper, and the noblest in companionship. Whoever beheld him suddenly felt reverence, and whoever came to know him loved him intimately. The one who described him could only say: "I have never seen his like, before him or after him."' [ﷺ]

units.ar: وَعَنْ جَابِرٌ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَمْ يَسْلُكْ طَرِيقًا فَيَتْبَعُهُ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا عرفَ أَنه قد سلكه من طيب عرقه - أَوْ قَالَ: مِنْ رِيحِ عَرَقِهِ - رَوَاهُ الدَّارِمِيُّ
units.en: Jābir said, 'His majesty never went down any road, but that whoever went along that road after him knew that the Prophet had passed by, on account of the fragrant scent of his body.'
units.en2: Jābir ibn ʿAbdillāh narrates: 'The Prophet ﷺ never took any pathway in Madinah without anyone who followed in his footsteps knowing he had walked there, by the fragrant scent that remained behind him.'

units.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَفْلَجَ الثَّنِيَّتَيْنِ إِذَا تَكَلَّمَ رُئِيَ كَالنُّورِ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ بَيْنِ ثَنَايَاهُ. رَوَاهُ الدَّارمِيّ
units.en: Ibn ʿAbbās said, 'The Prophet used to let his hair hang down, while the idolaters parted theirs; and the Prophet liked to agree with the People of the Book in things wherein he was not otherwise commanded; after that, he parted his hair.'
units.en2: Ibn ʿAbbās narrates: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ used to let his hair flow naturally without parting, whereas the polytheists parted their hair. The Prophet ﷺ preferred harmony with the People of the Book in matters where no specific command had come; subsequently, he parted his hair symmetrically.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5797 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا سُرَّ اسْتَنَارَ وَجْهُهُ حَتَّى كَأَنَّ وَجْهَهُ قِطْعَةُ قَمَرٍ وَكُنَّا نَعْرِفُ ذَلِكَ. مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ
units.en: Kaʿb-ibn-Mālik said, 'When his majesty was pleased, his blessed face shone like a piece of the full moon, and we used to recognise his joy by that.'
units.en2: Kaʿb ibn Mālik narrates: 'Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was filled with joy, his radiant countenance illuminated until it looked like a piece of the full moon; and by that radiance we always knew his happiness.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5798 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

sections.heading: Demeanor, Speech & Laughter
sections.note: Matthews' Book XXIV, Chapter III, Part 1 (printed 1810, Calcutta, pp. 674–684). His distinct and measured speech, words easily counted, gentle smiles rather than loud laughter, intense modesty, purposeful stride, and attentive listening to all people.

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا صَلَّى الْغَدَاةَ جَاءَ خَدَمُ الْمَدِينَةِ بِآنِيَتِهِمْ فِيهَا الْمَاءُ فَمَا يَأْتُونَ بإناءٍ إِلَّا غمسَ يدَه فِيهَا فرُبما جاؤوهُ بِالْغَدَاةِ الْبَارِدَةِ فَيَغْمِسُ يَدَهُ فِيهَا. رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ
units.en: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī said, 'The Prophet was more modest than a virgin behind her curtain; and when he saw anything that displeased him, we knew it by his countenance.'
units.en2: Abū Saʿīd al-Khudrī narrates: 'The Prophet ﷺ was more modest and bashful than a maiden secluded behind her veil. When he witnessed anything he disliked, we could recognize it immediately upon his face.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5808 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَتْ أَمَةٌ مِنْ إِمَاءِ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ تَأْخُذُ بِيَدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَتَنْطَلِقُ بِهِ حَيْثُ شَاءَتْ. رَوَاهُ البُخَارِيّ
units.en: ʿĀʾeshah said, 'I never saw the Prophet laugh so loudly as to see the uvula or roof of his mouth; his majesty only used to smile.'
units.en2: Sayyidah ʿĀʾishah narrates: 'I never saw the Prophet ﷺ laugh boisterously so that the uvula in his throat became visible; his laughter was always a gentle, radiant smile.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5809 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ أَنَّ امْرَأَةً كَانَتْ فِي عَقْلِهَا شَيْءٌ فَقَالَت: يَا رَسُول الله إِنِّي لِي إِلَيْكَ حَاجَّةً فَقَالَ: «يَا أُمَّ فُلَانٍ انْظُرِي أَيَّ السِّكَكِ شِئْتِ حَتَّى أَقْضِيَ لَكِ حَاجَتَكِ» فَخَلَا مَعَهَا فِي بَعْضِ الطُّرُقِ حَتَّى فرغت من حَاجَتهَا. رَوَاهُ مُسلم
units.en: ʿĀʾeshah said, 'His majesty's speech was not hurried like yours; but his words were distinct and clear, so that if any one wished to count them, he might have done so.'
units.en2: Sayyidah ʿĀʾishah narrates: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ did not speak rapidly and continuously like people do today; rather, his speech was so clear, measured, and distinct that anyone who wished to count his words could easily do so.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5810 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ: مَا خُيِّرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ بَيْنَ أَمْرَيْنِ قَطُّ إِلَّا أَخَذَ أَيْسَرَهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ إِثْمًا فَإِنْ كَانَ إِثْمًا كَانَ أَبْعَدَ النَّاسِ مِنْهُ وَمَا انْتَقَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِنَفْسِهِ فِي شَيْءٍ قَطُّ إِلَّا أَنْ يُنتهك حرمةُ الله فينتقم لله بهَا. مُتَّفق عَلَيْهِ
units.en: Anas said, 'When the Prophet spoke, he used to repeat his words three times, that they might be thoroughly understood from him; and when he gave a greeting, he greeted three times.'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'Whenever the Prophet ﷺ delivered an important statement, he would repeat it three times so that it would be fully comprehended; and when he arrived at a gathering, he would greet them with peace thrice.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِذَا صَافَحَ الرَّجُلَ لَمْ يَنْزِعْ يَدَهُ مِنْ يَدِهِ حَتَّى يَكُونَ هُوَ الَّذِي يَنْزِعُ يَدَهُ وَلَا يَصْرِفُ وَجْهَهُ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ حَتَّى يَكُونَ هُوَ الَّذِي يَصْرِفُ وَجْهَهُ عَن وَجهه وَلم يُرَ مقدِّماً رُكْبَتَيْهِ بَين يَدي جليس لَهُ. رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيّ
units.en: ʿAbdullāh-ibn-al-Ḥārith said, 'I never saw any one smile more than the Prophet.'
units.en2: ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Ḥārith narrates: 'I have never seen anyone in my life who smiled more frequently or radiantly than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.'

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ لَا يَدَّخِرُ شَيْئًا لِغَدٍ. رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيّ
units.en: Anas said, 'When any man shook hands with his majesty, he did not withdraw his noble hand until the other withdrew his; nor did he turn away his face until the other turned away; nor was he ever seen extending his knees before his companions.'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'When anyone shook hands with the Prophet ﷺ, he never withdrew his hand until the other person let go; nor did he turn his face away until the person turned away; and he was never seen stretching his legs out in front of his companions in a gathering.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ طَوِيلَ الصَّمْتِ. رَوَاهُ فِي «شرح السّنة»
units.en: Anas said, 'When a man whispered into his majesty's ear, he did not remove his head until the other man finished; and he was never seen looking haughty.'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'Whenever anyone leaned in to whisper something into the Prophet's ﷺ ear, he never drew his head back until the person had finished speaking; and he attended to everyone with total presence.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ: مَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَسْرُدُ سَرْدَكُمْ هَذَا وَلَكِنَّهُ كَانَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِكَلَامٍ بَيْنَهُ فَصْلٌ يَحْفَظُهُ من جَلَسَ إِلَيْهِ. رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيّ
units.en: Jarīr-ibn-ʿAbdillāh said, 'His majesty never secluded himself from me since I embraced Islām, and never saw me but with a smile.'
units.en2: Jarīr ibn ʿAbdillāh narrates: 'From the day I accepted Islam, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ never screened himself from me, and he never looked at me except with a warm smile upon his face.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5828 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَبْدِاللَّهِ بْنِ سَلَامٍ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِذَا جَلَسَ يَتَحَدَّثُ يُكْثِرُ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ طَرْفَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاء. رَوَاهُ أَبُو دَاوُد
units.en: Abū Hurairah said, 'They said: O Messenger of God! you joke with us. He said: Verily I do, but I say nothing but what is strictly true.'
units.en2: Abū Hurairah narrates: The Companions said: 'O Messenger of Allah, you joke with us!' He replied: 'Yes, but I never speak anything except the absolute truth.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: مَا رَأَيْتُ شَيْئًا أَحْسَنَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَأَن الشَّمْس تجْرِي على وَجْهِهِ وَمَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا أَسْرَعَ فِي مَشْيِهِ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَأَنَّمَا الْأَرْضُ تُطْوَى لَهُ إِنَّا لَنُجْهِدُ أَنْفُسَنَا وَإنَّهُ لغير مكترث. رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيّ
units.en: Abū Hurairah said, 'I never saw any one handsomer than the Prophet; you might say the sun was moving in his face. And I never saw any one walk faster than he; you might say the ground was folded up for him: we were fatigued in walking with him, while he walked without effort.'
units.en2: Abū Hurairah narrates: 'I never saw anything more beautiful than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ; it was as if the sun itself was gliding across his face. And I never saw anyone walk with such swift, purposeful grace; it was as if the earth were being folded up before him. We would exert ourselves to keep pace, while he walked with effortless ease.'

sections.heading: Humility, Clemency & Noble Character
sections.note: Matthews' Book XXIV, Chapter III, Part 2 (printed 1810, Calcutta, pp. 684–707). Sayyidah ʿĀʾishah and Anas recount his household conduct, mending his own sandals, milking his sheep, never striking a servant, choosing gentleness, forbearing debtors, and his supreme mercy towards all creation.

units.ar: عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: خَدَمْتُ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ فَمَا قَالَ لِي: أُفٍّ وَلَا: لِمَ صَنَعْتَ؟ وَلَا: أَلَّا صَنَعْتَ؟ مُتَّفق عَلَيْهِ
units.en: Anas said, 'I served the Prophet ten years; and he never said Uff! to me; and never said, Why didst thou do so? to anything I had done; nor, Why didst thou not do so? to anything I had neglected.'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'I served the Prophet ﷺ for ten full years. In all that time, he never once said "Uff!" to me in exasperation; nor did he ever question me about something I had done, saying "Why did you do that?", nor about something I had left undone, saying "Why did you not do that?"'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5801 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مِنْ أَحْسَنِ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا فَأَرْسَلَنِي يَوْمًا لِحَاجَةٍ فَقُلْتُ: وَاللَّهِ لَا أَذْهَبُ وَفِي نَفْسِي أَنْ أَذْهَبَ لِمَا أَمَرَنِي بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَخَرَجْتُ حَتَّى أَمُرَّ عَلَى صِبْيَانٍ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ فِي السُّوقِ فَإِذَا بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَدْ قَبَضَ بِقَفَايَ مِنْ وَرَائِي قَالَ: فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ فَقَالَ: «يَا أُنَيْسُ ذَهَبْتَ حَيْثُ أَمَرْتُكَ؟» . قُلْتُ: نَعَمْ أَنَا أَذْهَبُ يَا رَسُول الله. رَوَاهُ مُسلم
units.en: Anas said, 'His majesty was the handsomest of men, and the most liberal, and the most brave. Verily one night the inhabitants of Medīnah were alarmed, and people went towards the noise; but his majesty had gone out before them upon a bare horse, with his sword slung to his neck, and said: Be not afraid, be not afraid!'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'The Prophet ﷺ was the best of men in appearance, the most generous of men, and the bravest of men. One night, the people of Madinah were terrified by a sudden noise, and people rushed toward the sound. They found that the Prophet ﷺ had already ridden out alone ahead of everyone on an unsaddled horse with his sword hung about his neck, reassuring them: "Do not be alarmed! Do not be alarmed!"'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5802 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وعنه قال : كنت أمشي مع رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم وعليه برد نجراني غليظ الحاشية فأدركه أعرابي فجبذه جبذة شديدة ورجع نبي الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في نحر الأعرابي حتى نظرت إلى صفحة عاتق رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم قد أثرت به حاشية البرد من شدة جبذته ثم قال : يا محمد مر لي من مال الله الذي عندك فالتفت إليه رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ثم ضحك ثم أمر له بعطاء . متفق عليه
units.en: Anas said, 'I was walking with the Prophet, and upon him was a Najrān cloak with a coarse border. A Bedouin came and gave his mantle a hard pull, so that I looked at the side of his majesty's neck, and the border of the cloth had marked it. After that the Bedouin said: O Muḥammad! order that some of God's property which you have may be given to me. Then the Prophet looked at him, and laughed, and ordered something to be given to him.'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'I was walking alongside the Messenger of Allah ﷺ while he was wearing a coarse Najrān mantle. A desert Bedouin approached and yanked his cloak with such violent force that I saw the red welt left on his neck by the hem. The Bedouin demanded: "O Muḥammad! Order that I be given some of the wealth of Allah in your possession!" The Prophet ﷺ turned to him, smiled with gentleness, and ordered that he be given a generous gift.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5803 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ وَأَجْوَدَ النَّاسِ وَأَشْجَعَ النَّاسِ وَلَقَدْ فَزِعَ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَانْطَلَقَ النَّاسُ قِبَلَ الصَّوْتِ فَاسْتَقْبَلَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ قَدْ سَبَقَ النَّاس إِلَى الصَّوْت هُوَ يَقُولُ: «لَمْ تُرَاعُوا لَمْ تُرَاعُوا» وَهُوَ عَلَى فَرَسٍ لِأَبِي طَلْحَةَ عُرْيٍ مَا عَلَيْهِ سَرْجٌ وَفِي عُنُقِهِ سَيْفٌ. فَقَالَ: «لَقَدْ وَجَدْتُهُ بَحْرًا» . مُتَّفق عَلَيْهِ
units.en: Jābir said, 'His majesty was never asked for anything to which he said No.'
units.en2: Jābir ibn ʿAbdillāh narrates: 'Never in his life was the Messenger of Allah ﷺ asked for anything and replied with "No."'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5804 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَن أنس إِنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسلم غَنَمًا بَيْنَ جَبَلَيْنِ فَأَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ فَأَتَى قَوْمَهُ فَقَالَ: أَي قوم أَسْلمُوا فو الله إِنَّ مُحَمَّدًا لَيُعْطِي عَطَاءً مَا يَخَافُ الْفَقْرَ. رَوَاهُ مُسلم
units.en: Anas said, 'There was a slave girl of Medīnah who used to take the Prophet by the hand, and lead him wherever she wished, to assist her in her wants.'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'Any young maidservant of Madinah could take the Messenger of Allah ﷺ by the hand, and lead him wherever she wished across the city until he helped fulfill her need.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ بَيْنَمَا هُوَ يَسِيرُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَقْفَلَهُ مِنْ حُنَيْنٍ فَعَلِقَتِ الْأَعْرَابُ يَسْأَلُونَهُ حَتَّى اضْطَرُّوهُ إِلَى سَمُرَةٍ فَخَطَفَتْ رِدَاءَهُ فَوَقَفَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ: «أَعْطُونِي رِدَائِي لَوْ كَانَ لِي عَدَدَ هَذِهِ الْعِضَاهِ نَعَمٌ لَقَسَمْتُهُ بَيْنَكُمْ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُونِي بَخِيلًا وَلَا كذوباً وَلَا جَبَانًا» . رَوَاهُ البُخَارِيّ
units.en: Abū Hurairah said, 'It was said to the Prophet: O Messenger of God! curse the infidels. He said: I was not sent for cursing, but I was sent a mercy.'
units.en2: Abū Hurairah narrates: It was said: 'O Messenger of Allah, invoke a curse against the polytheists!' He replied: 'I was not sent as a curser; I was sent only as an embodiment of mercy.'

units.ar: وَعَنْهُ قَالَ: لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَاحِشًا وَلَا لَعَّانًا وَلَا سَبَّابًا كَانَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْمَعْتَبَةِ: «مَا لَهُ تربَ جَبينُه؟» . رَوَاهُ البُخَارِيّ
units.en: Al-Aswad said, 'I asked ʿĀʾeshah: What did his majesty do within doors? She said: He used to serve his family; and when prayer-times came, he would go out to perform them.'
units.en2: Al-Aswad narrates: I asked Sayyidah ʿĀʾishah: 'What did the Prophet ﷺ do inside his home?' She replied: 'He was constantly in the service of his household; and when the time for prayer arrived, he went out to pray.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ: قِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ. قَالَ: «إِنِّي لَمْ أُبْعَثْ لَعَّانًا وَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ رَحْمَةً» . رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ
units.en: ʿĀʾeshah said, 'His majesty never struck any one or any thing with his own hand (either his wives, slave-girls, or servants), except when he was fighting in the cause of God; and on his own account never felt revenge, except when the commandments of God were broken, and then he punished for the sake of God.'
units.en2: Sayyidah ʿĀʾishah narrates: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ never struck anyone with his hand in his entire life — neither a woman, nor a servant, nor anyone else — except when striving in the cause of Allah. Nor did he ever take revenge for any personal slight, unless the sacred boundaries of Allah were violated, in which case he acted purely for Allah.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ قَالَ: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَشَدَّ حَيَاءً مِنَ الْعَذْرَاءِ فِي خِدْرِهَا فَإِذَا رَأَى شَيْئًا يَكْرَهُهُ عَرَفْنَاهُ فِي وَجْهِهِ. مُتَّفَقٌ عَلَيْهِ
units.en: ʿĀʾeshah said, 'His majesty was never given a choice between two things, but he took the easiest of them, provided it was not sinful; but if it was sinful, he kept himself the farthest from it.'
units.en2: Sayyidah ʿĀʾishah narrates: 'Whenever the Messenger of Allah ﷺ was presented with a choice between two permissible matters, he consistently chose the easier of the two, so long as it was not sinful; but if it involved sin, he was the farthest of all people from it.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5813 · Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī & Ṣaḥīḥ Muslim

units.ar: وَعَنْهَا قَالَتْ: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لَمْ يَكُنْ يَسْرُدُ الْحَدِيثَ كَسَرْدِكُمْ كَانَ يُحَدِّثُ حَدِيثًا لَوْ عَدَّهُ الْعَادُّ لَأَحْصَاهُ. مُتَّفق عَلَيْهِ
units.en: Qatādah said, 'I asked ʿĀʾeshah concerning the character of the Prophet. She said: His character was the Korʾān.'
units.en2: Qatādah narrates: I asked Sayyidah ʿĀʾishah: 'O Mother of the Believers, tell me about the character of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.' She replied: 'His character was the Qur'an itself.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهَا قَالَتْ: لَمْ يَكُنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَاحِشًا وَلَا مُتَفَحِّشًا وَلَا سَخَّابًا فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ وَلَا يَجْزِي بِالسَّيِّئَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ وَلَكِنْ يَعْفُو وَيَصْفَحُ. رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيّ
units.en: ʿĀʾeshah said, 'The Prophet was not foul-mouthed, nor did he use coarse language, nor did he shout in the markets; nor did he return evil for evil; but he pardoned and overlooked.'
units.en2: Sayyidah ʿĀʾishah narrates: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ was never vulgar, nor indecent in speech, nor clamorous in the marketplaces. He never repaid evil with evil; rather, he pardoned, forgave, and overlooked.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ أَنَسٍ يُحَدِّثَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ كانَ يعودُ المريضَ وَيتبع الْجِنَازَة ويجيب دَعْوَة الْمَمْلُوك ويركب الْحمار لَقَدْ رَأَيْتُهُ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ عَلَى حِمَارٍ خِطَامُهُ لِيفٌ. رَوَاهُ ابْنُ مَاجَهْ وَالْبَيْهَقِيُّ فِي «شُعَبِ الْإِيمَانِ»
units.en: Anas said, 'The Prophet used to visit the sick, and attend funerals, and would ride upon an ass, and would accept the invitation of the humblest slave.'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'The Messenger of Allah ﷺ would visit the sick, attend funerals, ride a simple donkey, and willingly accept the dinner invitation of even the humblest servant.'

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَائِشَةَ قَالَتْ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَخْصِفُ نَعْلَهُ وَيَخِيطُ ثَوْبَهُ وَيَعْمَلُ فِي بَيْتِهِ كَمَا يَعْمَلُ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي بَيْتِهِ وَقَالَتْ: كَانَ بَشَرًا مِنَ الْبَشَرِ يَفْلِي ثَوْبَهُ وَيَحْلُبُ شَاتَهُ وَيَخْدُمُ نَفْسَهُ. رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيُّ
units.en: ʿĀʾeshah said, 'His majesty used to sew his own clothes, and mend his own sandals, and do what men do in their houses.'
units.en2: Sayyidah ʿĀʾishah was asked: 'What did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ do in his house?' She replied: 'He was a human being among human beings: he would inspect his garments, milk his own sheep, mend his sandals, and serve his own needs.'
units.note: Mishkāt report 5822 · Jāmiʿ al-Tirmidhī & Musnad Aḥmad

units.ar: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ قَالَ: مَا رَأَيْتُ أَحَدًا كَانَ أَرْحَمَ بِالْعِيَالِ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ كَانَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ ابْنُهُ مُسْتَرْضَعًا فِي عَوَالِي الْمَدِينَةِ فَكَانَ يَنْطَلِقُ وَنَحْنُ مَعَهُ فَيَدْخُلُ الْبَيْتَ وَإِنَّهُ لَيُدَّخَنُ وَكَانَ ظِئْرُهُ قَيْنًا فَيَأْخُذُهُ فَيُقَبِّلُهُ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ. قَالَ عَمْرٌو: فَلَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِنَّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ابْنِي وَإِنَّهُ مَاتَ فِي الثَّدْيِ وَإِنَّ لَهُ لَظِئْرَيْنِ تُكْمِلَانِ رَضَاعَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ» . رَوَاهُ مُسْلِمٌ
units.en: ʿAmr-ibn-Saʿīd said from Anas, who said, 'I never saw any one who was more compassionate towards his family and little children than the Prophet.'
units.en2: Anas ibn Mālik narrates: 'I have never seen anyone in all creation who was more compassionate, merciful, and tender towards children and household members than the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.'

units.ar: وَعَن عَليّ أَنَّ يهوديّاً يُقَالُ لَهُ: فُلَانٌ حَبْرٌ كَانَ لَهُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فِي دَنَانِيرُ فَتَقَاضَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ فَقَالَ لَهُ: «يَا يَهُودِيُّ مَا عِنْدِي مَا أُعْطِيكَ» . قَالَ: فَإِنِّي لَا أُفَارِقُكَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ حَتَّى تُعْطِيَنِي. فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «إِذًا أَجْلِسُ مَعَكَ» فَجَلَسَ مَعَهُ فَصَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ وَالْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ الْآخِرَةَ وَالْغَدَاةَ وَكَانَ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَتَهَدَّدُونَهُ وَيَتَوَعَّدُونَهُ فَفَطِنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ مَا الَّذِي يَصْنَعُونَ بِهِ. فَقَالُوا: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَهُودِيٌّ يَحْبِسُكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ: «مَنَعَنِي رَبِّي أَنْ أَظْلِمَ مُعَاهِدًا وَغَيْرَهُ» فَلَمَّا تَرَجَّلَ النَّهَارُ قَالَ الْيَهُودِيُّ: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَشَطْرُ مَالِي فِي سبيلِ الله أَمَا وَاللَّهِ مَا فَعَلْتُ بِكَ الَّذِي فَعَلْتُ بِكَ إِلَّا لِأَنْظُرَ إِلَى نَعْتِكَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مَوْلِدُهُ بِمَكَّةَ وَمُهَاجَرُهُ بِطَيْبَةَ وَمُلْكُهُ بِالشَّامِ لَيْسَ بِفَظٍّ وَلَا غَلِيظٍ وَلَا سَخَّابٍ فِي الْأَسْوَاقِ وَلَا مُتَزَيٍّ بِالْفُحْشِ وَلَا قَوْلِ الْخَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَهَذَا مَالِي فَاحْكُمْ فِيهِ بِمَا أَرَاكَ اللَّهُ وَكَانَ الْيَهُودِيُّ كَثِيرَ المالِ. رَوَاهُ الْبَيْهَقِيّ فِي «دَلَائِل النُّبُوَّة»
units.en: ʿAlī said, 'A Jewish scholar had a claim of some Dinārs against his majesty, and demanded payment. The Prophet said: I have nothing to give thee. The Jew said: Then I will not quit thee until thou payest me. The Prophet said: Then I will sit with thee. And he sat with him until morning. And when the Jew saw his majesty's forbearance, he said: I bear witness that there is no God but God, and that thou art the Messenger of God; and half my wealth is in the path of God.'
units.en2: Sayyidunā ʿAlī narrates: 'A Jewish creditor came to the Prophet ﷺ demanding payment of a debt. The Prophet ﷺ said: "I have nothing to give you right now." The man said: "Then I will not leave your side until you pay me." The Prophet ﷺ replied: "Then I shall sit with you." He remained seated with him through the day and night without displaying anger. At dawn, the man declared: "I bear witness that there is no god but Allah and that you are the Messenger of Allah! By Allah, I only did this to test the description of you in the Torah: not harsh, not severe, not shouting in the markets, nor answering evil with evil. Half of my wealth is now dedicated in the path of Allah!"'

units.ar: وَعَنْ عَلِيٍّ أَنَّ أَبَا جَهْلٍ قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عَلَيْهِ وَسلم: إنَّا لَا نُكذِّبكَ ولكنْ نكذِّبُ بِمَا جئتَ بِهِ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فِيهِمْ: [فَإِنَّهُمْ لَا يُكَذِّبُونَكَ ولكنَّ الظالمينَ بآياتِ اللَّهِ يَجْحَدونَ] رَوَاهُ التِّرْمِذِيّ
units.en: ʿĀʾeshah said, A. G. S. 'I eat as a servant eats, and I sit as a servant sits; for verily I am a servant.'
units.en2: Sayyidah ʿĀʾishah narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'I eat as a servant eats, and I sit as a servant sits; for truly I am a servant of Allah.'

works.author: Imam al-Jazūlī
works.description_en: The celebrated manual of blessings upon the Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ composed by the Moroccan Sufi Imam Muḥammad ibn Sulaymān al-Jazūlī, recited daily by communities across the Muslim world for five centuries. The Arabic text is in the public domain and complete here in eight parts; the opening devotions, intention and supplication of completion are rendered in an original translation made for this project, and Hizbs 1–8 in the public-domain 1907 translation of Rev. John B. Pearson.

units.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ. الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ الْعَلِيِّ الْعَظِيمِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَبْرَأُ مِنْ حَوْلِي وَقُوَّتِي إِلَى حَوْلِكَ وَقُوَّتِكَ،
units.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful. Praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the Worlds. Allah is sufficient for me, and an excellent Guardian is He! And there is no power nor might save in Allah, the Exalted, the Magnificent. O Allah, I disavow any power and might of mine unto Thy power and Thy might,
units.en2: In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful. Praise be to God, Lord of all creation. God is sufficient for me, and He is the best Protector! There is no power and no strength except with God, the Most High, the Supreme. O God, I disclaim my own strength and power, turning entirely to Your strength and Your power,

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَقَرَّبُ إِلَيْكَ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ امْتِثَالًا لِأَمْرِكَ، وَتَصْدِيقًا لِنَبِيِّكَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَمَحَبَّةً فِيهِ، وَشَوْقًا إِلَيْهِ، وَتَعْظِيمًا لِقَدْرِهِ، وَلِكَوْنِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ أَهْلًا لِذَٰلِكَ، فَتَقَبَّلْهَا مِنِّي بِفَضْلِكَ وَإِحْسَانِكَ، وَأَزِلْ حِجَابَ الْغَفْلَةِ عَنْ قَلْبِي، وَاجْعَلْنِي مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, I seek nearness unto Thee by sending blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ in obedience to Thy command, in confirmation of Thy Prophet our master Muḥammad ﷺ, out of love for him, longing for him, veneration of his sublime rank, and because he is worthy of that. So accept it from me by Thy grace and bounty; and remove the veil of heedlessness from my heart, and make me among Thy righteous servants.
units.en2: O God, I seek closeness to You by praying for blessings upon the Prophet ﷺ in obedience to Your command, affirming Your Prophet our master Muḥammad ﷺ, out of deep love for him, longing for him, and veneration of his honor, and because he is truly worthy of it. So graciously accept it from me through Your favor and kindness, remove the veil of heedlessness from my heart, and count me among Your righteous servants.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ زِدْهُ شَرَفًا عَلَى شَرَفِهِ الَّذِي أَوْلَيْتَهُ، وَعِزًّا عَلَى عِزِّهِ الَّذِي أَعْطَيْتَهُ، وَنُورًا عَلَى نُورِهِ الَّذِي مِنْهُ خَلَقْتَهُ، وَأَعْلِ مَقَامَهُ فِي مَقَامَاتِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَدَرَجَتَهُ فِي دَرَجَاتِ النَّبِيِّينَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ رِضَاكَ وَرِضَاهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، مَعَ الْعَافِيَةِ الدَّائِمَةِ، وَالْمَوْتِ عَلَى الْكِتَابِ وَالسُّنَّةِ وَالْجَمَاعَةِ، وَكَلِمَةِ الشَّهَادَةِ عَلَى تَحْقِيقِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ تَبْدِيلٍ وَلَا تَغْيِيرٍ، وَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا ارْتَكَبْتُهُ بِمَنِّكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ يَا أَكْرَمَ الْأَكْرَمِينَ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَإِمَامِ الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, grant him honor above the honor Thou hast already bestowed upon him, and glory above the glory Thou hast given him, and light above the light from which Thou didst create him; and exalt his station among the stations of the Messengers, and his degree among the degrees of the Prophets; and I ask of Thee Thy pleasure and his pleasure, O Lord of all Worlds, with enduring well-being, and death upon the Book, the Sunnah, and the community of believers, and the testimony of faith in its true reality without alteration or change. And forgive me whatever sins I have committed through Thy favor, bounty, generosity, and benevolence, O Most Generous of the Generous! And may Allah bless our master Muḥammad, the Seal of the Prophets and Leader of the Messengers, and his family and companions all together; and peace be upon the Messengers, and praise be to Allah, the Lord of all the Worlds.
units.en2: O God, increase his honor beyond the honor You have already granted him, increase his glory beyond the glory You have given him, and increase his light beyond the light from which You created him. Elevate his rank among the ranks of the Messengers, and his degree among the degrees of the Prophets. I ask You for Your good pleasure and his good pleasure, O Lord of all the Worlds, along with everlasting well-being, dying upon the Quran, the prophetic Sunnah, and the united community, firmly rooted in the testimony of faith without deviation or alteration. Forgive all my misdeeds through Your favor, grace, bounty, and generosity, O Most Generous of the generous! May God bless our master Muḥammad, the Seal of the Prophets and the Imam of the Messengers, and all his family and companions; peace be upon the Messengers, and all praise is due to God, Lord of all the Worlds.

units.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
units.en: In the Name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful.
units.en2: In the name of Allah, the Compassionate, the Merciful.

units.ar: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَمَوْلَانَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ.
units.en: The blessing of Allah and perfect peace be on our master and our lord Muhammad, and his Family and Companions.
units.en2: The blessing of Allah and perfect peace be upon our master and our lord Muhammad, and his family and Companions.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, and his wives, and his descendants, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, and favour our master Muhammad and his wives and his descendants as Thou didst favour our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, his wives, and his descendants, as You blessed our master Abraham; and favour our master Muhammad, his wives, and his descendants, as You favoured our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his Family, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, and favour our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad as Thou didst favour our master Abraham in the ages; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his family, as You blessed our master Abraham; and favour our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You favoured our master Abraham throughout the ages — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, and favour our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst favour our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You blessed our master Abraham; and favour our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You favoured our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and the Family of our master Muhammad.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and the family of our master Muhammad.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, Thy Servant and Thy Apostle.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, Your servant and Your messenger.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You blessed our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, favour our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst favour our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, favour our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You favoured our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَتَرَحَّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَرَحَّمْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: And, O Allah, have mercy on our master Muhammad and on the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou hadst mercy on our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: And, O Allah, have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You had mercy on our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَتَحَنَّنْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تَحَنَّنْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: And, O Allah, show compassion to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst show compassion to our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: And, O Allah, show compassion to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You showed compassion to our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا سَلَّمْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, and send peace to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst send peace to our master Abraham, and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, send peace upon our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You sent peace upon our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَارْحَمْ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا وَآلَ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَرَحِمْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, and have mercy on our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, and show favour on our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst show blessing and mercy and favour to our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham in the ages; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, have mercy on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, and show favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You showed blessing, mercy, and favour to our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham throughout the ages — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ أُمَّهَاتِ المُؤْمِنِينَ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad the Prophet, and his wives who are Mothers of the Faithful, and his descendants and the people of his House, as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad the Prophet, his wives who are the Mothers of the Faithful, his descendants, and the people of his house, as You blessed our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, show favour to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst show favour to our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, show favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You showed favour to our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ دَاحِيَ المَدْحُوَّاتِ، وَبَارِئَ المَسْمُوكَاتِ، وَجَبَّارَ القُلُوبِ عَلَى فِطْرَتِهَا شَقِيِّهَا وَسَعِيدِهَا، اجْعَلْ شَرَائِفَ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَنَوَامِيَ بَرَكَاتِكَ وَرَأْفَةَ تَحَنُّنِكَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ الفَاتِحِ لِمَا أُغْلِقَ، وَالخَاتِمِ لِمَا سَبَقَ، وَالمُعْلِنِ الحَقَّ بِالحَقِّ، وَالدَّامِغِ لِجَيْشَاتِ الأَبَاطِيلِ كَمَا حُمِّلَ، فَاضْطَلَعَ بِأَمْرِكَ بِطَاعَتِكَ، مُسْتَوْفِزًا فِي مَرْضَاتِكَ، وَاعِيًا لِوَحْيِكَ، حَافِظًا لِعَهْدِكَ، مَاضِيًا عَلَى نَفَاذِ أَمْرِكَ، حَتَّى أَوْرَى قَبَسًا لِقَابِسٍ، آلَاءُ اللَّهِ تَصِلُ بِأَهْلِهِ أَسْبَابَهُ، بِهِ هُدِيَتِ القُلُوبُ بَعْدَ خَوْضَاتِ الفِتَنِ وَالإِثْمِ، وَأَبْهَجَ مُوضِحَاتِ الأَعْلَامِ، وَنَائِرَاتِ الأَحْكَامِ، وَمُنِيرَاتِ الإِسْلَامِ، فَهُوَ أَمِينُكَ المَأْمُونُ، وَخَازِنُ عِلْمِكَ المَخْزُونِ، وَشَهِيدُكَ يَوْمَ الدِّينِ، وَبَعِيثُكَ نِعْمَةً، وَرَسُولُكَ بِالْحَقِّ رَحْمَةً.
units.en: O Allah, Thou who didst level the plains and create the heights, and art Controller of hearts in their imaginations, be they wretched or be they happy, give the most excellent of Thy blessings and the kindest of Thy favours and the gentlest of Thy graces to Muhammad, Thy Servant and Apostle, who reveals whatever is most closed and secret, and seals whatever is past, and manifests the truth by the truth, and destroys the armies of folly, even as he was supported and enabled to bear his burthen in Thy work in obedience to Thee, maintaining himself promptly in Thy good favour, mindful of Thy revelation, observant of the promise, ever forward in the advance of Thy work, till he kindled the light for those who aspired to receiving the light, and access was gained through him to the blessings of Allah: when hearts were guided by him after discussions upon trials and sins, and the finest arguments of the learned, and the brilliant thoughts of the wise, and the enlightenments of self-surrender: verily he is Thy trusted trustee, and the treasure of Thy valued knowledge, and Thy Witness on the Day of Judgment, and Thy Envoy as a favour, and Thy Apostle too, in truth, as a mercy.
units.en2: O Allah, You who levelled the plains and created the heights, who govern hearts according to their inborn nature, wretched or happy: give the most excellent of Your blessings, the kindest of Your favours, and the gentlest of Your graces to Muhammad, Your servant and messenger — who opened what was closed, sealed what came before, proclaimed the truth by the truth, and crushed the armies of falsehood, bearing his burden in Your work as he was charged: in obedience to You, hastening to Your good pleasure, mindful of Your revelation, keeping Your covenant, ever pressing forward with Your command, until he kindled a light for everyone who aspired to receive it, and through him people gained access to the blessings of Allah; hearts were guided by him after plunging into trials and sins, after the finest arguments of the learned, the brilliant thoughts of the wise, and the lights of self-surrender. Truly he is Your trusted trustee, the treasure of Your valued knowledge, Your witness on the Day of Judgement, Your envoy as a favour, and Your messenger, in truth, as a mercy.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ افْسَحْ لَهُ فِي عَدْنِكَ، وَاجْزِهِ مُضَاعَفَاتِ الخَيْرِ مِن فَضْلِكَ مُهَنَّئَاتٍ لَهُ غَيْرَ مُكَدَّرَاتٍ، مِنْ فَوْزِ ثَوَابِكَ المَحْلُولِ، وَجَزِيلِ عَطَائِكَ المَعْلُولِ.
units.en: O Allah, give him free place in Thy Eden, and double his reward in the best of Thy favour, made pleasant and unalloyed for him, from the bounty of Thy manifest recompense, and the greatness of Thy repeated gifts.
units.en2: O Allah, give him a spacious place in Your Eden, and double his reward from the best of Your favour — made pleasant and untroubled for him — from the bounty of Your manifest recompense and the greatness of Your repeated gifts.

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ أَعْلِ عَلَى بِنَاءِ النَّاسِ بِنَاءَهُ، وَأَكْرِمْ مَثْوَاهُ لَدَيْكَ وَنُزُلَهُ، وَأَتْمِمْ لَهُ نُورَهُ، وَاجْزِهِ مِنِ ابْتِعَاثِكَ لَهُ مَقْبُولَ الشَّهَادَةِ، وَمَرْضِيَّ المَقَالَةِ، ذَا مَنْطِقٍ عَدْلٍ، وَخُطَّةٍ فَصْلٍ، وَبُرْهَانٍ عَظِيمٍ، ﴿
إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَمَلَـٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى النَّبِىِّ ۚ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ صَلُّواْ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلِّمُواْ تَسْلِيمًا  ﴾، لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبِّى وَسَعْدَيْكَ صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ البَرِّ الرَّحِيمِ، وَالمَلَائِكَةِ المُقَرَّبِينَ، وَالنَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ، وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، وَمَا سَبَّحَ لَكَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ، عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، خَاتِمِ النَّبِيِّينَ، وَسَيِّدِ المُرْسَلِينَ، وَإِمَامِ المُتَّقِينَ، وَرَسُولِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، الشَّاهِدِ البَشِيرِ، الدَّاعِي إِلَيْكَ بِإِذْنِكَ، السِّرَاجِ المُنِيرِ، وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
units.en: O Allah, exalt his followers over all mankind and honour his abode and his sojourn in Thy Presence, and give him perfect light, and when Thou recallest him to life, reward him by Thy witness to the reception and by Thy approval of the address awarded him, so that he becomes the author of upright speech, gracious conduct, and prevailing reason; Verily Allah and His Angels bless the Prophet. O ye who believe, pray Allah to bless him, and grant him abundant peace; I am Thy servant; O Allah, my Lord, in the name of Thy own felicity, the blessings of the True and Merciful Allah, and the angels who have the privilege of access to the Presence, and the Prophets and the Just, and the Witnesses, and the Upright, and whatever else offers Thee praise; yea, Thou Lord of the ages, may these blessings be on our master Muhammad, son of Abdullah, Seal of the Prophets, and master of the Apostles, Imam of the Devout, and Apostle of the Lord of the Worlds; the Witness, the Evangelist, the one who invoked mankind towards Thee by Thy leave, the Lamp of the Brightness, and on him be peace.
units.en2: O Allah, raise his edifice above the edifices of mankind; honour his resting-place and his lodging with You; perfect his light; and when You call him back to life, reward him with accepted testimony and approved speech — a tongue of justice, a decisive word, and a mighty proof. Truly, Allah and His angels bless the Prophet; O you who believe, call blessings upon him and greet him with abundant peace. At Your service, O Allah, my Lord, and at Your service again: may the blessings of Allah, the Benign, the Merciful, and of the angels brought near to the Presence, and of the prophets, the truthful, the witnesses, and the upright, and of everything that glorifies You — O Lord of the worlds — be upon our master Muhammad, son of ʿAbdullāh, the Seal of the Prophets, the master of the messengers, the imam of the devout, the messenger of the Lord of the worlds, the witness, the bearer of good news, the caller to You by Your leave, the luminous lamp — and upon him be peace.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ وَرَحْمَتَكَ عَلَى سَيِّدِ المُرْسَلِينَ، وَإِمَامِ المُتَّقِينَ، وَخَاتِمِ النَّبِيِّينَ، سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِك، إِمَامِ الخَيْرِ، وَقَائِدِ الخَيْرِ، وَرَسُولِ الرَّحْمَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, give effect to Thy Blessings and Thy Gracious Favours and Thy Mercy on the master of Apostles, the Imam of the Devout, the Seal of the Prophets, Muhammad Thy Servant and Apostle, the good Imam, the good Ruler, and Apostle of Mercy.
units.en2: O Allah, bestow Your blessings, Your gracious favours, and Your mercy upon the master of the messengers, the imam of the devout, the Seal of the Prophets — Muhammad, Your servant and messenger, the good imam, the good leader, and the messenger of mercy.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ ابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَّحْمُودًا يَغْبِطُهُ فِيهِ الأَوَّلُونَ وَالآخِرُونَ.
units.en: O Allah, send him to an honourable place, so that the First and the Last will envy him in it.
units.en2: O Allah, raise him to an honoured station in which the first and the last will envy him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou didst bless our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You blessed our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, grant favour to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, as Thou didst to the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Laudable and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, grant favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You granted favour to the family of our master Abraham — for You are Praiseworthy and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَأَوْلَادِهِ، وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، وَأَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَأَصْهَارِهِ، وَأَنْصَارِهِ وَأَشْيَاعِهِ، وَمُحِبِّيهِ وَأُمَّتِهِ وَعَلَيْنَا مَعَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
units.en: Bless our master Muhammad and his Family, and his Comrades, and his children, and his wives, and his descendants, and the men of his house, and his relatives by marriage, and those who aided him, and his partisans, and those who were attached to him, and are of his creed, and ourselves in union with them, one and all, Thou Merciful and Compassionate.
units.en2: Bless our master Muhammad, his family, his Companions, his children, his wives, his descendants, the people of his house, his relatives by marriage, those who aided him, his partisans, those who were attached to him and follow his creed — and ourselves together with them all, O Merciful and Compassionate.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَي سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَّمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَنَا بِالصَّلاةِ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ كَمَا يُحِبُّ أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every one who blesses him, and bless our master Muhammad in every one who does not bless him, and bless our master Muhammad as Thou hast enjoined us, in prayer to him; and bless our master Muhammad even as it is meet that he should be blessed.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in everyone who blesses him; bless our master Muhammad in everyone who does not bless him; bless our master Muhammad as You commanded us to, in prayer for him; and bless our master Muhammad as it is fitting that he should be blessed.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا أَمَرْتَنَا أَنْ نُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as Thou hast enjoined that we bless him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad, as You commanded us to bless him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad as much as he deserves.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as much as he deserves.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَاهُ لَهُ.
units.en: Bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad even as Thou desirest, and art pleased to approve for him.
units.en2: Bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as You desire and are pleased to approve for him.
