And by the Names by which our master Jahia (John) invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the Names by which our master Jeremiah invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the Names by which our master Isaiah invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the Names by which our master Elias invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the Names by which our master Elisha invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the Names by which our master Ezekiel invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the Names by which our master Joshua invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the Names by which our master Jesus son of Mary invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the Names by which our master Muhammad invoked Thee, the blessing and peace of Allah be on him, And on all the Prophets and Apostles one and all, so that the blessing shall be on our master Muhammad Thy Prophet throughout the number of all things that Thou hast created, before the heavens were built up, or the earth spread forth, or the mountains raised, or the seas set to flow, or the fountains opened, or the rivers given their currents, or the sun illuminated, or the moon became bright, or the stars shone; And Thou wast when Thou wast; There knoweth no one when Thou wast; save Thou Alone in Thy Unity, And there is no associate with Thee
units.en2: And I entreat You, O Allah, by the names by which our master Adam called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Noah called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Hūd called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Abraham called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Ṣāliḥ called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Jonah called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Job called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Jacob called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Joseph called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Moses called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Aaron called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Hobab called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Ishmael called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master David called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Solomon called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Zachariah called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Yaḥyā (John) called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Jeremiah called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Isaiah called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Elijah called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Elisha called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Ezekiel called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Joshua called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Jesus son of Mary called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Muhammad called upon You — Allah bless him and grant him peace — and upon all the prophets and messengers, one and all: that blessing be upon our master Muhammad, Your prophet, as many times as all things You created before the heavens were built, the earth spread out, the mountains raised, the seas set flowing, the springs opened, the rivers given their courses, the sun lit, the moon made bright, or the stars made to shine. And You were when You were — no one knows when You were but You alone in Your oneness, and You have no partner.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ حِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ عَرْشِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ القَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الكِتَابِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقٌ فِيهِنَّ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad to the best of Thy Forbearance; And bless our master Muhammad to the best of Thy Knowledge; And bless our master Muhammad to the best of Thy Words; And bless our master Muhammad to the best of Thy Grace; And bless our master Muhammad throughout Thy Heavens; And bless our master Muhammad throughout Thy Earth; And bless our master Muhammad in all Thy Throne; And bless our master Muhammad in the embellishment of Thy Throne; And bless our master Muhammad through all that the Pen recorded in the contents of the Book; And bless our master Muhammad throughout all that Thou hast created in Thy Seven Heavens; And bless our master Muhammad throughout all that Thou createst in them unto the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad to the full reach of Your forbearance; bless our master Muhammad to the full reach of Your knowledge; bless our master Muhammad to the full reach of Your words; bless our master Muhammad to the full reach of Your grace; bless our master Muhammad throughout Your heavens; bless our master Muhammad throughout Your earth; bless our master Muhammad in all Your Throne; bless our master Muhammad in the adornment of Your Throne; bless our master Muhammad through all the Pen recorded in the contents of the Book; bless our master Muhammad through all You created in Your seven heavens; and bless our master Muhammad through all You create in them until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ قَطَرَتْ مِنْ سَمَاوَاتِكَ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad throughout every drop, every drop of rain that falls from heaven on Thy earth, from the day that Thou didst create the world till the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad for every drop of rain that falls from Your heaven upon Your earth, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يُسَبِّحُكَ وَيُهَلِّلُكَ وَيُكَبِّرُكَ وَيُعَظِّمُكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad always for every one who shall praise Thee, And declare Thy Name and Thy Greatness and Thy Power, From the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad always, for everyone who praises You and proclaims Your name, Your greatness, and Your power, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ نَسَمَةٍ خَلَقْتَهَا فِيهِمْ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in themselves and in their words, and bless our master Muhammad throughout every breath that Thou hast created in them from the day that Thou didst create the world, till the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in themselves and in their words, and bless our master Muhammad for every breath You created in them, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الجَارِيَةِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all the passing clouds, tanned in all the fleeting winds, from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all the passing clouds and all the fleeting winds, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا هَبَّتْ عَلَيْهِ الرِّيَاحُ وَحَرَّكَتْهُ مِنَ الأَغْصَانِ وَالأَشْجَارِ، وَالأَوْرَاقِ وَالثِّمَارِ، وَجَمِيعِ مَا خَلَقْتَ عَلَى أَرْضِكَ، وَمَا بَيْنَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in everything on which the winds breathe and stir it, be it branch or tree or leaves or fruit, and everything that Thou hast created on Thy Earth, and everything within Thy Heavens from the day that Thou didst create the world till the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in everything the winds breathe on and stir — branch, tree, leaf, or fruit — and in everything You created on Your earth and everything within Your heavens, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all the stars of heaven, from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all the stars of heaven, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِّلْءَ أَرْضِكَ، مِمَّا حَمَلَتْ وَأَقَلَّتْ مِنْ قُدْرَتِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the fullness of Thy Earth, in all that Thou hast sustained and ordained by Thy Power.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad to the fullness of Your earth, in all You have sustained and ordained by Your power.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ بِحَارِكَ، مِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ فِيهَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all that Thou hast created in Thy Seven Seas, the knowledge whereof no one knows but Thee, and whatever Thou dost create in them till the Day of Resurrection, and every day a thousand times.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all You created in Your seven seas — which no one knows but You — and in all You create in them until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مِلْءِ سَبْعِ بِحَارِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ زِنَةَ سَبْعِ بِحَارِكَ، مِمَّا حَمَلَتْ وَأَقَلَّتْ مِنْ قُدْرَتِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the fullness of Thy Seven Seas; and bless our master Muhammad in the splendour of Thy Seven Seas; in all that Thou hast sustained or ordained in Thy power.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad to the fullness of Your seven seas, and bless our master Muhammad in the splendour of Your seven seas, in all You have sustained or ordained by Your power.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَمْوَاجِ بِحَارِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all the undulations of the waters, sweet or salt, from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every swell of the waters, sweet or salt, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرَّمْلِ وَالحَصَى فِي مُسْتَقَرِّ الأَرَضِينَ وَسَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad throughout all the sand and the stones of the wide regions of the earth, and its plains and its mountains, from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all the sand and stones of the earth's wide regions, its plains and its mountains, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ اضْطِرَابِ المِيَاهِ العَذْبَةِ وَالمِلْحَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَهُ عَلَى جَدِيدِ أَرْضِكَ فِي مُسْتَقَرِّ الأَرَضِينَ شَرْقِهَا وَغَرْبِهَا سَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا وَأَوْدِيَتِهَا وَطَرِيقِهَا وَعَامِرِهَا وَغَامِرِهَا إِلَى سَائِرِ مَا خَلَقْتَهُ عَلَيْهَا وَمَا فِيهَا مِنْ حَصَاةٍ وَمَدَرٍ وَحَجَرٍ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad through all that Thou hast created on the surface of Thy Earth through the wide regions of the lands, In the East and the West thereof, in its plains and mountains, in its valleys and its roads, the parts that are peopled and those that are deserted, for the traveler whom Thou hast created in it, And through all the flints and clay and stones that are in it, from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all You created on the face of Your earth across the wide lands, east and west, in their plains and mountains, valleys and roads, the inhabited parts and the deserted, for every traveller You created in it; and in all the flint, clay, and stones within it, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ عَدَدَ نَبَاتِ الأَرْضِ مِنْ قِبْلَتِهَا وَشَرْقِهَا وَغَرْبِهَا، وَسَهْلِهَا وَجِبَالِهَا وَأَوْدِيَتِهَا، وَأَشْجَارِهَا وَثِمَارِهَا، وَأَوْرَاقِهَا وَزُرُوعِهَا، وَجَمِيعِ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ نَبَاتِهَا وَبَرَكَاتِهَا، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet, through all the productions of the earth towards her South and towards her East, and her West, her plains and her mountains, her valleys and her trees, her fruits, her leaves, and her seeds, and all that may issue from her productions, and her blessings, from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, in all the produce of the earth — to her south, her east, her west; her plains and mountains, valleys and trees, fruits, leaves, and seeds, and all that issues from her produce and her blessings — from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْهُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad through all that Thou hast created of spirits and men and devils, and any of them whom Thou mayest create till the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all You created of spirits, men, and jinn, and any of them You create until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ فِي أَبْدَانِهِمْ وَفِي وُجُوهِهِمْ وَعَلَى رُءُوسِهِمْ، مُنْذُ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad through every follicle of hair on their bodies and their faces, and their heads since Thou didst create the world till the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad for every hair on their bodies, their faces, and their heads, since You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ خَفَقَانِ الطَّيْرِ وَطَيَرَانِ الجِنِّ وَالشَّيَاطِينِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad through all the movements of birds, and the flight of spirits and devils from the day that Thou didst create the world, to the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every movement of birds and every flight of spirits and jinn, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ بَهِيمَةٍ خَلَقْتَهَا عَلَى وَجْهِ أَرْضِكَ مِنْ صَغِيرٍ أَوْ كَبِيرٍ، فِي مَشَارِقِ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، مِنْ إِنْسِهَا وَجِنِّهَا، وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad through every animal that Thou hast created on the surface of Thy earth, be it small or great, in the Eastern parts of the earth, or the Western, with the men upon it and the spirits and all besides: the knowledge whereof no one enjoys except Thou Thyself, from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every animal You created on the face of Your earth, small or great, in the east of the earth or the west, together with the men, the spirits, and all else upon it — which no one knows but You alone — from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ خُطَاهُمْ عَلَى وَجْهِ الأَرْضِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all their footsteps on the face of the earth, from the day that Thou didst create the world till the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all their footsteps on the face of the earth, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ القَطْرِ وَالمَطَرِ وَالنَّبَاتِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in every man that blesses him, and bless our master Muhammad in every man that does not bless him, and bless our master Muhammad in every shower and rain and plants, and bless our master Muhammad in every sort of things.
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in everyone who blesses him, and bless our master Muhammad in everyone who does not bless him; bless our master Muhammad in every shower, every rain, and every plant; and bless our master Muhammad in every kind of thing.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ في اللَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ في النَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ في الآخِرَةِ وَالأُولَى، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ شَابًّا زَكِيًّا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَهْلًا مَرْضِيًّا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مُنْذُ كَانَ في المَهْدِ صَبِيًّا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ شَيْءٌ.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the night when it closes in and in the daylight as it brightens, and bless our master Muhammad in the End and in the Beginning, and bless our master Muhammad in all his brightness and purity, and bless our master Muhammad in all his acknowledged manhood, and bless our master Muhammad since he was a babe in the cradle, and bless our master Muhammad till there shall be no blessing whatever left.
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the night as it closes in and the daylight as it brightens; bless our master Muhammad in the end and in the beginning; bless our master Muhammad in all his brightness and purity; bless our master Muhammad in all his acknowledged manhood; bless our master Muhammad from when he was a babe in the cradle; and bless our master Muhammad until no blessing of any kind remains.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَأَعْطِ سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا المَقَامَ المَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، الَّذِي إِذَا قَالَ صَدَّقْتَهُ، وَإِذَا سَأَلَ أَعْطَيْتَهُ.
units.en: And, O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the Honourable Place which Thou hast promised him, which Thou didst verify when he spoke, and which Thou didst grant when he asked.
units.en2: And, O Allah, grant our master Muhammad the honoured station You promised him — which You confirmed when he spoke and granted when he asked.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَأَعْظِمْ بُرْهَانَهُ، وَشَرِّفْ بُنْيَانَهُ، وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ، وَبَيِّنْ فَضِيلَتَهُ.
units.en: And, O Allah, strengthen his argument, and confirm his eloquence, and give success to his reasoning, and manifest his kindness,
units.en2: And, O Allah, strengthen his argument, confirm his eloquence, give success to his reasoning, and make his kindness manifest,

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَتَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ فِي أُمَّتِهِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِسُنَّتِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ، وَتَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنْ رُفَقَائِهِ، وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ، وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ، وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَحَبَّتِهِ، اللَّهُمَّ آمِينَ.
units.en:
And, O Allah, accept his intercession in his religion, and employ us in his law, and unite us to his society, and gather us to his company, and beneath his standard, and make us to be of his comrades, and lead us to his fountain, and give us water of his cup, and let us profit by his affection.

O Allah, Ameen.
units.en2: And, O Allah, accept his intercession for his community; employ us in his law, unite us with his fellowship, gather us into his company beneath his banner, make us his companions, lead us to his fountain, give us to drink from his cup, and let us profit from his love. O Allah, amen.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ الَّتِي دَعَوْتُكَ بِهَا أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا وَصَفْتُ، وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَأَنْ تَرْحَمَنِي وَتَتُوبَ عَلَيَّ وَتُعَافِيَنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ البَلَاءِ وَالبَلْوَاءِ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَ المُؤْمِنِينَ وَالمُؤْمِنَاتِ، وَالمُسْلِمِينَ وَالمُسْلِمَاتِ، الأَحْيَاءَ مِنْهُمْ وَالأَمْوَاتَ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِعَبْدِكَ (فُلَانِ بْنِ فُلَانٍ) المُذْنِبِ الخَاطِئِ الضَّعِيفِ، وَأَنْ تَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِ، إِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ، اللَّهُمَّ آمِينَ، يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en: And, I beseech Thee by the Name wherein I pray to Thee that Thou wouldest bless our master Muhammad through all that I have specified, and in that whereof there is no one who knows it except Thou Alone; and that Thou wouldest have mercy on me, and pardon me, and preserve me from all trials and calamities, and that Thou wouldest forgive me, and my parents, and have mercy on all believers, and all Muslim, be they men or women, and on those of them who are living, and those who are dead; and that Thou wouldest pardon Thy servant M or N. son of the late lamented C. or D.,(the reader of this book) a humble sinner, erroneous and weak: and that Thou wilt have regard for him, for Thou art Forgiving and Merciful. O Allah Ameen.
units.en2: And I beseech You by the name by which I pray to You, to bless our master Muhammad through all I have specified, and through that which no one knows but You alone; to have mercy on me and pardon me; to preserve me from all trials and calamities; to forgive me and my parents; to have mercy on all believers and all Muslims, men and women, living and dead; and to pardon Your servant, the reader of this book, a humble, erring, weak sinner — and to watch over him, for You are Forgiving and Merciful. O Allah, amen.

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ مَا حَمَلَ كُرْسِيُّكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ وَقُدْرَتِكَ وَجَلَالِكَ وَبَهَائِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ اسْمِكَ المَخْزُونِ المَكْنُونِ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ، وَأَنْزَلْتَهُ فِي كِتَابِكَ، وَاسْتَأثَرْتَ بِهِ فِي عِلْمِ الغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ.
وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ أَجَبْتَ، وَإِذَا سُئِلْتَ بِهِ أَعْطَيْتَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي وَضَعْتَهُ عَلَى اللَّيْلِ فَأَظْلَمَ، وَعَلَى النَّهَارِ فَاسْتَنَارَ، وَعَلَى السَّمَاوَاتِ فَاسْتَقَلَّتْ، وَعَلَى الأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ، وَعَلَى الجِبَالِ فَأَرْسَتْ، وَعَلَى الصَّعْبَةِ فَذَلَّتْ، وَعَلَى مَاءِ السَّمَاءِ فَسَكَبَتْ، وَعَلَى مَاءِ السَّحَابِ فَأَمْطَرَتْ.
وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ نَّبِيُّكَ.
وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ سَيِّدُنَا آدَمُ نَبِيُّكَ.
وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ أَنْبِيَاؤُكَ وَرُسُلُكَ، وَمَلَائِكَتُكَ المُقَرَّبُونَ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْمَعِينَ.
وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ أَهْلُ طَاعَتِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ، أَنْ تُصَلِّي عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً، وَالأَرْضُ مَدْحِيَّةً، وَالجِبَالُ مَرْسِيَّةً، وَالعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً، وَالأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً، وَالشَّمْسُ مُضْحِيَّةً، وَالقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا، وَالكَوَاكِبُ مُنِيرَةً.
units.en: This is for any one who recites it every Friday the whole of it, his is this grace; by Allah, who is the source of Grace and all Powerful; and in another narrative.
units.en2: This grace belongs to anyone who recites it in full every Friday — by Allah, the source of grace, the All-Powerful. And in another narration:

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ حِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَحْصَاهُ اللَّوْحُ المَحْفُوظُ مِنْ عِلْمِكَ.
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ القَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الكِتابِ عِنْدَكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en:
For, O Allah, I beseech Thee by the truth that sustains Thy Throne, of Thy Power and Thy Glory and Thy Grandeur and Thy Splendor and by Thy Power, and by the Truth of Thy Name so treasured, so precious, by which Thou hast Named Thyself, and hast inserted it in Thy Book, and hast reserved it for Thyself in the Secret knowledge that is with Thyself; yes, that thou wilt bless Thy servant and Apostle Muhammad; and I beseech Thee by Thy Name by which if invoked Thou answers, and by which if I entreat Thee by it, Thou grantest my request; and I beseech Thee by the Name which if Thou dost use it with the night, it becomes dark; I and if with the daylight, it becomes bright; or with the heavens, they rise aloft; or with the earth, she stands firm; or with the mountains, they range in peaks; or whatever is hard becomes simple; or with the water of heaven, it gives rain; or with the clouds, they send a shower; and I beseech Thee by that Name wherewith our master Muhammad Thy Prophet entreated Thee; and I beseech Thee by that wherewith our master Adam Thy Prophet entreated Thee, and I beseech Thee by that wherewith Thy Prophets and Apostles and Thy closest Angels entreated Thee, O Allah, bless them all; and I beseech Thee by that wherewith the People of Thy Service one and all entreat Thee, that Thou wouldest bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad throughout all that Thou hadest created; before the heavens were firm or the earth wide, or the mountains firm, or the fountains abundant, or the rivers full of water, or the sun brilliant, or the moon shining, or the stars gave their light.

O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, and the Family of our master Muhammad in all Thy knowledge; and bless our master Muhammad, and the Family of our master Muhammad in all Thy Patience; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all the decrees of the Table preserved in Thy knowledge.
units.en2: For, O Allah, I beseech You by the truth that sustains Your Throne, by Your power, glory, grandeur, and splendour, and by the truth of Your treasured, precious name by which You named Yourself, which You placed in Your Book and reserved for Yourself in the hidden knowledge that is with You — that You bless Your servant and messenger Muhammad. And I beseech You by Your name which, when invoked, You answer, and when asked by it, You grant; and I beseech You by the name which, when You speak it to the night, it darkens; to the daylight, it brightens; to the heavens, they rise aloft; to the earth, it stands firm; to the mountains, they rise in peaks; by which whatever is hard becomes easy; by which heaven's water gives rain and the clouds pour showers. And I beseech You by the name by which our master Muhammad, Your prophet, entreated You; and I beseech You by that by which our master Adam, Your prophet, entreated You; and I beseech You by that by which Your prophets, Your messengers, and Your nearest angels entreated You — O Allah, bless them all; and I beseech You by that by which all the people of Your service entreat You — that You bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad through all You created before the heavens stood firm, the earth spread wide, the mountains stood fast, the springs flowed abundantly, the rivers ran full, the sun shone brilliant, the moon gave light, or the stars gleamed. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all Your knowledge; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all Your patience; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the decrees of the Preserved Tablet in Your knowledge.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ صُفُوفِ المَلَائِكَةِ وَتَسْبِيحِهِمْ وَتَقْدِيسِهِمْ، وَتَحْمِيدِهِمْ وَتَمْجِيدِهِمْ، وَتَكْبِيرِهِمْ وَتَهْلِيلِهِمْ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all that the Pen has entered in the original of the Book that is with Thee; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad throughout Thy heavens; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad throughout Thy earth; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad through all that Thou art creating, from the day that Thou didst create and world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all that the Pen has entered in the original Book that is with You; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad throughout Your heavens; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad throughout Your earth; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all You are creating, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection — every day a thousand times.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الجَارِيَةِ، وَالرِّيَاحِ الذَّارِيَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad throughout the ranks of angels and their songs of praise, and their holiness and honour and glory and their declaration of Thy Greatness and their pronouncement of Thy Unity from the day that Thou didst create the world until the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad through all the ranks of angels — their songs of praise, their holiness, honour, and glory, their proclamation of Your greatness and Your oneness — from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ تَقْطُرُ مِنْ سَمَاوَاتِكَ إِلَى أَرْضِكَ، وَمَا تَقْطُرُ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad through all the clouds that pass and the winds that blow, from the day that Thou didst create the world, until the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the passing clouds and blowing winds, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا هَبَّتِ الرِّيَاحُ، وَعَدَدَ مَا تَحَرَّكَتِ الأَشْجَارُ وَالأَوْرَاقُ وَالزَّرْعُ، وَجَمِيعِ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي قَرَارِ الحِفْظِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all the drops of rain that may or may not drop from Thy heavens upon Thy earth, from the day that Thou didst create the world until the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the drops of rain that fall or do not fall from Your heavens upon Your earth, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ القَطْرِ وَالمَطَرِ وَالنَّبَاتِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad it all the winds that blow, and in all that stir the trees and the leaves and seed, and all that Thou hast created in the Abode of Safety, from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the winds that blow and all that stirs the trees, the leaves, and the seeds, and in all You created in the Abode of Safety, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النُّجُومِ فِي السَّمَاءِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in ai} the dew and rain and plants from the day that Thou didst create the world till the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the dew, rain, and plants, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي بِحَارِكَ السَّبْعَةِ مِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad through all the stars in heaven from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad through all the stars in heaven, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرَّمْلِ وَالحَصَى، فِي مَشَارِقِ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all that Thou hast created in Thy seven seas of what there is no one who has knowledge of it, except Thou Alone; and that which Thou art creating until the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all You created in Your seven seas — which no one knows but You alone — and in all You are creating until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنَ الجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ، وَمَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad through all the sands and stony places in the Eastern and Western regions of the earth.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad through all the sands and stony places in the eastern and western regions of the earth.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَنْفَاسِهِمْ وَأَلْفَاظِهِمْ وَأَلْحَاظِهِمْ مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad through all that Thou hast created, of spirits and men, and all that Thou art creating until the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad through all You created of spirits and men, and all You are creating until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ طَيَرَانِ الجِنِّ وَالمَلَائِكَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all their souls and words and looks from the day that Thou didst create the world until the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all their souls, words, and glances, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الطُّيُورِ وَالهَوَامِّ، وَعَدَدَ الوُحُوشِ وَالآكَامِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in every flight of spirits and angels from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in every flight of spirits and angels, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الأَحْيَاءِ وَالأَمْوَاتِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all birds and invertebrates and wild beasts and rising hills in the Eastern and in the Western regions of the earth.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all birds, creeping things, and wild beasts, and all rising hills in the eastern and western regions of the earth.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad through all the living and the dead.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad through all the living and the dead.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى رِجْلَيْنِ، وَمَنْ يَمْشِي عَلَى أَرْبَعٍ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad wherever the night has darkened or the light brightened, from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad wherever night has darkened or daylight brightened, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ وَالمَلَائِكَةِ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en:
O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad for every creature that walks on two feet or four, from the day that Thou didst create the earth to the Day of Resurrection.

O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in every one who blesses him, of spirits and men and angels, from the day that Thou didst create the world to the Day of Resurrection.

O Allah, bless our master Muhammad. and the Family of our master Muhammad, for every one who blesses him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad for every creature that walks on two legs or four, from the day You created the earth until the Day of Resurrection; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in everyone who blesses him, of spirits, men, and angels, from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad for everyone who blesses him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad for every one who does not bless him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad for everyone who does not bless him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا يَجِبُ أَنْ يُّصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as it is meet that he shall be blessed.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as it is fitting that he be blessed.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad, even as it shall be right that he shall be blessed.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as it is right that he be blessed.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ حَتَّى لَا يَبْقَى شَيْءٌ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad until there shall be no sort of blessing remaining for him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad until no blessing of any kind remains for him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الأَوَّلِينَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ فِي الآخِرِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad among the First : and bless our master Muhammad among the Last,
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad among the first, and bless our master Muhammad among the last,

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ في المَلَإِ الأَعْلَى إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ، مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ، لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا باللَّهِ العَلِيِّ العَظِيمِ.
units.en: O Allah, and bless our master Muhammad in the Higher Assembly of angels until the Day of Judgement. as Allah wishes; there is no power save in Allah, the Exalted, the Mighty One.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in the highest assembly of angels until the Day of Judgement, as Allah wills — there is no power except with Allah, the Exalted, the Mighty.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَأَعْطِهِ الوَسِيلَةَ وَالفَضِيلَةَ، وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ اللَّهُمَّ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ المِيعَادَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad and grant him influence and grace and high rank, and award him hereafter the Illustrious Place that Thou hast ordained for him, for Thou dost not change that which is ordained.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad; grant him intercession, grace, and high rank, and award him in the hereafter the Praised Station You have ordained for him — for You never break what You have decreed.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَظِّمْ شَاْنَهُ، وَبَيِّنْ بُرْهَانَهُ، وَأَبْلِجْ حُجَّتَهُ، وَبَيِّنْ فَضِيلَتَهُ، وَتَقَبَّلْ شَفَاعَتَهُ فِي أُمَّتِهِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا بِسُنَّتِهِ، يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ، وَيَا رَبَّ العَرْشِ العَظِيمِ.
units.en: O Allah, strengthen his work and define his argument, and fulfill his principles, and give evidence of his merits, and accept his intercession in his religion, and exercise us in his law, Thou Lord of the Worlds, Thou Lord of the Mighty Throne.
units.en2: O Allah, strengthen his work, define his argument, fulfill his principles, make his merits evident, accept his intercession for his community, and train us in his law, O Lord of the Worlds, Lord of the Mighty Throne.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ احْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ وَتَحْتَ لِوَائِهِ، وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ، وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَحَبَّتِهِ، آمِينَ يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, yea, Lord, enlist us in his company, and beneath his standard, and suffer us to drink of his cup, and benefit us with his love so be it O Thou Lord of the Worlds.
units.en2: O Allah — yes, Lord — enlist us in his company beneath his banner, let us drink from his cup, and benefit us with his love. So be it, O Lord of the Worlds.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ بَلِّغْهُ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ السَّلَامِ، وَاجْزِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ بِهِ نَبِيًّا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, yea, Lord, cause him to receive for our sakes the perfection of the peace and reward him for our sakes with the reward as gracious as Thou hast ever given to any of Thy Prophets from his followers in faith, O Thou Lord of the Worlds.
units.en2: O Allah — yes, Lord — grant him on our behalf the perfection of peace, and reward him on our behalf as graciously as You ever rewarded any of Your prophets on behalf of his followers in faith, O Lord of the Worlds.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا رَبِّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي وَتَرْحَمَنِي وَتَتُوبَ عَلَيَّ وَتُعَافِيَنِي مِنْ جَمِيعِ البَلَاءِ وَالبَلْوَاءِ، الخَارِجِ مِنَ الأَرْضِ وَالنَّازِلِ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ بِرَحْمَتِكَ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالمُؤْمِنَاتِ، وَالمُسْلِمِينَ وَالمُسْلِمَاتِ، الأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالأَمْوَاتِ، وَرَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ الطَّاهِرَاتِ أُمَّهَاتِ المُؤْمِنِينَ، وَرَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِ الأَعْلَامِ أَئِمَّةِ الهُدَى، وَمَصَابِيحِ الدُّنْيَا، وَعَنِ التَّابِعِينَ وَتَابِعِ التَّابِعِينَ لَهُمْ بِإِحْسَانٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en:
O Allah, yea, Lord, myself I beseech Thee to forgive me and have mercy on me, and look on me, and preserve me from all trials and evils that proceed from the earth, and descend from the heaven, as Thou art Powerful over everything in Thy Mercy; and that Thou wouldest forgive the believers and Muslims, men and women alike, as well those of them who are alive as those who are deceased; and may Allah be pleased with his wives who are pure and are Mothers of the Faithful, and may Allah be pleased with those of his Companions who were men of learning, teachers of the way of life, and shining lamps in the World; and those who were their disciples, and disciples of their disciples in doing good unto the Day of Judgement.

Praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Worlds.
units.en2: O Allah — yes, Lord — I myself beseech You: forgive me, have mercy on me, look upon me, and preserve me from every trial and evil that comes from the earth or descends from heaven, as You are powerful over all things in Your mercy; and forgive the believers and the Muslims, men and women alike, the living and the deceased. May Allah be pleased with his wives, the pure, the Mothers of the Faithful; may Allah be pleased with his Companions who were men of learning, teachers of the way of life, and shining lamps in the world, and with their disciples and their disciples' disciples in doing good until the Day of Judgement. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.

sections.note: English: historical translation by Rev. John B. Pearson (Guide to Happiness, Oxford, 1907), in the public domain.

sections.heading: Saturday — Ḥizb 6 (حِزْبُ يَوْمِ السَّبْت)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ الأَرْوَاحِ وَالأَجْسَادِ البَالِيَةِ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِطَاعَةِ الأَرْوَاحِ الرَّاجِعَةِ إِلَى أَجْسَادِهَا، وَبِطَاعَةِ الأَجْسَادِ المُلْتَئِمَةِ بِعُرُوقِهَا، وَبِكَلِمَاتِكَ النَّافِذَةِ فِيهِمْ، وَأَخْذِكَ الحَقَّ مِنْهُمْ، وَالخَلَائِقُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ يَنْتَظِرُونَ فَصْلَ قَضَائِكَ، وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَكَ، وَيَخَافُونَ عِقَابَكَ، أَنْ تَجْعَلَ النُّورَ فِي بَصَرِي، وَذِكْرَكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ عَلَى لِسَانِي، وَعَمَلًا صَالِحًا فَارْزُقْنِي.
units.en: O Allah, Lord of our transient spirits and of our frail bodies, I beseech Thee by the obedience of the spirits that return to their bodies, and by the obedience of the bodies that are restored in their nerves, and by Thy Words that pass over them, and the grasp that Thy Truth takes of them, and by the created beings in Thy Presence who await the issue of Thy Decree and hope for Thy Mercy and fear Thy punishment: I beseech Thee that Thou wilt put light in my sight, and the remembrance of Thee on my tongue in the night and in the day, and good deeds; and give me what I need.
units.en2: O Allah, Lord of our fleeting spirits and our frail bodies, I beseech You by the obedience of spirits that return to their bodies, by the obedience of bodies restored in their nerves, by Your words that pass over them, and by the grip Your truth takes of them, and by the created beings in Your presence awaiting Your decree, hoping for Your mercy and fearing Your punishment: put light in my sight, remembrance of You on my tongue night and day, and good deeds; and give me what I need.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, and favour our master Muhammad as Thou didst favour the Family of our master Abraham.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad as You blessed our master Abraham, and favour our master Muhammad as You favoured the family of our master Abraham.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَبَرَكَاتِكَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا جَعَلْتَهَا عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bestow Thy blessings and Thy favours on our master Muhammad and on the Family of our master Muhammad. as Thou didst bestow them on our master Abraham and on the Family of our master Abraham, for Thou art Praiseworthy and Honourable; and show favour to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad as Thou didst show favour to our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham, for Thou art Praiseworthy and Honourable.
units.en2: O Allah, bestow Your blessings and favours on our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as You bestowed them on our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — You are Praiseworthy and Honourable; and show favour to our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as You showed favour to our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — You are Praiseworthy and Honourable.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَرَسُولِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى المُؤْمِنِينَ وَالمُؤْمِنَاتِ، وَالمُسْلِمِينَ وَالمُسْلِمَاتِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, Thy Servant and Thy Apostle, and bless the faithful and Muslims, men and women alike.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, Your servant and messenger, and bless the believers and Muslims, men and women alike.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ، وَأَحْصَاهُ كِتَابُكَ، وَشَهِدَتْ بِهِ مَلَائِكَتُكَ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً تَدُومُ بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِ اللَّهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless Muhammad our master, and his Family throughout all that Thy knowledge includes, or Thy Book teaches, or Thy angels testify in continuous blessings that may endure through the eternity of the kingdom of Allah.
units.en2: O Allah, bless Muhammad our master and his family in all Your knowledge encompasses, Your Book teaches, and Your angels testify — continuous blessings enduring through the eternity of the kingdom of Allah.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ العِظَامِ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهَا نَفْسَكَ مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ، أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَبْدِكَ وَنَبِيِّكَ وَرَسُولِكَ، عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً، وَالأَرْضُ مَدْحِيَّةً، وَالجِبَالُ مَرْسِيَّةً، وَالعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً، وَالأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً، وَالشَّمْسُ مُشْرِقَةً، وَالقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا، وَالكَوَاكِبُ مُسْتَنِيرَةً، وَالبِحَارُ مُجْرِيَةً، وَالأَشْجَارُ مُثْمِرَةً.
units.en: For, O Allah, I beseech Thee by Thy Mighty Names, by those of them that I have learned, and those which I do not know, and by the Names by which Thou hast named Thyself, those of them that I have learned and those I know not, that Thou wilt bless our master Muhammad Thy Servant, Thy Prophet and Apostle, throughout all that Thou hast created, even before the heavens were firm or the earth plain, or the mountains ranged aloft, or the fountains flowed, or the rivers were full to the brim; or the sun rose in splendour, and the moon gave her light, and the stars twinkled and the seas rolled, or the trees gave their fruit.
units.en2: For, O Allah, I beseech You by Your mighty names — those I have learned and those I do not know — and by the names by which You named Yourself, those I have learned and those I do not know, to bless our master Muhammad, Your servant, prophet, and messenger, through all You created even before the heavens stood firm, the earth spread flat, the mountains rose aloft, the springs flowed, the rivers brimmed full, the sun rose in splendour, the moon gave her light, the stars twinkled, the seas rolled, or the trees bore fruit.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ عِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ حِلْمِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نِعْمَتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ فَضْلِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ جُودِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَرْضِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ مِنْ مَلَائِكَتِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي أَرْضِكَ مِنَ الجِنِّ وَالإِنْسِ وَغَيْرِهِمَا، مِنَ الوَحْشِ وَالطَّيْرِ وَغَيْرِهِمَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَى بِهِ القَلَمُ فِي عِلْمِ غَيْبِكَ، وَمَا يَجْرِي بِهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ القَطْرِ وَالمَطَرِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ يَحْمَدُكَ وَيَشْكُرُكَ، وَيُهَلِّلُكَ وَيُمَجِّدُكَ، وَيَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْتَ وَمَلَائِكَتُكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الجِبَالِ وَالرِّمَالِ وَالحَصَى، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الشَّجَرِ وَأَوْرَاقِهَا، وَالمَدَرِ وَأَثْقَالِهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ كُلِّ سَنَةٍ وَمَا تَخْلُقُ فِيهَا وَمَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا تَخْلُقُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ وَمَا يَمُوتُ فِيهِ إِلَى يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad throughout all Thy knowledge, and bless our master Muhammad in all Thy Patience, and bless our master Muhammad in all Thy Words, and bless our master Muhammad in all Thy Kindness, and bless our master Muhammad in all Thy Grace, and bless our master Muhammad in all Thy Generosity, and bless our master Muhammad in all Thy Heavens, and bless our master Muhammad in all Thy Earth; and bless our master Muhammad in all Thou hast created in Thy Seven Heavens, of Thy angels; and bless our master Muhammad in all that Thou hast created in Thy Earth, of spirits and men, and all besides them, of wild beasts and birds and all besides them; and bless our master Muhammad in all that the Pen has narrated in the knowledge of Thy Secrets, and in all that it will narrate until the Day of Resurrection; and bless our master Muhammad in all showers and rain; and bless our master Muhammad in every one that may praise Thee, and give Thee thanks and chant Thy praise, and honour Thee, and bear witness that Thou art Allah; and bless our master Muhammad in all that Thou hast blessed, Thou and Thy angels; and bless our master Muhammad in every one who blesses him of Thy creation; and bless our master Muhammad in every one of Thy creation who does not bless him; and bless our master Muhammad throughout all the mountains and plains of sand or stone; and bless our master Muhammad throughout all the trees, and their leaves, and in all villages and their stores; and bless our master Muhammad in every year, and whatever Thou mayest create in it, and whatever may die in it; and bless our master Muhammad in all that Thou mayest create every day, and whatever dies in it, till the Day of Resurrection.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all Your knowledge; bless our master Muhammad in all Your patience; bless our master Muhammad in all Your words; bless our master Muhammad in all Your kindness; bless our master Muhammad in all Your grace; bless our master Muhammad in all Your generosity; bless our master Muhammad in all Your heavens; bless our master Muhammad in all Your earth; bless our master Muhammad in all You created in Your seven heavens of Your angels; bless our master Muhammad in all You created in Your earth of spirits and men and all besides — wild beasts, birds, and all else; bless our master Muhammad in all the Pen has recorded in the knowledge of Your secrets and all it will record until the Day of Resurrection; bless our master Muhammad in every shower and rain; bless our master Muhammad in everyone who praises You, thanks You, chants Your praise, honours You, and bears witness that You are Allah; bless our master Muhammad in all that You and Your angels have blessed; bless our master Muhammad in everyone of Your creation who blesses him; bless our master Muhammad in everyone of Your creation who does not bless him; bless our master Muhammad throughout all mountains and plains of sand or stone; bless our master Muhammad throughout all trees and their leaves, and in all villages and their stores; bless our master Muhammad in every year and whatever You create in it and whatever dies in it; and bless our master Muhammad in all You create each day and whatever dies in it, until the Day of Resurrection.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ السَّحَابِ الجَارِيَةِ مَا بَيْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمَا تَمْطُرُ مِنَ المِيَاهِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الرِّيَاحِ المُسَخَّرَاتِ فِي مَشَارِقِ الأَرْضِ وَمَغَارِبِهَا، وَجَوْفِهَا وَقِبْلَتِهَا، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي بِحَارِكَ مِنَ الحِيتَانِ وَالدَّوَابِّ وَالمِيَاهِ وَالرِّمَالِ وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النَّبَاتِ وَالحَصَى، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ النَّمْلِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ المِيَاهِ العَذْبَةِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ المِيَاهِ المِلْحَةِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نِعْمَتِكَ عَلَى جَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ نِقْمَتِكَ وَعَذَابِكَ عَلَى مَنْ كَفَرَ بِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا دَامَتِ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةُ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا دَامَتِ الخَلَائِقُ فِي الجَنَّةِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا دَامَتِ الخَلَائِقُ فِي النَّارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا تُحِبُّهُ وَتَرْضَاهُ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى قَدْرِ مَا يُحِبُّكَ وَيَرْضَاكَ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَبَدَ الآبِدِينَ، وَأَنْزِلْهُ المُنْزَلَ المُقَرَّبَ عِنْدَكَ، وَأَعْطِهِ الوَسِيلَةَ وَالفَضِيلَةَ، وَالشَّفَاعَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَالمَقَامَ المَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ المِيعَادَ.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all the clouds that pass, that are between heaven and earth, and that rain down water; and bless our master Muhammad in all the breezes that blow in the Eastern and in the inland part and the parts nearest us; and bless our master Muhammad in all the stars of heaven, and bless our master Muhammad in all Thou hast created in Thy seas of whales and monsters, and the waters too, and sandy plains, and whatever else there is besides this; and bless our master Muhammad in all plants, and in all stony places; and bless our master Muhammad in all ants; and bless our master Muhammad in all fresh waters; and bless our master Muhammad in all salt waters; and bless our master Muhammad in all Thy Grace towards the whole of Thy creation; and bless our master Muhammad in all Thy vengeance and severity towards any one who does not believe in our master Muhammad, the blessings and peace of Allah be on him; and bless our master Muhammad as long as the earth continues and onward still; and bless our master Muhammad as long as all created beings continue in Paradise; and bless our master Muhammad as long as any created beings continue in the Fire; and bless our master Muhammad in all the power wherewith Thou canst Love him and Favour him; and bless our master Muhammad in all the power in which he can love Thee and favour Thee; and bless our master Muhammad to all eternity, and seat him in the Place of honour at Thy side, and give him privilege and favour, and the privilege of intercession, and an exalted rank, and bestow on him the illustrious Place which Thou hast ordained for him; for Thou dost not change whatever is ordained.
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad in all the passing clouds between heaven and earth that rain down water; bless our master Muhammad in all the breezes that blow in the east, inland, and the parts nearest us; bless our master Muhammad in all the stars of heaven; bless our master Muhammad in all You created in Your seas — whales, monsters, waters, and sandy plains, and whatever else besides; bless our master Muhammad in all plants and all stony places; bless our master Muhammad in all ants; bless our master Muhammad in all fresh waters; bless our master Muhammad in all salt waters; bless our master Muhammad in all Your grace toward Your whole creation; bless our master Muhammad in all Your punishment and severity toward whoever does not believe in our master Muhammad — Allah bless him and grant him peace; bless our master Muhammad as long as the earth endures and longer still; bless our master Muhammad as long as any created beings abide in Paradise; bless our master Muhammad as long as any created beings abide in the Fire; bless our master Muhammad to the full power of Your love and favour for him; bless our master Muhammad to the full power of his love and devotion to You; bless our master Muhammad for all eternity, seat him in the station of honour at Your side, grant him privilege, favour, the power of intercession, and exalted rank, and bestow on him the Praised Station You ordained for him — for You never break what You have decreed.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّكَ مَالِكِي، وَسَيِّدِي، وَمَوْلَايَ، وَثِقَتِي، وَرَجَائِي، أَسْأَلُكَ بِحُرْمَةِ الشَّهْرِ الحَرَامِ، وَالبَلَدِ الحَرَامِ، وَالمَشْعَرِ الحَرَامِ، وَقَبْرِ نَبِيِّكَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، أَنْ تَهَبَ لِي مِنَ الخَيْرِ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَتَصْرِفَ عَنِّي مِنَ السُّوءِ مَا لَا يَعْلَمُ عِلْمَهُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
units.en: O Allah, I beseech Thee, for that Thou art my king and my Master, and my Patron, and my Confidence, and my Hope; I beseech Thee by the sanctity of the Sacred Month [Moharram] and the Sacred City [of Mecca] and the Sacred Precincts, and the Grave of Thy Prophet, on him be blessing and peace: that Thou wouldest hasten for me whatever good may be, the knowledge of which none has but Thou, and that Thou wouldest divert from me the evil, the knowledge of which none has but Thou.
units.en2: O Allah, I beseech You — for You are my King, my Master, my Patron, my confidence, and my hope — by the sanctity of the Sacred Month [Muḥarram], the Sacred City [Mecca], the Sacred Precincts, and the grave of Your prophet, blessings and peace be upon him: hasten to me whatever good there is, which none but You knows, and turn from me every evil, which none but You knows.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِسَيِّدِنَا آدَمَ سَيِّدَنَا شِيثَ، وَلِسَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ سَيِّدَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَسَيِّدَنَا إِسْحَاقَ، وَرَدَّ سَيِّدَنَا يُوسُفَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا يَعْقُوبَ، وَيَا مَنْ كَشَفَ البَلَاءَ عَنْ سَيِّدِنَا أَيُّوبَ، وَيَا مَنْ رَدَّ سَيِّدَنَا مُوسَى إِلَى أُمِّهِ، وَيَا زَائِدَ سَيِّدِنَا الخَضِرِ فِي عِلْمِهِ، وَيَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِسَيِّدِنَا دَاوُودَ سَيِّدَنَا سُلَيْمَانَ، وَلِسَيِّدِنَا زَكَرِيَّا سَيِّدَنَا يَحْيَى، وَلِسَيِّدَتِنَا مَرْيَمَ سَيِّدَنَا عِيسَى، وَيَا حَافِظَ ابْنَةِ سَيِّدِنَا شُعَيْبٍ، أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى جَمِيعِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ، وَيَا مَنْ وَهَبَ لِسَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، الشَّفَاعَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي، وَتَسْتُرَ لِي عُيُوبِي كُلَّهَا، وَتُجِيرَنِي مِنَ النَّارِ، وَتُوجِبَ لِي رِضْوَانَكَ وَأَمَانَكَ، وَغُفْرَانَكَ وَإِحْسَانَكَ، وَتُمَتِّعَنِي فِي جَنَّتِكَ مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ، إِنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ مَا أَزْعَجَتِ الرِّيَاحُ سَحَابًا رُكَامًا، وَذَاقَ كُلُّ ذِي رُوحٍ حِمَامًا، وَأَوْصِلِ السَّلَامَ لِأَهْلِ السَّلَامِ، فِي دَارِ السَّلَامِ تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَامًا.
units.en:
O Allah, yes, by Him who bestowed our master Seth on our master Adam, and our master Ismail and our master Isaac on our master Abraham, and restored our master Joseph to our master Jacob; yes, by Him who relieved our master Job of trouble; yes, by Him Who restored our master Moses to his mother; yes, by Him Who increases our master EL Khudr in his knowledge: yes, by Him who gave our master Solomon to David, and our master John to our master Zachariah, and our master Jesus to lady Mary.

Yes, Thou Who wast Protector of the daughter of our master Hobab, I beseech Thee that Thou wilt bless our master Muhammad and all Prophets, and all who have genuine mission.

Yes, by Him Who granted to our master Muhammad, the blessing and peace of Allah be upon him, the power of intercession and exalted rank: yes, I ask Thee that Thou wilt forgive me my faults, and hide for me all my defects, and wilt protect me from the Fire, and wilt bestow on me Thy Favour and Thy Trust and Thy Forgiveness, and Thy Benevolence, and that Thou wilt permit me in Thy Paradise to be with those whom Thou favourest, be they Prophets or Upright men, or Men of Truth and Character, for Thou art all Powerful in everything.

O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his Family in all the breezes that generate thick clouds and everything possessed of a soul has tasted death and send abundant peace and salutation on the Men of Peace in the Abode of Peace.
units.en2: O Allah — yes, by Him who bestowed our master Seth on our master Adam, our master Ishmael and our master Isaac on our master Abraham, and restored our master Joseph to our master Jacob; yes, by Him who relieved our master Job of his trouble; yes, by Him who restored our master Moses to his mother; yes, by Him who increased our master al-Khaḍir in knowledge; yes, by Him who gave our master Solomon to David, our master John to our master Zachariah, and our master Jesus to our lady Mary; yes, You who protected the daughter of our master Hobab — I beseech You to bless our master Muhammad and all the prophets and all true messengers. Yes, by Him who granted our master Muhammad — Allah bless him and grant him peace — the power of intercession and exalted rank: yes, I ask You to forgive my faults, conceal all my defects, protect me from the Fire, bestow on me Your favour, Your trust, Your forgiveness, and Your benevolence, and admit me in Your Paradise among those You favour — prophets, upright men, and men of truth and character — for You are powerful over all things. O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his family in all the breezes that raise thick clouds, until everything with a soul has tasted death, and send abundant peace and greeting upon the people of peace in the Abode of Peace.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَفْرِدْنِي لِمَا خَلَقْتَنِي لَهُ، وَلَا تَشْغَلْنِي بِمَا تَكَفَّلْتَ لِي بِهِ، وَلَا تَحْرِمْنِي وَأَنَا أَسْأَلُكَ، وَلَا تُعَذِّبْنِي وَأَنَا أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ (3)
units.en: O Allah, separate me for that for which Thou hast created me, and do not weary me in that for which Thou hast brought me up, and do not refuse me when I ask Thee, and do not forsake me when I seek Thy pardon. [Repeat Three times]
units.en2: O Allah, set me apart for what You created me for; do not weary me with what You raised me for; do not refuse me when I ask You; and do not forsake me when I seek Your pardon. (Three times)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَسَلِّمْ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his Family and give him peace;
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his family, and grant him peace;

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ وَأَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِحَبِيبِكَ المُصْطَفَى عِنْدَكَ، يَا حَبِيبَنَا يَا سَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنَّا نَتَوَسَّلُ بِكَ إِلَى رَبِّكَ، فَاشْفَعْ لَنَا عِنْدَ المَوْلَى العَظِيمِ، يَا نِعْمَ الرَّسُولُ الطَّاهِرُ، اللَّهُمَّ شَفِّعْهُ فِينَا بِجَاهِهِ عِنْدَكَ (3)
units.en:
for I beseech Thee and turn myself to Thee by Thy Beloved one, Thine own elect, aye, our Beloved the chosen one, aye, our master Muhammad; seeing we betake ourselves for thy sake to Thy Lord, and intercede with that Mighty Patron; yea, thou excellent, yea verily, thou pure Envoy.

O Allah, accept his intercession for us, when he comes before Thee [Repeat Thrice], O Allah;
units.en2: for I beseech You and turn to You through Your beloved, Your elect — our beloved, the chosen one, our master Muhammad; for his sake we turn to You, his Lord, and intercede through that mighty patron — yes, you excellent one, yes indeed, you pure messenger. O Allah, accept his intercession for us when he comes before You. (Three times) O Allah,

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنَا مِنْ خَيْرِ المُصَلِّينَ وَالمُسَلِّمِينَ عَلَيْهِ، وَمِنْ خَيْرِ المُقَرَّبِينَ مِنْهُ وَالوَارِدِينَ عَلَيْهِ، وَمِنْ أَخْيَارِ المُحِبِّينَ فِيهِ وَالمَحْبُوبِينَ لَدَيْهِ، وَفَرِّحْنَا بِهِ فِي عَرَصَاتِ القِيَامَةِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ لَنَا دَلِيلًا إِلَى جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ، بِلَا مَؤُونَةٍ وَلَا مَشَقَّةٍ وَلَا مُنَاقَشَةِ الحِسَابِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ مُقْبِلًا عَلَيْنَا، وَلَا تَجْعَلْهُ غَاضِبًا عَلَيْنَا، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلِوَالِدِينَا وَلِجَمِيعِ المُسْلِمِينَ، الأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالمَيِّتِينَ، وَآخِرُ دَعْوَانَا أَنِ الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en: and make us to be of the best of those who make their prayers, and surrender themselves to him, and of the best of those who have the privilege of access to him, and present themselves to him, and of those who are the best of those who have love for him and are beloved by him; and make us rejoice in him in the Courts of the Resurrection and make him our guide to the Garden of Pleasure, without expense, without trouble, without much scrutiny in reckoning; and make him friendly towards us, and do not make him hostile to us; and forgive ourselves and our parents, and all Muslims, men and women alike, those of them who are alive and those who are dead, and the faithful, men and women alike. And our final prayer is, Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.
units.en2: and make us among the best of those who pray to him and surrender to him, among the best of those granted nearness to him who present themselves to him, and among the best of those who love him and are loved by him; let us rejoice in him in the courts of the Resurrection; make him our guide to the Garden of Delight without expense, without trouble, and without much scrutiny in the reckoning; make him friendly toward us, not hostile; and forgive us, our parents, and all Muslims, men and women, living and dead, and the believers, men and women. And our final prayer is: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.

units.ar:
فَأَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ، يَا اللَّهُ، يَا اللَّهُ، يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ يَا ذَا الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ،
﴿
لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّـٰلِمِينَ
﴾.
أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا حَمَلَ كُرْسِيُّكَ مِنْ عَظَمَتِكَ، وَجَلَالِكَ وَبَهَائِكَ، وَقُدْرَتِكَ وَسُلْطَانِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ أَسْمَائِكَ المَخْزُونَةِ المَكْنُونَةِ المُطَهَّرَةِ الَّتِي لَمْ يَطَّلِعْ عَلَيْهَا أَحَدٌ مِّنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَبِحَقِّ الِاسْمِ الَّذِي وَضَعْتَهُ عَلَي اللَّيْلِ فَأَظْلَمَ، وَعَلَي النَّهَارِ فَاسْتَنَارَ، وَعَلَي السَّمَاوَاتِ فَاسْتَقَلَّتْ، وَعَلَي الأَرْضِ فَاسْتَقَرَّتْ، وَعَلَي البِحَارِ فَانْفَجَرَتْ، وَعَلَي العُيُونِ فَنَبَعَتْ، وَعَلَي السَّحَابِ فَأَمْطَرَتْ.
وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالأَسْمَاءِ المَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ المَكْتُوبَةِ فِي جَبْهَةِ سَيِّدِنَا إِسْرَافِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَعَلَي جَمِيعِ المَلَائِكَةِ.
وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالأَسْمَاءِ المَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ العَرْشِ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ المَكْتُوبَةِ حَوْلَ الكُرْسِي.
وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيمِ الأَعْظَمِ الَّذِي سَمَّيْتَ بِهِ نَفْسَكَ.
وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ أَسْمَائِكَ كُلِّهَا مَا عَلِمْتُ مِنْهَا وَمَا لَمْ أَعْلَمْ.
وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا آدَمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا نُوحٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا صَالِحٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يُونُسُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا مُوسَي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا هَارُونُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا شُعَيْبٌ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا دَاوُودُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا سُلَيْمَانُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا زَكَرِيَّا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا يُوشَعُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا الخَضِرُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا إِلْيَاسُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا الْيَسَعُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا ذُو الكِفْلِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا عِيسَي عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ.
وَبِالأَسْمَاءِ الَّتِي دَعَاكَ بِهَا سَيِّدُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّي اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيُّكَ وَرَسُولُكَ وَحَبِيبُكَ وَصَفِيُّكَ، يَا مَنْ قَالَ وَقَوْلُهُ الحَقُّ: ﴿
وَاللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
﴾، وَلَا يَصْدُرُ عَنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْ عَبِيدِهِ قَوْلٌ وَلَا فِعْلٌ وَلَا حَرَكَةٌ وَلَا سُكُونٌ، إِلَّا وَقَدْ سَبَقَ فِي عِلْمِهِ وَقَضَائِهِ وَقَدَرِهِ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ، كَمَا أَلْهَمْتَنِي وَقَضَيْتَ لِي بِجَمْعِ هَذَا الكِتَابِ، وَيَسَّرْتَ عَلَيَّ فِيهِ الطَّرِيقَ وَالأَسْبَابَ، وَنَفَيْتَ عَنْ قَلْبِي فِي هَذَا النَّبِيِّ الكَرِيمِ الشَّكَّ وَالارْتِيَابَ، وَغَلَّبْتَ حُبَّهُ عِنْدِي عَلَي حُبِّ جَمِيعِ الأَقْرِبَاءِ وَالأَحِبَّاءِ.
أَسْأَلُكَ يَا اللَّهُ، يَا اللَّهُ، يَا اللَّهُ، أَنْ تَرْزُقَنِي وَكُلَّ مَنْ أَحَبَّهُ وَاتَّبَعَهُ، شَفَاعَتَهُ وَمُرَافَقَتَهُ يَوْمَ الحِسَابِ، مِنْ غَيْرِ مُنَاقَشَةٍ وَلَا عَذَابٍ، وَلَا تَوْبِيخٍ وَلَا عِتَابٍ، وَأَنْ تَغْفِرَ لِي ذُنُوبِي، وَتَسْتُرَ عُيُوبِي يَا وَهَّابُ يَا غَفَّارُ، وَأَنْ تُنَعِّمَنِي بِالنَّظَرِ إِلَى وَجْهِكَ الكَرِيمِ فِي جُمْلَةِ الأَحْبَابِ، يَوْمَ المَزِيدِ وَالثَّوَابِ، وَأَنْ تَتَقَبَّلَ مِنِّي عَمَلِي، وَأَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَمَّا أَحَاطَ عِلْمُكَ بِهِ مِنْ خَطِيئَتِي وَنِسْيَانِي وَزَلَلِي، وَأَنْ تُبَلِّغَنِي مِنْ زِيَارَةِ قَبْرِهِ وَالتَّسْلِيمِ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَي صَاحِبَيْهِ غَايَةَ أَمَلِي بِمَنِّكَ وَفَضْلِكَ وَجُودِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ، يَا رَؤُوفُ يَا رَحِيمُ يَا وَلِيُّ، وَأَنْ تُجَازِيَهُ عَنِّي وَعَنْ كُلِّ مَنْ آمَنَ بِهِ وَاتَّبَعَهُ، مِنَ المُسْلِمِينَ وَالمُسْلِمَاتِ، الأَحْيَاءِ مِنْهُمْ وَالأَمْوَاتِ، أَفْضَلَ وَأَتَمَّ وَأَعَمَّ مَا جَازَيْتَ بِهِ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، يَا قَوِيُّ يَا عَزِيزُ يَا عَلِيُّ.
units.en:
And I beseech Thee, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, yea Thou Living One, yea Thou Unchangeable; Thou Lord of Majesty and Honour, there is no Allah but Thou.
