Praise be to Thee; as I am one of the sinners, I beseech Thee by the canopy of Thy Throne, by Thy Greatness and Thy Majesty and Thy Glory, and Thy Power, and Thy Authority, and by the Truth of Thy Names, so valued, so treasured, so pure, to which no one of Thy creation can attain; and by the truth of the Name that Thou hast assigned for the night so that darkness comes on, and for the day so that the light approaches; and for the heavens, that they rise aloft; and for the earth, that it stands firm; and for the rivers, that they flow; and the fountains, that they gush forth; and the clouds, that they drop rain; and I beseech Thee by the name that are written on the forehead of Gabriel, on him be peace; and by the Names that are written on the forehead of Asraphel, on him be peace, and on all the angels.

And I beseech Thee by the Names that are written around the Throne and by the Names that are written around the Chair, and I beseech Thee by Thy Mighty, Most Mighty Name, wherewith Thou hast Named Thyself; and I beseech Thee by the truth of all Thy Names, those of them that I have learned, and those I do not know.

And I beseech Thee by the Names wherewith our master Adam invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the names wherewith our master Noah invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the Names wherewith Our master Saleh invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names wherewith our master Jacob invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names wherewith our master Joseph invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names wherewith our master Jonah invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names wherewith our master Moses invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names wherewith our master Aaron invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names wherewith Our master Hobab invoked Thee, on him be peace And by the Names wherewith our master Abraham invoked Thee, on him be peace And by the Names wherewith our master Ishmael invoked Thee, on him be peace And by the Names wherewith our master David invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names wherewith our master Solomon invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names whereby our master Zachariah invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names whereby our master Yahya invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names whereby our master Joshua invoked Thee, on him be peace And by the Names whereby our master El Khudr invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names whereby our master Elias invoked Thee, on him be peace. And by the Names whereby our master Elisha invoked Thee on him be peace, And by the Names whereby our master Dhoulkephil invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the Names whereby our master Jesus invoked Thee, on him be peace.

And by the Names whereby our master Muhammad invoked Thee, Allah bless him and give him peace; Thy prophet, Thy Envoy, Thy Beloved one, Thy Chosen; yea, he it was who said, and his word is truth: “Yea, Allah hath created you, and what ye do, surely there shall not issue from any of His Servants, either voice, or verb, or vowel, or stop, but that it most surely is already preordained in His knowledge, and His Judgement, and His Power.” How shall it be as Thou hast inspired me, and hast ordained for me to compile/edit / read this book; and hast made the way and means therein easy for me; and hast banished from my heart doubt or suspicion of this noble Prophet so that the love of him prevails in me above the love of all my relations and my friends.

I beseech Thee, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, that Thou wilt grant to me and to every one who loves him and follows him, his prayers and indulgencies in the Day of Reckoning, without strictness or penalty, reprimand or anger, and that Thou wilt forgive my sins, and hide my faults.

Yea, Thou Benevolent, yea Thou Merciful One: and that Thou wilt favour me when we look upon Thy Noble Countenance, in the assembly of friends in the Day of Honour and Reward; and that Thou wilt accept of my work, and wilt annul whatever Thy knowledge embraces of my errors and omissions and mistakes; and that Thou wilt grant me visit to his Tomb; and peace be upon him and his Companions; to the utmost goal of my hope from Thy Goodness and Thy Grace, Thy Generosity and Thy Honour; yea, Thou indulgent one, yea Thou Merciful one, yea, Thou Friend; and that Thou wilt grant him a reward for my sake and for every one who believes in him, and follows him among Muslims, be they men or women, those of them who are alive and those who are gone; a reward as gracious and perfect and complete as Thou hast ever granted for his sake to any one of Thy creation;

O Thou Powerful one, O Thou Mighty, O Thou Exalted;
units.en2: And I beseech You, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah — O Living One, O Ever-Standing, Lord of majesty and honour, there is no god but You. Praise be to You; I am one of the sinners. I beseech You by the canopy of Your Throne, by Your greatness, majesty, glory, power, and authority, and by the truth of Your names — so valued, so treasured, so pure, which none of Your creation can attain; and by the truth of the name You assigned to the night so darkness falls, to the day so light approaches, to the heavens so they rise aloft, to the earth so it stands firm, to the rivers so they flow, to the springs so they gush forth, and to the clouds so they drop rain. And I beseech You by the names written on the forehead of Gabriel, peace be upon him, and by the names written on the forehead of Isrāfīl, peace be upon him, and on all the angels. And I beseech You by the names written around the Throne and the names written around the Footstool, and I beseech You by Your mighty, most mighty name by which You named Yourself, and by the truth of all Your names, those I have learned and those I do not know. And I beseech You by the names by which our master Adam called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Noah called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Ṣāliḥ called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Jacob called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Joseph called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Jonah called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Moses called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Aaron called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Hobab called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Abraham called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Ishmael called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master David called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Solomon called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Zachariah called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Yaḥyā called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Joshua called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master al-Khaḍir called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Elijah called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Elisha called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Dhū'l-Kifl called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Jesus called upon You, peace be upon him; and by the names by which our master Muhammad called upon You — Allah bless him and grant him peace — Your prophet, Your messenger, Your beloved, Your chosen. He it is who said, and his word is truth: "Allah has created you and what you do; no word, verb, vowel, or consonant issues from any of His servants without being already foreordained in His knowledge, His judgement, and His power." How it stands with me: as You inspired me and ordained for me to compile this book, made the way and means in it easy for me, and banished from my heart all doubt and suspicion of this noble Prophet, so that love of him prevails in me over love of all my relations and friends. I beseech You, O Allah, O Allah, O Allah, to grant me and everyone who loves him and follows him his prayers and his indulgence on the Day of Reckoning, without strictness, penalty, reprimand, or anger; to forgive my sins and hide my faults — O Benevolent, O Merciful; to favour me when we look upon Your noble countenance in the assembly of friends on the Day of Honour and Reward; to accept my work and annul whatever Your knowledge encompasses of my errors, omissions, and mistakes; to grant me a visit to his tomb — peace be upon him and his Companions — to the utmost goal of my hope, from Your goodness, grace, generosity, and honour, O Indulgent, O Merciful, O Friend; and to grant him, on my behalf and on behalf of everyone who believes in him and follows him among Muslims, men and women, living and gone, a reward as gracious, perfect, and complete as You ever granted on his behalf to any of Your creation — O Powerful, O Mighty, O Exalted.

units.ar: وَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِحَقِّ مَا أَقْسَمْتُ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ، أَن تُصَلِّي عَلَي سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَي آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَكُونَ السَّمَاءُ مَبْنِيَّةً، وَالأَرْضُ مَدْحِيَّةً، وَالجِبَالُ عُلْوِيَّةً، وَالعُيُونُ مُنْفَجِرَةً، وَالبِحَارُ مُسَخَّرَةً، وَالأَنْهَارُ مُنْهَمِرَةً، وَالشَّمْسُ مُضْحِيَّةً، وَالقَمَرُ مُضِيئًا، وَالنَّجْمُ مُنِيرًا، وَلَا يَعْلَمُ أَحَدٌ حَيْثُ تَكُونُ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَي آلِهِ عَدَدَ كَلَامِكَ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَي آلِهِ عَدَدَ آيَاتِ القُرْآنِ وَحُرُوفِهِ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَي آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَنْ يُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَي آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَنْ لَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَي آلِهِ مِلْءَ أَرْضِكَ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَي آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا جَرَي بِهِ القَلَمُ فِي أُمِّ الكِتَابِ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَي آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا خَلَقْتَ فِي سَبْعِ سَمَاوَاتِكَ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَي آلِهِ عَدَدَ مَا أَنْتَ خَالِقُهُ فِيهِنَّ إلَى يَوْمِ القِيامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ، وَأَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَي آلِهِ عَدَدَ قَطْرِ المَطَرِ، وَكُلِّ قَطْرَةٍ قَطَرَتْ مِنْ سَمَائِكَ إِلَي أَرْضِكَ، مِنْ يَوْمِ خَلَقْتَ الدُّنْيَا إِلَي يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ مَرَّةٍ.
units.en:
yea, I entreat Thee, O Allah, by the Truth onward Thou hast sworn for Thyself, that Thou wilt bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all that Thou hast created, even before the heavens were formed, or the plains of the earth opened out, or the mountains ranged aloft, or the fountains streamed, or the seas were favourable, or the rivers in full stream, or the sun clear and the moon brilliant, or the stars gave their light;

When no one knows but Thou when it may have been; and that Thou wilt bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all Thy Word: and that Thou wilt bless him and his Family in all the verses of the Quran, and its letters; and that Thou wilt bless him and his Family in every one who blesses him; and that Thou wilt bless him and his Family in the fullness of Thy earth; and that Thou wilt bless him and his Family in every one who does not bless him; and that Thou wilt bless him and his Family in all that the Pen describes in the volume of the Book; and that Thou wilt bless him and his Family in all that Thou hast created in Thy Seven Heavens; and that Thou will bless him and his Family in all that Thou createst in them till the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times; and that Thou wilt bless him and his Family in all the drops of rain, and in every drop that Thou dost shed from Thy Heavens on the earth, from the day that Thou didst create the world, to the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times:
units.en2: yes, I entreat You, O Allah, by the truth You swore upon Yourself, to bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all You created, even before the heavens were formed, the plains of the earth opened out, the mountains rose aloft, the springs streamed, the seas ran favourable, the rivers flowed full, the sun shone clear, the moon gleamed, or the stars gave their light — when no one knows when it was but You; and to bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all Your words; to bless him and his family in every verse and letter of the Qur'an; to bless him and his family in everyone who blesses him; to bless him and his family to the fullness of Your earth; to bless him and his family in everyone who does not bless him; to bless him and his family in all the Pen describes in the volume of the Book; to bless him and his family in all You created in Your seven heavens; to bless him and his family in all You create in them until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times; and to bless him and his family in all the drops of rain — every drop You shed from Your heavens upon the earth — from the day You created the world until the Day of Resurrection, every day a thousand times:

sections.note: English: historical translation by Rev. John B. Pearson (Guide to Happiness, Oxford, 1907), in the public domain.

sections.heading: Sunday — Ḥizb 7 (حِزْبُ يَوْمِ الأَحَد)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَا سَجَعَتِ الحَمَائِمُ، وَحَمَتِ الحَوَائِمُ، وَسَرَحَتِ البَهَائِمُ، وَنَفَعَتِ التَّمَائِمُ، وَشُدَّتِ العَمَائِمُ، وَنَمَتِ النَّوَائِمُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in the cry of the pigeons, in the flight of birds, in the tread of cattle to their pasture, and in the wearing of amulets, in the winding of turbans, and in the sprouting and growth from earth.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in the cooing of pigeons, the flight of birds, the tread of cattle to their pasture, the wearing of amulets, the winding of turbans, and the sprouting growth of the earth.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَا أَبْلَجَ الإِصْبَاحُ، وَهَبَّتِ الرِّيَاحُ، وَدَبَّتِ الأَشْبَاحُ، وَتَعَاقَبَ الغُدُوُّ وَالرَّوَاحُ، وَتُقُلِّدَتِ الصِّفَاحُ، وَاعْتُقِلَتِ الرِّمَاحُ، وَصَحَّتِ الأَجْسَادُ وَالأَرْوَاحُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in the brightness of dawn, and in the murmur of the winds, and in the tramp of cattle, and in the succession of the mornings and the breezes; and in the wearing of swords, and the brandish of lances, and in the health of every soul and spirit.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in the brightness of dawn, the murmur of the winds, the tramp of cattle, the succession of mornings and breezes, the wearing of swords, the brandishing of lances, and the health of every soul and spirit.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَا دَارَتِ الأَفْلَاكُ، وَدَجَتِ الأَحْلَاكُ، وَسَبَّحَتِ الأَمْلَاكُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in the rotation of the celestial bodies, in the overshadowing of darkness, and in the glorifying of angels.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in the turning of the celestial spheres, the overshadowing of darkness, and the glorifying of the angels.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي العَالَمِينَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad as Thou didst bless our master Abraham, and favour our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in the Worlds, as Thou art Honoured and Glorious.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as You blessed our master Abraham, and favour our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad throughout the worlds — for You are Honoured and Glorious.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَا طَلَعَتِ الشَّمْسُ، وَمَا صُلِّيَتِ الخَمْسُ، وَمَا تَأَلَّقَ بَرْقٌ، وَتَدَفَّقَ وَدْقٌ، وَمَا سَبَّحَ رَعْدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad wherever the sun rises, and in the performance of five obligatory prayers; and where the lightning flashes, and the rain descends, and thunder echoes.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad wherever the sun rises and wherever the five obligatory prayers are performed; wherever lightning flashes, rain descends, and thunder echoes.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مِلْءَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ وَمِلْءَ مَا بَيْنَهُمَا، وَمِلْءَ مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ شَيْءٍ بَعْدُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in the fullness of the Heavens and the Earth, and in the fullness of all that is between the two, and whatever Thou willest to exist beyond.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad to the fullness of the heavens and the earth, to the fullness of all between them, and to whatever else You will to exist.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا قَامَ بِأَعْبَاءِ الرِّسَالَةِ، وَاسْتَنْقَذَ الخَلْقَ مِنَ الجَهَالَةِ، وَجَاهَدَ أَهْلَ الكُفْرِ وَالضَّلَالَةِ، وَدَعَا إِلَى تَوْحِيدِكَ، وَقَاسَى الشَّدَائِدَ فِي إِرْشَادِ عَبِيدِكَ، فَأَعْطِهِ اللَّهُمَّ سُوْلَهُ، وَبَلِّغْهُ مَأْمُولَهُ، وَآتِهِ الفَضِيلَةَ وَالوَسِيلَةَ وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ المَقَامَ المَحْمُودَ الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ، إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ المِيعَادَ.
units.en: O Allah, even as he advanced himself in the robe of Apostleship, and delivered creation from ignorance, and made war on the tribes given over to infidelity and error, and addressed his prayers to Thy Unity, and endured hardships in the guidance of Thy servants, so grant him, O Allah, his request, and let him acquire whatever he aspires for. and let him have influence and grace and an exalted rank, and raise him to the Honourable Place that Thou hast promised him, for Thou dost not change whatever is ordained.
units.en2: O Allah, as he rose in the robe of apostleship, delivered creation from ignorance, made war on the tribes given over to unbelief and error, prayed to Your oneness, and endured hardships in guiding Your servants — grant him, O Allah, his request; let him attain whatever he aspires to; give him intercession, grace, and exalted rank; and raise him to the Praised Station You promised him — for You never break what You have decreed.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ المُتَّبِعِينَ لِشَرِيعَتِهِ، وَالمُتَّصِفِينَ بِمَحَبَّتِهِ، المُهْتَدِينَ بِهَدْيِهِ وَسِيرَتِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى سُنَّتِهِ، وَلا تَحْرِمْنَا فَضْلَ شَفَاعَتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي أَتْبَاعِهِ الغُرِّ المُحَجَّلِينَ، وَأَشْيَاعِهِ السَّابِقِينَ، وَأَصْحَابِ اليَمِينِ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ.
units.en: And, O Allah, make us to be of those who follow his law, those who unite themselves to his love, and allow themselves to be under his guidance, and his form of life; and attach us to his law; and do not refuse us the favour of his intercession, and include us among his followers, those shining with light, with his foremost companions, and his comrades on the right hand; O Thou the Compassionate, the Merciful.
units.en2: And, O Allah, make us among those who follow his law, who bind themselves to his love, who place themselves under his guidance and his way of life; attach us to his law; do not refuse us the favour of his intercession; and count us among his followers shining with light, with his foremost companions and his comrades on the right hand — O Compassionate, O Merciful.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَالمُقَرَّبِينَ، وَعَلَى أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَالمُرْسَلِينَ، وَعَلَى أَهْلِ طَاعَتِكَ أَجْمَعِينَ، وَاجْعَلْنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ المَرْحُومِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless the angels, and those who have access to Thy Presence, and Thy Prophets, and those who are sent forth, and the nations of Thy obedience each and all, and make us to share in the blessing on them, among those who share Thy Mercy.
units.en2: O Allah, bless the angels, those brought near to Your presence, Your prophets, and Your sent messengers, and all the hosts of Your obedience, every one; and let us share in the blessing upon them, among those who share Your mercy.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ المَبْعُوثِ مِنْ تِهَامَةَ، وَالآمِرِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالاسْتِقَامَةِ، وَالشَّفِيعِ لِأَهْلِ الذُّنُوبِ فِي عَرَصَاتِ القِيَامَةِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad who was recalled from Tehama to an honourable employment, and upright life and intercession for the sinful people in the Courts of the Resurrection:
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, who was called forth from Tihāma to an honoured task, an upright life, and intercession for sinful people in the courts of the Resurrection:

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَبْلِغْ عَنَّا نَبِيَّنَا وَشَفِيعَنَا وَحَبِيبَنَا أَفْضَلَ الصَّلَاةِ وَالتَّسْلِيمِ، وَابْعَثْهُ المَقَامَ المَحْمُودَ الكَرِيمَ، وَآتِهِ الفَضِيلَةَ وَالوَسِيلَةَ، وَالدَّرَجَةَ الرَّفِيعَةَ الَّتِي وَعَدْتَهُ فِي المَوْقِفِ العَظِيمِ، وَصَلِّ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيهِ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً مُتَّصِلَةً تَتَوَالَى وَتَدُومُ.
units.en:
O Allah, grant for our sakes to our Prophet, our Intercessor, our Beloved one favour and blessing and perfect peace, and recall him to his honourable and distinguished place, and give him favour, and influence, and exalted rank which Thou hast ordained for him in the awful Place of Judgement;

And give him, O Allah, a blessing continual, effective, that will continue always and for ever.
units.en2: O Allah, grant on our behalf to our Prophet, our intercessor, our beloved, favour, blessing, and perfect peace; restore him to his honoured and distinguished station; and give him the favour, intercession, and exalted rank You ordained for him in the awesome place of judgement; and give him, O Allah, a continual, effective blessing that continues always and forever.

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ مَا لَاحَ بَارِقٌ، وَذَرَّ شَارِقٌ، وَوَقَبَ غَاسِقٌ، وَانْهَمَرَ وَادِقٌ.
وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ مِلْءَ اللُّوحِ وَالفَضَاءِ، وَمِثْلَ نُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ، وَعَدَدَ القَطْرِ وَالحَصَى، وَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ صَلَاةً لَا تُعَدُّ وَلَا تُحْصَى.
units.en: O Allah, bless him and his Family whenever the lightning flashes, or the rising sun spreads his light, or the evening darkens, or when the rains pour down: and bless him and his Family in the space of the sky and of the plains, and as it were the stars of heaven, and in every drop of rain and every stone; and bless him and his Family with a blessing that cannot be reckoned or numbered.
units.en2: O Allah, bless him and his family whenever lightning flashes, the rising sun spreads its light, the evening darkens, or the rains pour down; bless him and his family across the expanse of sky and plains, as many as the stars of heaven, in every drop of rain and every stone; and bless him and his family with a blessing beyond all reckoning and counting.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ زِنَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَبْلَغَ رِضَاكَ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِكَ، وَمُنْتَهَى رَحْمَتِكَ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him in the embellishment of Thy Throne and the extent of Thy Favour, and in the form of Thy Words and in the bounds of Thy Mercy.
units.en2: O Allah, bless him in the adornment of Your Throne, the extent of Your favour, the measure of Your words, and the bounds of Your mercy.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَزْوَاجِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ وَبَارَكْتَ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَّجِيدٌ، وَجَازِهِ عَنَّا أَفْضَلَ مَا جَازَيْتَ نَبِيًّا عَنْ أُمَّتِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنَا مِنَ المُهْتَدِينَ بِمِنْهَاجِ شَرِيعَتِهِ، وَاهْدِنَا بِهَدْيِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ، وَاحْشُرْنَا يَوْمَ الفَزَعِ الأَكْبَرِ مِنَ الآمِنِينَ فِي زُمْرَتِهِ، وَأَمِتْنَا عَلَى حُبِّهِ وَحُبِّ آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless him and his Family and his wives, and his offspring, and show favour to him and his Family and his wives in marriage, and his offspring, as Thou didst bless and favour our master Abraham and the Family of our master Abraham; for Thou art Honoured and Illustrious; and reward him for us with the most bounteous reward Thou hast given to the Prophets of his creed; and let us be of those who enjoy Thy Guidance in the path of his law, and guide us through his guidance, and receive us into his religion, and unite us in the Day of very Great Alarm with the faithful in his company; and devote us to his love and the love of his Family and his Comrades and his descendants.
units.en2: O Allah, bless him, his family, his wives, and his offspring; show favour to him, his family, his wives, and his offspring, as You blessed and favoured our master Abraham and the family of our master Abraham — for You are Honoured and Illustrious; reward him on our behalf with the most bounteous reward You ever gave a prophet on behalf of his people; let us be among those who enjoy Your guidance on the path of his law; guide us through his guidance; receive us into his religion; unite us on the Day of the Great Terror with the faithful in his company; and devote us to his love and the love of his family, his Companions, and his descendants.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ أَفْضَلِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ، وَأَكْرَمِ أَصْفِيَائِكَ، وَإِمَامِ أَوْلِيَائِكَ، وَخَاتَمِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ، وَحَبِيبِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، وَشَهِيدِ المُرْسَلِينَ، وَشَفِيعِ المُذْنِبِينَ، وَسَيِّدِ وَلَدِ آدَمَ أَجْمَعِينَ، المَرْفُوعِ الذِّكْرِ فِي المَلَائِكَةِ المُقَرَّبِينَ، البَشِيرِ النَّذِيرِ، السِّرَاجِ المُنِيرِ، الصَّادِقِ الأَمِينِ، الحَقِّ المُبِينِ، الرَّؤُوفِ الرَّحِيمِ، الهَادِي إِلَى الصِّرَاطِ المُسْتَقِيمِ، الَّذِي آتَيْتَهُ سَبْعًا مِنَ المَثَانِي وَالقُرْآنَ العَظِيمَ، نَبِيِّ الرَّحْمَةِ، وَهَادِي الأُمَّةِ، أَوَّلِ مَنْ تَنْشَقُّ عَنْهُ الأَرْضُ وَيَدْخُلُ الجَنَّةَ، المُؤَيَّدِ بِسَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ وَسَيِّدِنَا مِيكَائِيلَ، المُبَشَّرِ بِهِ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ وَالإِنْجِيلِ، المُصْطَفَى المُجْتَبَى، المُنْتَخَبِ أَبِي القَاسِمِ، سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ المُطَّلِبِ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ.
units.en:
O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the most favoured of Thy Prophets, and the noblest of Thy Elect and the Imam of Thy saints, and the Seal of Thy Prophets, and the one Beloved of the Lord of the Worlds, and witness of Messengers, and intercessor for sinners, and master of all the sons of Adam;

Honoured in remembrance among the angels who have the privilege of access; he the Evangelist, the Messenger of warning, the shining lamp, so sincere, so faithful; the truth; so explicit, so benevolent, so merciful, the guide towards the straight path; whom Thou hast gifted the Seven oft-repeated verses, even the Mighty Quran, Prophet of mercy and guide to religion, the First for whom Thou wilt open up the earth: that he enter Paradise; the one supported by Gabriel and Michael, blessing and peace be on both of them, he of whom there is tidings in the Law, and in the Gospel; the Elect one, Chosen and Preferred, the Father of Qasim, Muhammad, the son of Abdullah, the son of Abdul-Mutallib, the son of Hashim,
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad — the most favoured of Your prophets, the noblest of Your elect, the imam of Your saints, the Seal of Your prophets, the beloved of the Lord of the Worlds, the witness over the messengers, the intercessor for sinners, the master of all the children of Adam; honoured in remembrance among the angels brought near; he, the bearer of good news, the warner, the shining lamp, so sincere, so faithful, the truth, so clear, so benevolent, so merciful, the guide to the straight path; the one You gifted with the seven oft-repeated verses and the mighty Qur'an, the Prophet of mercy and the guide of religion, the first for whom the earth will open to enter Paradise, the one aided by Gabriel and Michael — blessings and peace upon them both — the one foretold in the Torah and the Gospel, the elect, chosen, and preferred, the father of al-Qāsim: Muhammad, son of ʿAbdullāh, son of ʿAbd al-Muṭṭalib, son of Hāshim.

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مَلَائِكَتِكَ وَالمُقَرَّبِينَ، الَّذِينَ
﴿
يُسَبِّحُونَ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
﴾
،
﴿
لَّا يَعْصُونَ اللَّهَ مَآ أَمَرَهُمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ
﴾.
units.en: O Allah, bless Thy angels, and those who have the privilege of access, who offer praises night and day without ceasing and without reluctance to Allah, as is their task, and they do as they are ordered.
units.en2: O Allah, bless Your angels brought near, who offer praise night and day to Allah without ceasing and without reluctance, as is their task — and they do as they are commanded.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ وَكَمَا اصْطَفَيْتَهُمْ سُفَرَاءَ إِلَى رُسُلِكَ، وَأُمَنَاءَ عَلَى وَحْيِكَ، وَشُهَدَاءَ عَلَى خَلْقِكَ، وَخَرَقْتَ لَهُمْ كُنُفَ حُجُبِكَ، وَأَطْلَعْتَهُمْ عَلَى مَكْنُونِ غَيْبِكَ، وَاخْتَرْتَ مِنْهُمْ خَزَنَةً لِجَنَّتِكَ، وَحَمَلَةً لِعَرْشِكَ، وَجَعَلْتَهُمْ مِنْ أَكْثَرِ جُنُودِكَ، وَفَضَّلْتَهُمْ عَلَى الوَرَى، وَأَسْكَنْتَهُمُ السَّمَاوَاتِ العُلَى، وَنَزَّهْتَهُمْ عَنِ المَعَاصِي وَالدَّنَاءَاتِ، وَقَدَّسْتَهُمْ عَنِ النَّقَائِصِ وَالآفَاتِ، فَصَلِّ عَلَيْهِمْ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً تَزِيدُهُمْ بِهَا فَضْلًا، وَتَجْعَلُنَا لِاسْتِغْفَارِهِمْ بِهَا أَهْلًا.
units.en: And, O Allah, even as Thou hast chosen them for interpreters to Thy Prophets, and Sureties for Thy Revelation, and Witnesses to Thy Creation, and hast opened for them the curtains of Thy Tabernacle, and hast revealed to them Thy Secret Realm and hast chosen from among them Guardians for Thy Paradise and Bearers for Thy Throne, and hast made them the Chief of Thy Hosts, and hast favoured them above the race of men, and hast made their dwelling place the highest Heaven, and hast kept them free from sins of disobedience and worldliness, and hast purified them from imperfections and defect; yes, bless them with an eternal blessing whereby Thou wilt enhance them in grace, and wilt help us thereby to entreat pardoning aid in the praise of the One only Allah.
units.en2: And, O Allah, as You chose them as interpreters to Your prophets, sureties for Your revelation, and witnesses over Your creation; opened for them the curtains of Your tabernacle; unveiled to them Your hidden realm; chose from among them guardians for Your Paradise and bearers for Your Throne; made them chiefs of Your hosts; favoured them above the race of men; made their dwelling the highest heaven; and kept them free from sins of disobedience and worldliness, purified from imperfection and defect — yes, bless them with an eternal blessing by which You increase them in grace and help us thereby to entreat pardoning aid in praising the One, the only Allah.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى جَمِيعِ أَنْبِيَائِكَ وَرُسُلِكَ الَّذِينَ شَرَحْتَ صُدُورَهُمْ، وَأَوْدَعْتَهُمْ حِكْمَتَكَ، وَطَوَّقْتَهُمْ نُبُوَّتَكَ، وَأَنْزَلْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ كُتُبَكَ، وَهَدَيْتَ بِهِمْ خَلْقَكَ، وَدَعَوا إِلَى تَوْحِيدِكَ، وَشَوَّقُوا إِلَى وَعْدِكَ، وَخَوَّفُوا مِنْ وَعِيدِكَ، وَأَرْشَدُوا إِلَى سَبِيلِكَ، وَقَامُوا بِحُجَّتِكَ وَدَلِيلِكَ، وَسَلِّمِ اللَّهُمَّ عَلَيْهِمْ تَسْلِيمًا، وَهَبْ لَنَا بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْرًا عَظِيمًا.
units.en: And, O Allah, bless all Thy Prophets and Messengers, whose hearts Thou hast enlightened, and entrusted them with Thy Wisdom, and qualified them for Thy Prophecy, and sent down to them Thy Book, and hast guided Thy Creation by their means, so that they have addressed their prayers to Thy Unity, and yearn for Thy Promise, and fear Thy Threats, and journey on Thy Road, and persevere in Thy Religion, and in Thy Guidance; and bestow on them, O Allah, perfect peace and on us bestow through prayer to them a great reward,
units.en2: And, O Allah, bless all Your prophets and messengers, whose hearts You enlightened, whom You entrusted with Your wisdom, qualified for Your prophecy, sent down Your Book to, and guided Your creation through — so that they prayed to Your oneness, yearned for Your promise, feared Your threats, journeyed on Your road, and persevered in Your religion and Your guidance; and bestow on them, O Allah, perfect peace, and bestow on us through prayer to them a great reward,

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً مَقْبُولَةً تُؤَدِّي بِهَا عَنَّا حَقَّهُ العَظِيمَ.
units.en: O Allah, grant to our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad a continuous and acceptable blessing, wherein for our sakes Thou wilt aid his mighty faith.
units.en2: O Allah, grant our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad a continuous, accepted blessing by which, on our behalf, You aid his mighty faith.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَاحِبِ الحُسْنِ وَالجَمَالِ، وَالبَهْجَةِ وَالكَمَالِ، وَالبَهَاءِ وَالنُّورِ، وَالوِلْدَانِ وَالحُورِ، وَالغُرَفِ وَالقُصُورِ، وَاللِّسَانِ الشَّكُورِ، وَالقَلْبِ المَشْكُورِ، وَالعَلَمِ المَشْهُورِ، وَالجَيْشِ المَنْصُورِ، وَالبَنِينَ وَالبَنَاتِ، وَالأَزْوَاجِ الطَّاهِرَاتِ، وَالعُلُوِّ عَلَى الدَّرَجَاتِ، وَالزَّمْزَمِ وَالمَقَامِ، وَالمَشْعَرِ الحَرَامِ، وَاجْتِنَابِ الآثَامِ، وَتَرْبِيَةِ الأَيْتَامِ، وَالحَجِّ وَتِلَاوَةِ القُرْآنِ، وَتَسْبِيحِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ، وَصِيَامِ رَمَضَانَ، وَاللِّوَاءِ المَعْقُودِ، وَالكَرَمِ وَالجُودِ، وَالوَفَاءِ بِالْعُهُودِ، صَاحِبِ الرَّغْبَةِ وَالتَّرغِيبِ، وَالبَغْلَةِ وَالنَّجِيبِ، وَالحَوْضِ وَالقَضِيبِ، النَّبِيِّ الأَوَّابِ، النَّاطِقِ بِالصَّوَابِ، المَنْعُوتِ فِي الكِتَابِ، النَّبِيِّ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، النَّبِيِّ كَنْزِ اللَّهِ، النَّبِيِّ حُجَّةِ اللَّهِ، النَّبِيِّ مَنْ أَطَاعَهُ فَقَدْ أَطَاعَ اللَّهَ وَمَنْ عَصَاهُ فَقَدْ عَصَى اللَّهَ، النَّبِيِّ العَرَبِيِّ، القُرَشِيِّ الزَّمْزَمِيِّ، المَكِّيِّ التِّهَامِيِّ، صَاحِبِ الوَجْهِ الجَمِيلِ، وَالطَّرْفِ الكَحِيلِ، وَالخَدِّ الأَسِيلِ، وَالكَوْثَرِ وَالسَّلْسَبِيلِ، قَاهِرِ المُضَادِّينَ، مُبِيدِ الكَافِرِينَ، وَقَاتِلِ المُشْرِكِينَ، قَائِدِ الغُرِّ المُحَجَّلِينَ، إِلَى جَنَّاتِ النَّعِيمِ، وَجِوَارِ الكَرِيمِ، صَاحِبِ سَيِّدِنَا جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَرَسُولِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ، وَشَفِيعِ المُذْنِبِينَ، وَغَايَةِ الغَمَامِ، وَمِصْبَاحِ الظَّلَامِ، وَقَمَرِ التَّمَامِ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ المُصْطَفَينَ مِنْ أَطْهَرِ جِبِلَّةٍ، صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً عَلَي الأَبَدِ غَيْرَ مُضْمَحِلَّةٍ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ صَلَاةً يَتَجَدَّدُ بِهَا حُبُورُهُ، وَيُشَرَّفُ بِهَا فِي المِيعَادِ بَعْثُهُ وَنُشُورُهُ، فَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ الأَنْجُمِ الطَّوَالِعِ، صَلَاةً تَجُودُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَجْوَدَ الغُيُوثِ الهَوَامِعِ، أَرْسَلَهُ مِنْ أَرْجَحِ العَرَبِ مِيزَانًا، وَأَوْضَحِهَا بَيَانًا، وَأَفْصَحِهَا لِسَانًا، وَأَشْمَخِهَا إِيمَانًا، وَأَعْلَاهَا مَقَامًا، وَأَحْلَاهَا كَلَامًا، وَأَوْفَاهَا ذِمَامًا، وَأَصْفَاهَا رَغَامًا، فَأَوْضَحَ الطَّرِيقَةَ، وَنَصَحَ الخَلِيقَةَ، وَشَهَرَ الإِسْلَامَ، وَكَسَرَ الأَصْنَامَ، وَأَظْهَرَ الأَحْكَامَ، وَحَظَرَ الحَرَامَ، وَعَمَّ بِالإِنْعَامِ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ فِي كُلِّ مَحْفِلٍ وَمَقَامٍ، أَفْضَلَ الصَّلَاةِ وَالسَّلَامِ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ عَوْدًا وَبَدْءًا، صَلَاةً تَكُونُ ذَخِيرَةً وَوِرْدًا، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ صَلَاةً تَامَّةً زَاكِيَةً، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ صَلَاةً يَتْبَعُهَا رَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ، وَيَعْقُبُهَا مَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِضْوَانٌ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى أَفْضَلِ مَنْ طَابَ مِنْهُ النِّجَارُ، وَسَمَا بِهِ الفَخَارُ، وَاسْتَنَارَتْ بِنُورِ جَبِينِهِ الأَقْمَارُ، وَتَضَاءَلَتْ عِنْدَ جُودِ يَمِينِهِ الغَمَائِمُ وَالبِحَارُ، سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي بِبَاهِرِ آيَاتِهِ أَضَاءَتِ الأَنْجَادُ وَالأَغْوَارُ، وَبِمُعْجِزَاتِ آيَاتِهِ نَطَقَ الكِتَابُ وَتَوَاتَرَتِ الأَخْبَارُ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَأَصْحَابِهِ الَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا لِنُصْرَتِهِ، وَنَصَرُوهُ فِي هِجْرَتِهِ، فَنِعْمَ المُهَاجِرُونَ وَنِعْمَ الأَنْصَارُ، صَلَاةً نَامِيَةً دَائِمَةً مَا سَجَعَتْ فِي أَيْكِهَا الأَطْيَارُ، وَهَمَعَتْ بِوَبْلِهَا الدِّيمَةُ المِدْرَارُ، ضَاعَفَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ دَائِمَ صَلَوَاتِهِ.
units.en:
O Allah, bless our master Muhammad the man of beauty and honour, and slenderness and perfection, and radiance, and light, and male servants, and Houris, and lofty chambers and palaces, and of grateful speech and acceptable heart and of famous knowledge, leader of the victorious host, and the father of sons and daughters; the husband of pure wives, who was exalted to the grade of honour, and to the well Zemzem, and to the Place of Favour (Station of Abraham) and to the Sacred Enclosure, and to aversion for sins, and the nurture of orphans, and the pilgrimage to Mecca, and the art of reading the Quran, and the praise of the Merciful One, and the fast of Ramadhan, and the folded banner, and generosity and honour, and the one true to his promise.

He, the man of affection and ardent desire, the muleteer, the nobleman, at the cistern and with his sword, the Prophet ever persistent, speaking clearly on the rules laid down in the Book; the Prophet, the servant of Allah; the Prophet, the treasure of Allah; the Prophet, the argument of Allah; the Prophet whom whoever obeys, indeed he does obey Allah, and whoever rebels against him, indeed he rebels against Allah: the Arabian Prophet, of the Qoraish, of the well Zemzem, of Mecca, of Tehama, the man of noble features, bright black eyes, and oval cheeks; destined for the streams and fountains of Paradise, victorious over the discontented, ruin of the infidels, slaughtering the idolaters, guide of the white shining ones to the gardens of delight, and the famous comrade of Gabriel, blessings and peace be on him;

Envoy of the Lord of the Worlds; intercessor for sinners, and limitless cloud of mercy, a lamp in darkness, and like the moon at the full; the blessing of Allah be on him and on his elect Family, of the purest character; a continuous blessing unto eternity that never fails: the blessing of Allah on him and his Family, a blessing of which the joy will renew itself and proclaim his honour in the appointed day of his return to life, and Resurrection.

And the blessing of Allah be on him, and on his Family; those rising stars, a blessing that will descend on them in most liberal aid, that will flow in streams; and Thou sent him from the deserts of Arabia as the scale of justice, and manifested his perspicuity and augmented his eloquence, and increased his power, and exalted him to a place of honour and gave grace to his language, the one who defended their rights and cured their antipathies and instructed them in modesty, and in such thoughts as Nature advises, and spread Islam, and caused the destruction of idols and the establishment of authorities and the enclosure of the sanctuary, and spread favours to the entire world. O Allah, bless him and his Family in every assembly and place, with the highest blessing and peace. Allah blessing him and his Family ever and anon with a blessing that will be a treasure and refreshment.

Allah bless him and his Family with a blessing perfect and pure.

Allah bless him and his Family with a blessing that will ever be followed by a breath and fragrant air, and attended by forgiveness and favour. O Allah, bless most graciously the families who benefit by him, and the chiefs who take names from him, and the moons that take their light from the brightness of his forehead; truly the clouds and the rivers waste away at the generosity of his right hand: our master and Prophet and Patron Muhammad: at the splendour of his signs the hills and the valleys are bright, while at his wonders and at his signs, the Book speaks and the traditions verify themselves.

O Allah, bless him and his Family and his Companions who left their friends, to aid him, and who aided him in his emigration; yes, verily blessed be those who shared the emigration and who gave him help, a blessing ever increasing, everlasting, while the doves coo in their woods, and the set and steady rains pour down in torrents: may Allah for ever double His blessings upon him.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad — the man of beauty and honour, grace and perfection, radiance and light; the man of servants and houris, lofty chambers and palaces, grateful speech and an accepted heart and renowned knowledge; leader of the victorious host, father of sons and daughters, husband of pure wives; the one raised to the degree of honour, to the well of Zamzam, to the Station of Abraham, to the Sacred Enclosure, to aversion for sins, the care of orphans, the pilgrimage to Mecca, the art of reciting the Qur'an, the praise of the Merciful, the fast of Ramaḍān, the folded banner, generosity and honour — the one true to his promise. He, the man of affection and ardent longing, the muleteer, the nobleman, at the Pool and with his sword; the ever-persistent Prophet, speaking clearly the rules laid down in the Book; the Prophet, the servant of Allah; the Prophet, the treasure of Allah; the Prophet, the proof of Allah; the Prophet whom whoever obeys has obeyed Allah, and whoever rebels against him has rebelled against Allah: the Arabian Prophet, of Quraysh, of Zamzam, of Mecca, of Tihāma; the man of noble features, bright black eyes, and oval cheeks; destined for the streams and fountains of Paradise; victorious over the discontented, ruin of the unbelievers, slayer of idolaters, guide of the white-shining ones to the gardens of delight, and the famed companion of Gabriel — blessings and peace be upon him; messenger of the Lord of the Worlds; intercessor for sinners; a limitless cloud of mercy; a lamp in darkness, like the moon at full. The blessing of Allah be upon him and his elect family, purest of character — a continuous, never-failing blessing into eternity; the blessing of Allah on him and his family, a blessing whose joy renews itself and proclaims his honour on the appointed day of his return to life and resurrection. And the blessing of Allah be on him and his family, those rising stars — a blessing descending on them in most generous aid, flowing in streams. You sent him from the deserts of Arabia as a scale of justice; You made his clarity manifest, increased his eloquence and power, exalted him to a station of honour, and graced his language — he who defended their rights, cured their hatreds, taught them modesty and the thoughts sound nature advises, spread Islam, destroyed idols, established rightful authority and the sanctity of the sanctuary, and spread favours to the entire world. O Allah, bless him and his family in every assembly and place with the highest blessing and peace; Allah bless him and his family, time and again, with a blessing that is a treasure and a refreshment; Allah bless him and his family with a blessing perfect and pure; Allah bless him and his family with a blessing ever followed by breath and fragrant air, attended by forgiveness and favour. O Allah, bless most graciously the families who benefit through him, the chiefs who take their names from him, and the moons that take their light from the brightness of his forehead — truly, clouds and rivers fall short of the generosity of his right hand, our master, prophet, and patron Muhammad: at the splendour of his signs hills and valleys shine, and at his wonders and signs the Book speaks and the traditions bear witness. O Allah, bless him, his family, and his Companions, who left their friends to aid him and aided him in his emigration — yes, blessed be those who shared the emigration and gave him help — with an ever-increasing, everlasting blessing, while doves coo in their woods and steady rains pour down in torrents: may Allah forever double His blessings upon him.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ الكِرَامِ، صَلَاةً مَوْصُولَةً دَائِمَةَ الاتِّصَالِ بِدَوَامِ ذِي الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, and his Family, so good, so noble; a blessing increasing, that will endure to a blessing in eternity, full of majesty and honour.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his family, so good, so noble — an increasing blessing that endures into eternity, full of majesty and honour.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الَّذِي هُوَ قُطْبُ الجَلَالَةِ، وَشَمْسُ النُّبُوَّةِ وَالرِّسَالَةِ، وَالهَادِي مِنَ الضَّلَالَةِ، وَالمُنْقِذُ مِنَ الجَهَالَةِ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةَ الاتِّصَالِ وَالتَّوَالِي، مُتَعَاقِبَةً بِتَعَاقُبِ الأَيَّامِ وَاللَّيَالِي.
units.en:
O Allah, bless our master Muhammad who is himself the Pivot of Honour, and the Sun of Inspiration and Prophecy, and the Guide from Error, and the Saviour from Ignorance.

Allah bless him in perfect peace, a blessing that continues an unbroken stream of blessing following in the succession of days and nights,
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, who is himself the pivot of honour, the sun of inspiration and prophecy, the guide from error, and the saviour from ignorance. Allah bless him with perfect peace — a blessing that continues as an unbroken stream, following the succession of days and nights,

sections.note: English: historical translation by Rev. John B. Pearson (Guide to Happiness, Oxford, 1907), in the public domain.

sections.heading: Monday (Conclusion) — Ḥizb 8 (حِزْبُ الخَتْم)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الزَّاهِدِ، رَسُولِ المَلِكِ الصَّمَدِ الوَاحِدِ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ صَلَاةً دَائِمَةً إِلَي مُنْتَهَى الآبَادِ، بِلَا انْقِطَاعٍ وَلَا نَفَادٍ، صَلَاةً تُنْجِينَا بِهَا مِنْ حَرِّ جَهَنَّمَ وَبِئْسَ المِهَادُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the ascetic Prophet and Envoy of the Eternal King, the Only Lord. Allah bless him in perfect peace, a blessing that will continue unto the bounds of eternity, without interruption or exhaustion; a blessing that will save us from the pains of Hell, and the misery of its Couch.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the ascetic Prophet and messenger of the Eternal King, the Only Lord. Allah bless him with perfect peace — a blessing that continues to the bounds of eternity without interruption or exhaustion, a blessing that will save us from the pains of Hell and the misery of its resting-place.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الأُمِّيِّ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَسَلِّمْ، صَلَاةً لَا يُحْصَى لَهَا عَدَدٌ، وَلَا يُعَدُّ لَهَا مَدَدٌ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the Unlettered Prophet, and bless his Family and give them peace: a blessing the amount of which cannot be computed, nor its extent reckoned.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the unlettered Prophet, and bless his family and grant them peace — a blessing whose amount cannot be computed and whose extent cannot be reckoned.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَاةً تُكْرِمُ بِهَا مَثْوَاهُ، وَتُبَلِّغُ بِهَا يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ مِنَ الشَّفَاعَةِ رِضَاهُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad with a blessing that will do honour to his home, and will reach of itself to the Day of Resurrection, for the entreaty That he hath pleased to approve.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad with a blessing that honours his home and reaches of itself to the Day of Resurrection, for the entreaty he has been pleased to approve.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ النَّبِيِّ الأَصِيلِ، السَّيِّدِ النَّبِيلِ، الَّذِي جَاءَ بِالْوَحْيِ وَالتَّنْزِيلِ، وَأَوْضَحَ بَيَانَ التَّأْوِيلِ، وَجَاءَهُ الأَمِينُ سَيِّدُنَا جِبْرِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، بِالْكَرَامَةِ وَالتَّفْضِيلِ، وَأَسْرَى بِهِ المَلِكُ الجَلِيلُ، فِي اللَّيْلِ البَهِيمِ الطَّوِيلِ، فَكَشَفَ لَهُ عَنْ أَعْلَى المَلَكُوتِ، وَأَرَاهُ سَنَاءَ الجَبَرُوتِ، وَنَظَرَ إِلَى قُدْرَةِ الحَيِّ الدَّائِمِ البَاقِي الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ، صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، صَلَاةً مَقْرُونَةً بِالْجَمَالِ، وَالحُسْنِ وَالكَمَالِ، وَالخَيْرِ وَالإِفْضَالِ.
units.en:
O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the unswerving Prophet, the capable master, who brought the revelation and the heaven sent gift, and explained the evidence of the vision, when the faithful Gabriel came to him, on whom be blessing and peace, with honour and favour: when the steed took him on the journey to the Realm on High, in the long dark night, and revealed to him some of the Highest Spheres of the kingdom, and showed him the Majesty of the Almighty; and he set eyes on His Power, so Living, so Eternal, so Enduring, Who never dies.

O Allah, give him blessing and peace, a blessing highly advanced in grace and excellence, in perfection, and goodness, and favour.
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, the unswerving Prophet, the capable master, who brought the revelation, the heaven-sent gift, and explained the evidence of the vision, when the faithful Gabriel came to him — blessings and peace be upon him — with honour and favour; when the steed carried him on the journey to the Realm on High in the long dark night, revealed to him some of the highest spheres of the kingdom, and showed him the majesty of the Almighty; and he set eyes upon His power — the Living, the Eternal, the Enduring, who never dies. O Allah, give him blessing and peace — a blessing most advanced in grace, excellence, perfection, goodness, and favour.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الأَقْطَارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ وَرَقِ الأَشْجَارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ زَبَدِ البِحَارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الأَنْهَارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ رَمْلِ الصَّحَارِي وَالقِفَارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ ثِقْلِ الجِبَالِ وَالأَحْجَارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ أَهْلِ الجَنَّةِ وَأَهْلِ النَّارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ الأَبْرَارِ وَالفُجَّارِ، وَصَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِ سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَدَدَ مَا يَخْتَلِفُ بِهِ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ.
units.en: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all quarters of the earth, and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all the leaves of the trees, and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all the foam of the seas; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all the rivers; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all the sand of the Sahara, and the deserts; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all the burden of the mountains and stony wastes; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the denizens of Paradise and Hell; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad in all acts of generosity or crime; and bless our master Muhammad and the Family of our master Muhammad as long as the night and the day shall continue their succession;
units.en2: O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all quarters of the earth; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the leaves of the trees; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the foam of the seas; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the rivers; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the sand of the Sahara and the deserts; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the mass of the mountains and stony wastes; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in all the dwellers of Paradise and Hell; bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad in every act of generosity or crime; and bless our master Muhammad and the family of our master Muhammad as long as night and day continue their succession;

units.ar: وَاجْعَلِ اللَّهُمَّ صَلَاتَنَا عَلَيْهِ حِجَابًا مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ، وَسَبَبًا لِإِبَاحَةِ دَارِ القَرَارِ، إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ العَزِيزُ الغَفَّارُ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ الطَّيِّبِينَ، وَذُرِّيَّتِهِ المُبَارَكِينَ، وَصَحَابَتِهِ الأَكْرَمِينَ، وَأَزْوَاجِهِ أُمَّهَاتِ المُؤْمِنِينَ، صَلَاةً مَوْصُولَةً تَتَرَدَّدُ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّينِ.
units.en:
And, O Allah, make our prayer of blessing upon him a shelter for us from the pain of Hell, and a way of admission to the Home of Rest: for Thou art the Mighty One, the Forgiving.

And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad and his worthy Family, and his favoured descendants, and his most noble Comrades, and his wives, the Mothers of the Faithful; a continuous blessing that will return from time to time till the Day of Judgement.
units.en2: And, O Allah, make our prayer of blessing upon him a shelter for us from the pain of Hell and a way of admission to the Home of Rest — for You are the Mighty, the Forgiving. And, O Allah, bless our master Muhammad, his worthy family, his favoured descendants, his most noble Companions, and his wives, the Mothers of the Faithful — a continuous blessing that returns time after time until the Day of Judgement.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِ الأَبْرَارِ، وَزَيْنِ المُرْسَلِينَ الأَخْيَارِ، وَأَكْرَمِ مَنْ أَظْلَمَ عَلَيْهِ اللَّيْلُ وَأَشْرَقَ عَلَيْهِ النَّهَارُ (3)
units.en: O Allah, bless the master of the Virtuous, and the Ornament of the Best Apostles, and most honourable of any on whom the night falls or the day dawns. (Repeat three times)
units.en2: O Allah, bless the master of the virtuous, the ornament of the best of the messengers, and the most honoured of all over whom night falls or day dawns. (Three times)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ يَا ذَا المَنِّ الَّذِي لَا يُكَافَى امْتِنَانُهُ، وَالطَّوْلِ الَّذِي لَا يُجَازَى إِنْعَامُهُ وَإِحْسَانُهُ، نَسْأَلُكَ بِكَ وَلَا نَسْأَلُكَ بِأَحَدٍ غَيْرِكَ، أَنْ تُطْلِقَ أَلْسِنَتَنَا عِنْدَ السُّؤَالِ، وَتُوَفِّقَنَا لِصَالِحِ الأَعْمَالِ، وَتَجْعَلَنَا مِنَ الآمِنِينَ يَوْمَ الرَّجْفِ وَالزِّلْزَالِ، يَا ذَا العِزَّةِ وَالجَلَالِ، أَسْأَلُكَ يَا نُورَ النُّورِ، قَبْلَ الأَزْمِنَةِ وَالدُّهُورِ، أَنْتَ البَاقِي بِلَا زَوَالِ، الغَنِيُّ بِلَا مِثَالِ، القُدُّوسُ الطَّاهِرُ، العَلِيُّ القَاهِرُ، الَّذِي لَا يُحِيطُ بِهِ مَكَانٌ، وَلَا يَشْتَمِلُ عَلَيْهِ زَمَانٌ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَسْمَائِكَ الحُسْنَى كُلِّهَا، وَبِأَعْظَمِ أَسْمَائِكَ إِلَيْكَ، وَأَشْرَفِهَا عِنْدَكَ مَنْزِلَةً، وَأَجْزَلِهَا عِنْدَكَ ثَوَابًا، وَأَسْرَعِهَا مِنْكَ إِجَابَةً، وَبِاسْمِكَ المَخْزُونِ المَكْنُونِ، الجَلِيلِ الأَجَلِّ، الكَبِيرِ الأَكْبَرِ، العَظِيمِ الأَعْظَمِ، الَّذِي تُحِبُّهُ، وَتَرْضَى عَمَّنْ دَعَاكَ بِهِ، وَتَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُ دُعَاءَهُ.
units.en:
O Allah; Aye, Thou for whose Liberality no return will ever suffice.

Aye, Thou whose Patience no kindness or Goodness can recompense; we beseech Thee by Thyself, and we do not beseech Thee by any one besides Thyself, that Thou wilt give freedom to our tongues in prayer, and wilt infuse integrity into our actions, and cause us to be of the believers in the Day of Trembling and Earthquake. O Thou Being of Might and Majesty; yea, Thou Light of Light before the ages of Eternity, Thou art He who Abides without decadence, Rich beyond comparison, the Holy one, the Pure, the Exalted, the Victorious, whom no place can include, and whom no period of Time can embrace; I entreat Thee by all Thy good Names, and by the power of Thy Names with Thyself, and by the most exalted of them in degree, and the most considerable in merit, and that have the promptest response from Thee, and by Thy Name of special value, Thy hidden Name so grand, so very grand, so great, so very great, so mighty, so very mighty, that Thou dost love and approve its use in any one who invoked Thee by it, and answers his prayer with favour:
units.en2: O Allah — yes, You whose liberality no return can ever suffice; yes, You whose patience no kindness or goodness can repay — we beseech You by Yourself, and we beseech You by none besides Yourself, to set our tongues free in prayer, to infuse integrity into our actions, and to make us among the believers on the Day of Trembling and Earthquake. O Being of might and majesty; yes, You Light of Light before the ages of eternity; You are He who abides without decay, rich beyond compare, the Holy, the Pure, the Exalted, the Victorious, whom no place can contain and no span of time embrace. I entreat You by all Your good names, by the power of Your names with You, by the most exalted of them in degree, the most considerable in merit, and the quickest to win Your response, and by Your name of special value — Your hidden name, so grand, so very grand, so great, so very great, so mighty, so very mighty — that You love and approve its use: whoever calls upon You by it, You answer his prayer with favour:

units.ar: أَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الحَنَّانُ المَنَّانُ، بَدِيعُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، ذُو الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ، عَالِمُ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الكَبِيرُ المُتَعَالِ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيمِ الأَعْظَمِ الَّذِي إِذَا دُعِيتَ بِهِ أَجَبْتَ، وَإِذَا سُئِلْتَ بِهِ أَعْطَيْتَ، وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِي يَذِلُّ لِعَظَمَتِهِ العُظَمَاءُ وَالمُلُوكُ وَالسِّبَاعُ وَالهَوَامُّ وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْتَهُ، يَا اللَّهُ يَا رَبِّ اسْتَجِبْ دَعْوَتِي، يَا مَنْ لَهُ العِزَّةُ وَالجَبَرُوتُ، يَا ذَا المُلْكِ وَالمَلَكُوتِ، يَا مَنْ هُوَ حَيٌّ لَّا يَمُوتُ، سُبْحَانَكَ رَبِّ مَا أَعْظَمَ شَاْنَكَ، وَأَرْفَعَ مَكَانَكَ، أَنْتَ رَبِّي، يَا مُتَقَدِّسًا فِي جَبَرُوتِهِ، إِلَيْكَ أَرْغَبُ، وَإِيَّاكَ أَرْهَبُ، يَا عَظِيمُ يَا كَبِيرُ، يَا جَبَّارُ يَا قَادِرُ يَا قَوِيُّ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا عَظِيمُ، تَعَالَيْتَ يَا عَلِيمُ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا عَظِيمُ، سُبْحَانَكَ يَا جَلِيلُ، أَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ العَظِيمِ التَّامِّ الكَبِيرِ، أَنْ لَا تُسَلِّطَ عَلَيْنَا جَبَّارًا عَنِيدًا، وَلَا شَيْطَانًا مَرِيدًا، وَلَا إِنْسَانًا حَسُودًا، وَلَا ضَعِيفًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ، وَلَا شَدِيدًا، وَلَا بَارًّا وَلَا فَاجِرًا وَلَا عَبِيدًا وَلَا عَنِيدًا.
units.en2: I beseech You, O Allah — for there is no god but You — the Affectionate, the Benevolent, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord of grandeur and veneration, Knower of the secret, ever Witness, Great, Exalted: yes, I entreat You by Your mighty, most mighty name, which when You are invoked by it, You answer, and when You are entreated by it, You grant; yes, I beseech You by Your mighty name, before whose might the mighty abate themselves — kings, wild beasts, lions, and everything You have created. Yes, O Allah, yes, Lord, give a favourable answer to my prayer — yes, You who hold power and pride; yes, You Lord of power and royalty; yes, You who are the Living One who does not die. Praise to You — how almighty is Your office, how high Your place. You are my Lord, yes, You, so sanctified in pride; You hold all that is most desired, and You are the One most feared — yes, You Mighty One, yes, You Great One, yes, You Majestic, yes, You Powerful, yes, You Strong, You deserving of blessing; yes, You Mighty One, deserving of exaltation; yes, You All-Knowing, praise be to You; yes, You Mighty One, praise be to You; yes, You Majestic One. I entreat You by Your mighty name, so perfect, so great: set over us no proud tyrant, no rebellious evil spirit, no envious or powerless man of Your creation — no severed one, no dissolute one, no slave, no obstinate one.

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ فَإِنِّي أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ الوَاحِدُ الأَحَدُ الصَّمَدُ، الَّذِي
﴿
لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ . وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
﴾
، يَا هُوَ يَا مَنْ لَّا هُوَ إِلَّا هُوَ، يَا مَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ، يَا أَزَلِيُّ يَا أَبَدِيُّ، يَا دَهْرِيُّ يَا دَيْمُومِيُّ، يَا مَنْ هُوَ الحَيُّ الَّذِي لَا يَمُوتُ، يَا إِلٰهَنَا وَإِلٰهَ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِلٰهًا وَاحِدًا، لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
units.en: O Allah, verily I entreat Thee, and give Thee my testimony: Thou art Allah, besides whom there is no Allah, the One, the only One, the Eternal, that does not beget, and is not begotten, to Whom there is no single equal; yea, it is He Who is no one but Himself; yea, He except Whom there is no Allah; yea, Thou art the One Who had no Beginning, that hast no End; Thou the Eternal, Thou the Enduring, yea, Thou Who art the Living One, that does not Die; yea, for ourselves and everything the One only Allah; there is no Allah but Thou.
units.en2: O Allah, I entreat You and bear You my witness: You are Allah, besides whom there is no god — the One, the Only, the Eternal, who begets not and is not begotten, and to whom there is no equal; yes, He who is none but Himself; yes, He, except whom there is no god; yes, You are the One who had no beginning and has no end; You, the Eternal; You, the Enduring; yes, You, the Living One who does not die; yes, for us and for everything, the One, the only Allah — there is no god but You.

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الرَّحْمَـٰنَ الرَّحِيمَ، الحَيَّ القَيُّومَ الدَّيَّانَ الحَنَّانَ المَنَّانَ، البَاعِثَ الوَارِثَ، ذَا الجَلَالِ وَالإِكْرَامِ، قُلُوبُ الخَلَائِقِ بِيَدِكَ، نَوَاصِيهِمْ إِلَيْكَ، فَأَنْتَ تَزْرَعُ الخَيْرَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ، وَتَمْحُو الشَّرَّ إِذَا شِئْتَ مِنْهُمْ.
units.en: O Allah, Creator of the Heavens and the Earth, that knowest Secret and Testimony, the Merciful, the Compassionate, the Living, the Self-sustaining, the Judge, the Gracious, the Benevolent, the Raiser from the dead, the Heir possessed of Majesty and Honour, the hearts of creatures are in Thy Hand, their foreheads are Thine, and Thou canst implant the good in their hearts, and wilt efface the sin as Thou wilt from them.
units.en2: O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the hidden and the witnessed, the Merciful, the Compassionate, the Living, the Self-Sustaining, the Judge, the Gracious, the Benevolent, the Raiser of the dead, the Heir, possessed of majesty and honour: the hearts of creatures are in Your hand, their foreheads are Yours — You can implant good in their hearts and efface sin from them as You will.

units.ar: فَأَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْ تَمْحُوَ مِنْ قَلْبِي كُلَّ شَيْءٍ تَكْرَهُهُ، وَأَنْ تَحْشُوَ قَلْبِي مِنْ خَشْيَتِكَ، وَمَعْرِفَتِكَ وَرَهْبَتِكَ، وَالرَّغْبَةِ فِيمَا عِنْدَكَ، وَالأَمْنَ وَالعَافِيَةَ، وَاعْطِفْ عَلَيْنَا بِالرَّحْمَةِ وَالبَرَكَةِ مِنْكَ، وَأَلْهِمْنَا الصَّوَابَ وَالحِكْمَةَ، فَنَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ عِلْمَ الخَائِفِينَ، وَإِنَابَةَ المُخْبِتِينَ، وَإِخْلَاصَ المُوقِنِينَ، وَشُكْرَ الصَّابِرِينَ، وَتَوْبَةَ الصِّدِّيقِينَ.
units.en:
And I entreat Thee, O Allah, that Thou wilt efface from my heart everything that is ungenial to it, and that Thou wilt fill my heart with Thy fear, and Thy knowledge, and Thy reverence, and ardent desire for all that is to be found with Thee, and faith, and forgiveness; and incline towards us in mercy and blessing from Thyself, and inspire us with justice and wisdom;

And we entreat Thee, O Allah, for the knowledge of those who fear Thee, and the repentance of those who humble themselves, and the sincerity of disciples, and the recompense of the persevering, and the devotion of the upright.
units.en2: And I entreat You, O Allah, to efface from my heart everything uncongenial to it; to fill my heart with Your fear, Your knowledge, reverence for You, ardent desire for all that is found with You, faith, and forgiveness; and to incline toward us in mercy and blessing from Yourself, and to inspire us with justice and wisdom. And we entreat You, O Allah, for the knowledge of those who fear You, the repentance of those who humble themselves, the sincerity of disciples, the reward of the persevering, and the devotion of the upright.

units.ar: وَنَسْأَلُكَ اللَّهُمَّ بِنُورِ وَجْهِكَ الَّذِي مَلَأَ أَرْكَانَ عَرْشِكَ، أَنْ تَزْرَعَ فِي قَلْبِي مَعْرِفَتَكَ حَتَّى أَعْرِفَكَ حَقَّ مَعْرِفَتِكَ، كَمَا يَنْبَغِي أَنْ تُعْرَفَ بِهِ، وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ خَاتَمِ النَّبِيِّينَ، وَإِمَامِ المُرْسَلِينَ، وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en:
And we entreat Thee. O Allah, by the Brightness of Thy Countenance, wherewith the pillars of Thy Throne are filled, that Thou wilt implant Thy knowledge in my heart, until I know Thee in the truth of Thy knowledge, so far as it is fitting that Thou shouldest be known by it.

Allah bless our master and patron Muhammad, Seal of the Prophets and Ensample of the Apostles, and his Family too, and his Comrades; and perfect peace. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds;

[Pearson's edition adds:]

He is our merit; and indeed our Advocate: there is no power, and there is no strength, save in Allah, the Exalted, the Mighty.

O Allah, forgive the compiler / editor / reader of this book, have mercy on him and make him among those who gather together in the company of Thy Prophets, the truthful ones, those established in Testimony and the righteous ones on the Day of Resurrection by Thy Grace, O Allah, the Most Merciful.
units.en2: And we entreat You, O Allah, by the brightness of Your countenance, with which the pillars of Your Throne are filled, to implant Your knowledge in my heart, until I know You with the truth of Your knowledge, as far as it is fitting that You be known. Allah bless our master and patron Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets and the model of the messengers, and his family too, and his Companions — and perfect peace. Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds. [Pearson's edition adds:] He is our merit and indeed our advocate: there is no power and no strength except with Allah, the Exalted, the Mighty. O Allah, forgive the compiler, editor, and reader of this book; have mercy on him, and make him among those who gather in the company of Your prophets, the truthful, the witnesses, and the righteous on the Day of Resurrection, by Your grace, O Allah, the Most Merciful.

sections.note: English: historical translation by Rev. John B. Pearson (Guide to Happiness, Oxford, 1907), in the public domain.

sections.heading: The Supplication of Completion (دُعَاءُ خَتْمِ دَلَائِلِ الخَيْرَات)

units.ar: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِمُؤَلِّفِهِ وَارْحَمْهُ، وَاجْعَلْهُ مِنَ المَحْشُورِينَ فِي زُمْرَةِ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ بِفَضْلِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ. اللَّهُمَّ امْنُنْ عَلَيْنَا بِصَفَاءِ المَعْرِفَةِ، وَهَبْ لَنَا صَحِيحَ المُعَامَلَةِ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ عَلَى السُّنَّةِ وَالجَمَاعَةِ، وَصِدْقَ التَّوَكُّلِ عَلَيْكَ، وَحُسْنَ الظَّنِّ بِكَ، وَامْنُنْ عَلَيْنَا بِكُلِّ مَا يُقَرِّبُنَا إِلَيْكَ مَقْرُونًا بِالعَفْوِ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ، وَحَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَكَفَى، وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى عِبَادِهِ الَّذِينَ اصْطَفَى، وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى المُرْسَلِينَ، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, forgive its author and have mercy upon him, and make him on the Day of Resurrection among those gathered in the company of the Prophets, the Truthful, the Martyrs, and the Righteous, through Thy grace, O Most Merciful of the merciful! O Allah, bestow upon us pure experiential knowledge; grant us soundness of conduct between us and Thee in accordance with the Prophetic Sunnah and the community; grant us true reliance upon Thee and good thoughts toward Thee; and bestow upon us everything that draws us close to Thee accompanied by pardon in both realms, O Lord of the Worlds! Allah is sufficient for us, and peaceful greetings upon His servants whom He has chosen, and peace be upon the Messengers, and praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ
اشْرَحْ بِالصَّلَاةِ عَلَيْهِ صُدُورَنَا، وَيَسِّرْ بِهَا أُمُورَنَا، وَفَرِّجْ بِهَا هُمُومَنَا، وَاكْشِفْ بِهَا غُمُومَنَا، وَاغْفِرْ بِهَا ذُنُوبَنَا، وَاقْضِ بِهَا دُيُونَنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ بِهَا أَحْوَالَنَا، وَبَلِّغْ بِهَا آمَالَنَا، وَتَقَبَّلْ بِهَا تَوْبَتَنَا، وَاغْسِلْ بِهَا حَوْبَتَنَا، وَانْصُرْ بِهَا حُجَّتَنَا، وَطَهِّرْ بِهَا أَلْسِنَتَنَا، وَآنِسْ بِهَا وَحْشَتَنَا، وَارْحَمْ بِهَا غُرْبَتَنَا، وَاجْعَلْهَا نُورًا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا، وَمِنْ خَلْفِنَا، وَعَنْ أَيْمَانِنَا، وَعَنْ شَمَائِلِنَا، وَمِنْ فَوْقِنَا، وَمِنْ تَحْتِنَا، وَفِي حَيَاتِنَا، وَمَوْتِنَا، وَفِي قُبُورِنَا، وَحَشْرِنَا، وَنَشْرِنَا، وَظِلًّا فِي يَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ عَلَي رُؤُوسِنَا، وَثَقِّلْ بِهَا مَوَازِينَ حَسَنَاتِنَا، وَأَدِمْ بَرَكَاتِهَا عَلَيْنَا حَتَّى نَلْقَى نَبِيَّنَا وَسَيِّدَنَا مُحَمَّدًا صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَنَحْنُ آمِنُونَ مُطْمَئِنُّونَ فَرِحُونَ مُسْتَبْشِرُونَ، وَلَا تُفَرِّقْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُ حَتَّى تُدْخِلَنَا مُدْخَلَهُ، وَتُؤْوِيَنَا إِلَي جِوَارِهِ الكَرِيمِ مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ
﴿
مِّنَ النَّبِيِّـنَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَآءِ وَالصَّـٰلِحِينَ ۚ وَحَسُنَ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ رَفِيقًا
﴾.
units.en: In the name of Allah, the Merciful, the Compassionate. O Allah, through blessings upon Thy holy Prophet, blessings and peace be upon him, enlighten our hearts and thereby make matters easy for us, and thereby dispel our anxieties, and thereby remove our griefs, and thereby forgive our sins, and thereby relieve us from indebtedness, and thereby straighten our affairs, and thereby fulfill our hopes, and accept our repentance, and cleanse our misdeeds, and thereby help us to come out victorious, and purify our tongues, and make us familiar with loneliness, and thereby relieve our separation; and make it a light in front of us and behind us, and to our left and right, and above us and beneath us, and in our lives, and at our deaths, and in our graves and on the Day of Gathering, and on the Day of Resurrection, and protect us with shade over our heads on the Day of Judgement, and weigh down the scales in our favour with good deeds; and perpetuate blessings on us until we meet our master and Prophet Muhammad, Allah's blessing and perfect peace be upon him and his Family, while we are well protected, fully satisfied and overjoyed; and do not separate us from him until Thou admit us through him into his entrance hall, and place us in his noble neighbourhood with those Thou hast favoured among the Prophets, the Truthful ones, the Martyrs, and the Righteous: and what a splendid company they are!
units.en2: O God, open our hearts through blessing him; ease our affairs through it; dispel our worries through it; lift our distress through it; forgive our sins through it; settle our debts through it; set right our affairs through it; bring us to our hopes through it; accept our repentance through it; wash away our misdeeds through it; strengthen our plea through it; purify our tongues through it; comfort our loneliness through it; have mercy on our estrangement through it; and make it a light before us, behind us, on our right, on our left, above us, beneath us, in our life and at our death, in our graves, at our gathering and our rising, and a shade over our heads on the Day of Resurrection. Weigh down the scales of our good deeds through it, and make its blessings continue upon us until we meet our prophet and master Muḥammad, may God bless him and grant him peace, while we are believing, reassured, joyful and glad-tidings-filled; and do not part us from him until You admit us by his entrance and shelter us in his noble neighbourhood, with those You have blessed «among the prophets, the truthful, the martyrs and the righteous — and excellent are those as companions».

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ
إِنَّا آمَنَّا بهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ وَلَمْ نَرَهُ، فَمَتِّعْنَا
اللَّهُمَّ
فِي الدَّارَيْنِ بِرُؤْيَتِهِ، وَثَبِّتْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى مَحَبَّتِهِ، وَاسْتَعْمِلْنَا عَلَى سُنَّتِهِ، وَتَوَفَّنَا عَلَى مِلَّتِهِ وَاحْشُرْنَا فِي زُمْرَتِهِ النَّاجِيَةِ وَحِزْبِهِ المُفْلِحِينَ، وَانْفَعْنَا بِمَا انْطَوَتْ عَلَيْهِ قُلُوبُنَا مِنْ مَحَبَّتِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَوْمَ لَا جَدَّ وَلَا مَالَ وَلَا بَنِينَ، وَأَوْرِدْنَا حَوْضَهُ الأَصْفَى، وَاسْقِنَا بِكَأْسِهِ الأَوْفَى، وَيَسِّرْ عَلَيْنَا زِيَارَةَ حَرَمِكَ وَحَرَمِهِ مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تُمِيتَنَا، وَأَدِمْ عَلَيْنَا الإِقَامَةَ بِحَرَمِكَ وَحَرَمِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ إِلَى أَنْ نُتَوَفَّى.
units.en: O Allah, we have believed in him, Allah's blessings and abundant peace be upon him, without seeing him; so make us enjoy, O Allah, a vision of him in both worlds, and keep our hearts ever in love with him, and employ us on his way, and cause us to die following his religion, and raise us in his protected company and with those who are declared successful; and let us profit from his love, which is in our hearts, on the Day of Judgement when wealth and offspring shall avail nothing, and bring us to his pure cistern and give us to drink from his cup, and facilitate for us a visit to Thy Sanctuary and his holy Resting Place before Thou causest us to die, and enable us to abide in these two Sacred Sanctuaries until we pass away.
units.en2: O God, we have believed in him, may God bless him and grant him peace, without having seen him; so let us delight, O God, in both abodes in the sight of him; make our hearts firm upon loving him; employ us upon his Sunna; take our souls upon his creed; gather us in his delivered throng and his prospering party; benefit us, on the day when neither lineage nor wealth nor sons avail, by the love of him that our hearts hold within, may God bless him and grant him peace; bring us to his purest Basin; give us to drink from his most brimming cup; ease for us the visit to Your sanctuary and his sanctuary before You take our souls; and make our dwelling at Your sanctuary and his sanctuary, may God bless him and grant him peace, continue until we are taken.

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ
إِنَّا نَسْتَشْفِعُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ إِذْ هُوَ أَوْجَهُ الشُّفَعَاءِ إِلَيْكَ، وَنُقْسِمُ بِهِ عَلَيْكَ إِذْ هُوَ أَعْظَمُ مَنْ أُقْسِمَ بِحَقِّهِ عَلَيْكَ، وَنَتَوَسَّلُ بِهِ إِلَيْكَ إِذْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ الوَسَائِلِ إِلَيْكَ، نَشْكُو إِلَيْكَ يَا رَبِّ قَسْوَةَ قُلُوبِنَا، وَكَثْرَةَ ذُنُوبِنَا، وَطُولَ آمَالِنَا، وَتَكَاسُلَنَا عَنِ الطَّاعَاتِ، وَهُجُومَنَا عَلَى المُخَالَفَاتِ، فَنِعْمَ المُشْتَكَى إِلَيْهِ أَنْتَ يَا رَبِّ، بِكَ نَسْتَنْصِرُ عَلَى أَعْدَائِنَا وَأَنْفُسِنَا فَانْصُرْنَا، وَعَلَى فَضْلِكَ نَتَوَكَّلُ فِي صَلَاحِنَا، فَلَا تَكِلْنَا إِلَى غَيْرِكَ يَا رَبَّنَا، وَإِلَى جَنَابِ رَسُولِكَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَنْتَسِبُ فَلَا تُبَعِّدْنَا، وَبِبَابِكَ نَقِفُ فَلَا تَطْرُدْنَا، وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْأَلُ فَلَا تُخَيِّبْنَا.
units.en: O Allah, we seek his intercession with Thee, for his is the most accepted intercession with Thee; and we entreat Thee through him, for he is the greatest of those who entreat Thee; and through him we seek access to Thee, for he is the nearest means of access unto Thee. We complain to Thee, O Allah, of the hardness of our hearts, and of the heavy load of our sins, and of the length of our worldly hopes, and of the corruption of our deeds, and of our indolence in doing good works; so grant us victory, O Allah, over our enemies and over the desires of our souls, and by Thy grace make us rely solely on Thy bounty and upon nothing else, O our Lord!
units.en2: O God, we seek intercession through him with You, for he is the most esteemed of intercessors before You; we swear by him upon You, for he is the greatest one whose right is sworn by upon You; and we draw near through him to You, for he is the closest of means to You. We complain to You, my Lord, of the hardness of our hearts, the abundance of our sins, the length of our hopes, our sluggishness in obedience, and our rushing into transgressions. What an excellent One to complain to You are, my Lord! Through You we seek victory over our enemies and our own selves, so grant us victory; upon Your bounty we rely for our betterment, so do not entrust us to anyone but You, our Lord; to the presence of Your messenger, may God bless him and grant him peace, we claim kinship, so do not cast us far; at Your door we stand, so do not drive us away; and You we ask, so do not disappoint us.

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ
ارْحَمْ تَضَرُّعَنَا، وَآمِنْ خَوْفَنَا، وَتَقَبَّلْ أَعْمَالَنَا، وَأَصْلِحْ أَحْوَالَنَا، وَاجْعَلْ بِطَاعَتِكَ اشْتِغَالَنَا، وَإِلَى الخَيْرِ مَآلَنَا، وَحَقِّقْ بِالزِّيَادَةِ آمَالَنَا، وَاخْتِمْ بِالسَّعَادَةِ آجَالَنَا. هَذَا ذُلُّنَا ظَاهِرٌ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ، وَحَالُنَا لَا يَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ، أَمَرْتَنَا فَتَرَكْنَا، وَنَهَيْتَنَا فَارْتَكَبْنَا، وَلَا يَسَعُنَا إِلَّا عَفْوُكَ فَاعْفُ عَنَّا يَا خَيْرَ مَأْمُولٍ، وَأَكْرَمَ مَسْئُولٍ، إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ رَؤُوفٌ رَحِيمٌ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ. وَصَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبهِ وَسَلَّمَ تَسْلِيمًا، وَالحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en: O Allah, we attach ourselves to the honor of Thy Messenger, Allah's blessings and perfect peace be upon him, so do not keep us distant from him; and we halt at Thy gate alone, so do not turn us away; and we ask of Thee alone, so do not disappoint us. O Allah, have mercy on our humble pleading, calm our fears, accept our deeds, straighten our state, keep us occupied in obedience to Thee, make us rich through Thee, and seal our lives with happiness and good end. This is our lowliness made manifest before Thee, and our condition is not hidden from Thee; Thou hast commanded us and we have fallen short, and Thou hast forbidden us and we have transgressed, yet nothing is too great for the expanse of Thy clemency: so pardon us, O Hope of those who ask, O Most Generous of those who bestow! For Thou art the Pardoner, the Forgiving, the Merciful, O Most Merciful of the merciful. And may Allah bless our master Muhammad and his Family and his Companions, and peace be upon the Messengers, and praise belongs to Allah, Lord of the Worlds.
units.en2: O God, have mercy on our humble pleading; calm our fear; accept our deeds; set right our affairs; make our occupation obedience to You and our outcome goodness; fulfil our hopes with increase; and seal our lifespans with felicity. Here is our abasement, laid bare before You, and our state is not hidden from You. You commanded us, and we abandoned; You forbade us, and we transgressed — and nothing can encompass us but Your pardon, so pardon us, best of those in whom hope is placed, most generous of those who are asked. You are Pardoning, Forgiving, Tender, Merciful, Most Merciful of the merciful. And may God bless our master Muḥammad, and his family and his companions, and grant them abundant peace; and praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds.

units.ar:
اللَّهُمَّ يَا مَنْ لَطَفْتَ بِخَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ، وَلَطَفْتَ بِالأَجِنَّةِ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِهَا، الْطُفْ بِنَا فِي قَضَائِكَ وَقَدَرِكَ، لُطْفًا يَلِيقُ بِكَرَمِكَ، يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ. (ثَلَاثًا)

اللَّهُمَّ انْصُرْ بِفَضْلِكَ سُلْطَانَنَا، وَأَهْلِكِ الكَفَرَةَ أَعْدَاءَنَا، وَآمِنَّا فِي أَوْطَانِنَا، وَوَلِّ أُمُورَنَا خِيَارَنَا، وَلَا تُوَلِّ أُمُورَنَا شِرَارَنَا، وَارْفَعْ مَقْتَكَ وَغَضَبَكَ عَنَّا، وَلَا تُسَلِّطْ عَلَيْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا مَنْ لَا يَخَافُكَ وَلَا يَرْحَمُنَا، يَا رَبَّ العَالَمِينَ.
units.en:
