units.en: For this [happened] in the time of the fulness of the prophetship; therefore the state of the dreamer is not denied regarding him.
units.en2: for this was at the height of prophethood; his state as a dreamer is not to be doubted.

units.ar: تَبَارَكَ اللَّهُ مَا وَحْيٌ بِمُكْتَسَبٍ — وَلَا نَبِيٌّ عَلَى غَيْبٍ بِمُتَّهَمِ
units.en: God be sanctified! No revelation can be acquired by effort; and no prophet is suspected without his privity.
units.en2: Glory be to God! Revelation cannot be earned by effort, and no prophet is ever accused of anything without his knowledge.

units.ar: كَمْ أَبْرَأَتْ وَصِبًا بِاللَّمْسِ رَاحَتُهُ — وَأَطْلَقَتْ أَرِبًا مِنْ رِبْقَةِ اللَّمَمِ
units.en: How many hath his [Muhammad's] hand cured by the touch who were diseased; and hath skilfully set free from the halter of insanity!
units.en2: How many sick people his hand healed with a touch, how many it freed from the noose of madness!

units.ar: وَأَحْيَتِ السَّنَةَ الشَّهْبَاءَ دَعْوَتُهُ — حَتَّى حَكَتْ غُرَّةً فِي الْأَعْصُرِ الدُّهُمِ
units.en: And his prayer hath made the year of drought to be alive—so that it hath been told of as a chief [year] among the times of rich vegetation—
units.en2: His prayer brought a year of drought back to life, until it was remembered as a chief among years of plenty,

units.ar: بِعَارِضٍ جَادَ أَوْ خِلْتَ الْبِطَاحَ بِهَا — سَيْبٌ مِنَ الْيَمِّ أَوْ سَيْلٌ مِنَ الْعَرِمِ
units.en: By a cloud-bank that rained copiously, so that thou wouldst thence have imagined the pebbly torrent-channels were dikes cut from the ocean, or an inundation from a mountain-reservoir broken loose!
units.en2: with a rain-cloud that poured until you would have thought the dry riverbeds were channels cut from the sea, or a floodburst from a mountain dam.

sections.heading: On the Excellence of the Noble Qur'an
sections.note: Verses 88–104

units.ar: دَعْنِي وَوَصْفِيَ آيَاتٍ لَهُ ظَهَرَتْ — ظُهُورَ نَارِ الْقِرَى لَيْلًا عَلَى عَلَمِ
units.en: Let me alone, and my description of some of his miracles, which were as manifest as is the conspicuousness of the hospitality-fire by night on the mountain-top;—
units.en2: Leave me with my account of just some of his miracles — plain to see as a fire of hospitality lit at night on a hilltop;

units.ar: فَالدُّرُّ يَزْدَادُ حُسْنًا وَهْوَ مُنْتَظِمٌ — وَلَيْسَ يَنْقُصُ قَدْرًا غَيْرَ مُنْتَظِمِ
units.en: For pearls increase in beauty when they are in regular strings, while they lose no value when unstrung;—
units.en2: pearls grow more beautiful in a string, yet lose none of their value unstrung.

units.ar: فَمَا تَطَاوُلُ آمَالِ الْمَدِيحِ إِلَى — مَا فِيهِ مِنْ كَرَمِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَالشِّيَمِ
units.en: And what [signifies] the aspiringness of the yearnings of the panegyrist toward that which is in him [Muhammad] of noble qualities and habits?
units.en2: What can a panegyrist's longing aspire to, beside the noble qualities and character within him?

units.ar: آيَاتُ حَقٍّ مِنَ الرَّحْمَنِ مُحْدَثَةٌ — قَدِيمَةٌ صِفَةُ الْمَوْصُوفِ بِالْقِدَمِ
units.en: [And that volume of] Miracles of the Truth, brought into new existence by the All-Merciful, though [itself] an attribute of Him who is qualified with eternity, and [itself also] eternal;
units.en2: And the Qur'an — the miracle of the True One, brought into being by the All-Merciful, though it is His timeless attribute, eternal —

units.ar: لَمْ تَقْتَرِنْ بِزَمَانٍ وَهْيَ تُخْبِرُنَا — عَنِ الْمَعَادِ وَعَنْ عَادٍ وَعَنْ إِرَمِ
units.en: It is not in conjunction with any one time [alone]; but it reminds us of the Resurrection, and of [the people of] 'Ad, and of [the garden of] Iram;
units.en2: it belongs to no single age; it reminds us of the Resurrection, of ʿĀd, and of Iram;

units.ar: دَامَتْ لَدَيْنَا فَفَاقَتْ كُلَّ مُعْجِزَةٍ — مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ إِذْ جَاءَتْ وَلَمْ تَدُمِ
units.en: It remains perpetual with us; therefore it hath surpassed every miracle of the prophets [of old], since they came forth and endured not;
units.en2: it remains with us forever, and so it surpassed every miracle of the earlier prophets, which appeared and did not last;

units.ar: مُحَكَّمَاتٌ فَمَا يُبْقِينَ مِنْ شُبَهٍ — لِذِي شِقَاقٍ وَمَا يَبْغِينَ مِنْ حَكَمِ
units.en: [Its miracles, i.e., verses, are] self-evident, so that they remain not matters of doubt to the caviller, neither do they excite a desire for [another] arbiter;
units.en2: its proofs are self-evident — they leave the doubter no room for suspicion, and no one longs for another judge;

units.ar: مَا حُورِبَتْ قَطُّ إِلَّا عَادَ مِنْ حَرَبٍ — أَعْدَى الْأَعَادِي إِلَيْهَا مُلْقِيَ السَّلَمِ
units.en: It has never been contested, but that the most aggressive of its attackers has returned to it proposing peace;
units.en2: it has never been challenged without the fiercest of its attackers coming back to sue for peace;

units.ar: رَدَّتْ بَلَاغَتُهَا دَعْوَى مُعَارِضِهَا — رَدَّ الْغَيُورِ يَدَ الْجَانِي عَنِ الْحُرَمِ
units.en: Its eloquence repels the pretensions of its disputer, with the repulsion of the jealous one [who repels] the hand of the criminal from the things held sacred [to virtue];
units.en2: its eloquence drives off every disputant's claim, as a jealous guardian drives a criminal's hand from what is sacred;

units.ar: لَهَا مَعَانٍ كَمَوْجِ الْبَحْرِ فِي مَدَدٍ — وَفَوْقَ جَوْهَرِهِ فِي الْحُسْنِ وَالْقِيَمِ
units.en: Its miracles [verses] have significations like the waves of the ocean at full tide, and above the pearls thereof in beauty and in values;
units.en2: its meanings surge like the waves of a swelling sea, and surpass its pearls in beauty and in worth;

units.ar: فَمَا تُعَدُّ وَلَا تُحْصَى عَجَائِبُهَا — وَلَا تُسَامُ عَلَى الْإِكْثَارِ بِالسَّأَمِ
units.en: Its wonders are not to be told or counted, neither does it verge, through over-abundance, on tediousness;
units.en2: its wonders cannot be numbered or told, yet abundance never makes it tedious;

units.ar: قَرَّتْ بِهَا عَيْنُ قَارِيهَا فَقُلْتُ لَهُ — لَقَدْ ظَفِرْتَ بِحَبْلِ اللَّهِ فَاعْتَصِمِ
units.en: The eye of its reader is made to sparkle; therefore have I said to him [the reader]: "Thou hast found the stay [cable] of God; keep fast hold [thereon];
units.en2: it makes the reader's eye sparkle — so I said to him: you have found God's firm rope; hold it fast!

units.ar: إِنْ تَتْلُهَا خِيفَةً مِنْ حَرِّ نَارِ لَظَى — أَطْفَأْتَ حَرَّ لَظَى مِنْ وِرْدِهَا الشَّبِمِ
units.en: "If thou recite it out of fear of the heat of the fire of hell's lowest pit, thou hast extinguished the heat of the pit with its refreshing recitation."
units.en2: If you recite it in fear of the heat of the lowest Hellfire, its cooling recitation puts that heat out.

units.ar: كَأَنَّهَا الْحَوْضُ تَبْيَضُّ الْوُجُوهُ بِهِ — مِنَ الْعُصَاةِ وَقَدْ جَاءُوهُ كَالْحُمَمِ
units.en: It is, as it were, the Tank, at which the faces of transgressors become whitened, who have approached it black as charcoal;
units.en2: It is like the Prophet's Basin: sinners come to it with faces black as charcoal and leave with them white;

units.ar: وَكَالصِّرَاطِ وَكَالْمِيزَانِ مَعْدِلَةً — فَالْقِسْطُ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا فِي النَّاسِ لَمْ يَقُمِ
units.en: And as the [strait] Path and the Balance, in equity; for justice, by any other than it, is not established among the people.
units.en2: and like the Bridge and the Scales in justice — without it, justice cannot stand among people.

units.ar: لَا تَعْجَبَنْ لِحَسُودٍ رَاحَ يُنْكِرُهَا — تَجَاهُلًا وَهْوَ عَيْنُ الْحَاذِقِ الْفَهِمِ
units.en: Wonder thou not at envious ones who deny it through ignorance, whereas it is [as] the [very] eye[-sight] of the perspicacious and intelligent:—
units.en2: Do not marvel at the envious who deny it out of ignorance, when it is the very eyesight of the discerning:

units.ar: قَدْ تُنْكِرُ الْعَيْنُ ضَوْءَ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ رَمَدٍ — وَيُنْكِرُ الْفَمُ طَعْمَ الْمَاءِ مِنْ سَقَمِ
units.en: The eye, through ophthalmia, has, ere now, denied the light of the sun; and the mouth, through disease, has denied the taste of water.
units.en2: a diseased eye has denied the sunlight before now, and a sick mouth has denied the taste of water.

audio.title: Chapter 6: On the Excellence of the Noble Qur'an

sections.heading: On His Night Journey and Ascension ﷺ
sections.note: Verses 105–117

units.ar: يَا خَيْرَ مَنْ يَمَّمَ الْعَافُونَ سَاحَتَهُ — سَعْيًا وَفَوْقَ مُتُونِ الْأَيْنُقِ الرُّسُمِ
units.en: O [Muhammad] thou Best of those whose court the guests seek, trudging on foot, or [seated] upon the loins of easy-paced she-camels;
units.en2: Best of all those whose courtyard guests seek — some trudging on foot, some riding gentle she-camels!

units.ar: وَمَنْ هُوَ الْآيَةُ الْكُبْرَى لِمُعْتَبِرٍ — وَمَنْ هُوَ النِّعْمَةُ الْعُظْمَى لِمُغْتَنِمِ
units.en: And who art the greatest sign for one who takes admonition; and who art the greatest blessing to him who avails [thereof]!
units.en2: The greatest of signs for anyone who takes warning, and the greatest of blessings for anyone who profits by it!

units.ar: سَرَيْتَ مِنْ حَرَمٍ لَيْلًا إِلَى حَرَمٍ — كَمَا سَرَى الْبَدْرُ فِي دَاجٍ مِنَ الظُّلَمِ
units.en: Thou travelledst by night from one sacred site to [another] sacred site, as the full moon journeys in the deepest of darkness;
units.en2: You journeyed by night from one sacred place to another, as the full moon travels through the deepest dark;

units.ar: وَبِتَّ تَرْقَى إِلَى أَنْ نِلْتَ مَنْزِلَةً — مِنْ قَابِ قَوْسَيْنِ لَمْ تُدْرَكْ وَلَمْ تُرَمِ
units.en: And thou continuedst to mount, until thou reachedst the stage of Two Bow-shots, not reached [by another], and not attempted;
units.en2: and you rose until you reached the station of Two Bow-shots' Length — a height none has reached and none has aspired to;

units.ar: وَقَدَّمَتْكَ جَمِيعُ الْأَنْبِيَاءِ بِهَا — وَالرُّسْلِ تَقْدِيمَ مَخْدُومٍ عَلَى خَدَمِ
units.en: And all the prophets and messengers gave thee the precedency—the precedency of the served one over the servants;
units.en2: and all the prophets and messengers yielded you precedence — the precedence of the master over the servants;

units.ar: وَأَنْتَ تَخْتَرِقُ السَّبْعَ الطِّبَاقَ بِهِمْ — فِي مَوْكِبٍ كُنْتَ فِيهِ صَاحِبَ الْعَلَمِ
units.en: And thou traversedst with them the seven strata [of the heavens] in a procession, in which thou wast the standard-bearer;
units.en2: and you passed with them through the seven heavens in procession, and you were their standard-bearer,

units.ar: حَتَّى إِذَا لَمْ تَدَعْ شَأْوًا لِمُسْتَبِقٍ — مِنَ الدُّنُوِّ وَلَا مَرْقًى لِمُسْتَنِمِ
units.en: Until thou leftest not a further limit for any to go beyond thee in propinquity [to God's throne], nor a stair of ascent for any one mounting;
units.en2: until you left no higher peak for anyone to surpass you in nearness, nor any rung for anyone still ascending;

units.ar: خَفَضْتَ كُلَّ مَقَامٍ بِالْإِضَافَةِ إِذْ — نُودِيتَ بِالرَّفْعِ مِثْلَ الْمُفْرَدِ الْعَلَمِ
units.en: Thou debasedst every degree by comparison, when thou wast invited to go up higher, like the sole distinguished guest;
units.en2: you lowered every rank by comparison, when you were called up higher, like an honoured guest set apart,

units.ar: كَيْمَا تَفُوزَ بِوَصْلٍ أَيِّ مُسْتَتِرٍ — عَنِ الْعُيُونِ وَسِرٍّ أَيِّ مُكْتَتَمِ
units.en: That thou mightest have an interview with One curtained in how special a manner from the eyes [of mankind] and [the communication of] a secret concealed in how profound a degree;
units.en2: to be granted an audience with One screened from all eyes, and a secret hidden beyond all depth.

units.ar: فَحُزْتَ كُلَّ فَخَارٍ غَيْرَ مُشْتَرَكٍ — وَجُزْتَ كُلَّ مَقَامٍ غَيْرَ مُزْدَحَمِ
units.en: Thou gainedst every subject of [legitimate] boasting, without a co-participator; and thou passedst through every stage [of progress] free from the throng;
units.en2: You won every honour worth boasting of, shared with no one; you passed through every station beyond the crowds;

units.ar: وَجَلَّ مِقْدَارُ مَا وُلِّيتَ مِنْ رُتَبٍ — وَعَزَّ إِدْرَاكُ مَا أُولِيتَ مِنْ نِعَمِ
units.en: And illustrious was the worth of the grades thou acquiredst; difficult is the comprehension of the favours thou receivedst!
units.en2: glorious the worth of the degrees you attained; beyond reckoning the favours you received!

units.ar: بُشْرَى لَنَا مَعْشَرَ الْإِسْلَامِ إِنَّ لَنَا — مِنَ الْعِنَايَةِ رُكْنًا غَيْرَ مُنْهَدِمِ
units.en: Glad tidings unto us, the host of Islām! For verily we have, through [God's] grace, a corner pilaster undemolishable!
units.en2: Good news for us, the community of Islam: by God's grace we have a supporting pillar that can never be demolished!

units.ar: لَمَّا دَعَا اللَّهُ دَاعِينَا لِطَاعَتِهِ — بِأَكْرَمِ الرُّسْلِ كُنَّا أَكْرَمَ الْأُمَمِ
units.en: Inasmuch as God has named him [Muhammad] "the Most Noble of the Apostles," who called us to obedience unto Him [God], we are the noblest of peoples.
units.en2: Since God named the one who called us to Him "the noblest of messengers", we are the noblest of communities.

audio.title: Chapter 7: On His Night Journey and Ascension ﷺ

sections.heading: On the Prophet's Jihad ﷺ
sections.note: Verses 118–139

units.ar: رَاعَتْ قُلُوبَ الْعِدَا أَنْبَاءُ بِعْثَتِهِ — كَنَبْأَةٍ أَجْفَلَتْ غُفْلًا مِنَ الْغَنَمِ
units.en: The tidings of his mission scared the hearts of the enemies, as a cry that puts to flight an unminded flock of sheep and goats;
units.en2: The news of his mission struck fear into enemy hearts, like a shout that scatters a heedless flock;

units.ar: مَا زَالَ يَلْقَاهُمُ فِي كُلِّ مُعْتَرَكٍ — حَتَّى حَكَوْا بِالْقَنَا لَحْمًا عَلَى وَضَمِ
units.en: Neither did he cease to meet them on every battle-field, until, through his lances, they put [men] in mind of flesh on a tray;
units.en2: and he kept meeting them on every battlefield, until his spears made of them meat upon a tray;

units.ar: وَدُّوا الْفِرَارَ فَكَادُوا يَغْبِطُونَ بِهِ — أَشْلَاءَ شَالَتْ مَعَ الْعِقْبَانِ وَالرَّخَمِ
units.en: They preferred flight; and therein they had well-nigh envied the [torn] limbs rising [into the air] with the eagles and the vultures;
units.en2: they chose to flee — and almost envied the limbs carried off by eagles and vultures;

units.ar: تَمْضِي اللَّيَالِي وَلَا يَدْرُونَ عِدَّتَهَا — مَا لَمْ تَكُنْ مِنْ لَيَالِي الْأَشْهُرِ الْحُرُمِ
units.en: The nights went by, and they knew not the count thereof, when these were not nights of the months when warfare is unlawful.
units.en2: the nights passed, and they lost count of them — except the sacred months, when fighting is forbidden.

units.ar: كَأَنَّمَا الدِّينُ ضَيْفٌ حَلَّ سَاحَتَهُمْ — بِكُلِّ قَرْمٍ إِلَى لَحْمِ الْعِدَا قَرِمِ
units.en: As though the religion [of Islām] were a guest that had alighted in their court with all noble brood camels, eager to devour the flesh of his enemies,
units.en2: It was as if the religion were a guest that alighted in their courtyard with noble camels eager to devour the flesh of its enemies,

units.ar: يَجُرُّ بَحْرَ خَمِيسٍ فَوْقَ سَابِحَةٍ — يَرْمِي بِمَوْجٍ مِنَ الْأَبْطَالِ مُلْتَطِمِ
units.en: Who led a flood of an army [mounted] upon fleet horses, that threw up dashing waves of brave warriors,
units.en2: leading a flood of an army on swift horses, raising waves of brave warriors,

units.ar: مِنْ كُلِّ مُنْتَدِبٍ لِلَّهِ مُحْتَسِبٍ — يَسْطُو بِمُسْتَأْصِلٍ لِلْكُفْرِ مُصْطَلِمِ
units.en: [Composed] of all ready answerers to his call, confiding in God, and attacking with an exterminating weapon—extirpator of blasphemy;
units.en2: all answering his call, trusting in God, striking with a destroying weapon that uproots unbelief,

units.ar: حَتَّى غَدَتْ مِلَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ وَهْيَ بِهِمْ — مِنْ بَعْدِ غُرْبَتِهَا مَوْصُولَةَ الرَّحِمِ
units.en: Until, through them, the religious community of Islām, after its exile, became united to its blood-kindred;
units.en2: until, through them, the community of Islam — after its exile — was reunited with its own kin,

units.ar: مَكْفُولَةً أَبَدًا مِنْهُمْ بِخَيْرِ أَبٍ — وَخَيْرِ بَعْلٍ فَلَمْ تَيْتَمْ وَلَمْ تَئِمِ
units.en: For ever guaranteed, through them, with the best of fathers, and the best of husbands; so that it shall not become an orphan, nor a widow.
units.en2: forever secured through them with the best of fathers and the best of husbands: never an orphan, never a widow.

units.ar: هُمُ الْجِبَالُ فَسَلْ عَنْهُمْ مُصَادِمَهُمْ — مَاذَا رَأَى مِنْهُمُ فِي كُلِّ مُصْطَدَمِ
units.en: They were [immovable as] mountains. Ask, then, concerning them, of him who encountered with them: what was it he experienced from them in every place of encounter?
units.en2: They stood like mountains — ask anyone who met them in battle what he tasted from them at every encounter;

units.ar: وَسَلْ حُنَيْنًا وَسَلْ بَدْرًا وَسَلْ أُحُدًا — فُصُولَ حَتْفٍ لَهُمْ أَدْهَى مِنَ الْوَخَمِ
units.en: And ask Hunayn, and ask Badr, and ask 'Uhud: seasons of death more dire to them than the pest!
units.en2: ask Ḥunayn, ask Badr, ask Uḥud — seasons of death for them, crueller than plague!

units.ar: الْمُصْدِرِي الْبِيضِ حُمْرًا بَعْدَ مَا وَرَدَتْ — مِنَ الْعِدَا كُلَّ مُسْوَدٍّ مِنَ اللِّمَمِ
units.en: They sent forth the bright swords red, after these had reached every black hanging ear-curl of the hair of their enemies;
units.en2: They sent their bright swords back red, after they had reached every dark sidelock of the enemy,

units.ar: وَالْكَاتِبِينَ بِسُمْرِ الْخَطِّ مَا تَرَكَتْ — أَقْلَامُهُمْ حَرْفَ جِسْمٍ غَيْرَ مُنْعَجِمِ
units.en: And they wrote with brown lances of Khatt, whose pens did not leave one body of a letter unpunctuated;
units.en2: and they wrote with brown Khaṭṭī spears, pens that left no letter of a body without its dots;

units.ar: شَاكِي السِّلَاحِ لَهُمْ سِيمَا تُمَيِّزُهُمْ — وَالْوَرْدُ يَمْتَازُ بِالسِّيمَا عَنِ السَّلَمِ
units.en: Whose weapons are keen; who have a mark that distinguishes them; for the rose is distinguished from the acacia by its mark.
units.en2: their weapons are keen, and they bear a mark that sets them apart — as the rose is told from the thorn-tree by its mark.

units.ar: تُهْدِي إِلَيْكَ رِيَاحُ النَّصْرِ نَشْرَهُمُ — فَتَحْسَبُ الزَّهْرَ فِي الْأَكْمَامِ كُلَّ كَمِي
units.en: The winds of victory guide unto thee their odour; so that thou deemest each armour-clad warrior a flower in its calyx.
units.en2: The winds of victory carry their fragrance to you, until you think every armoured rider a flower in its calyx;

units.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ فِي ظُهُورِ الْخَيْلِ نَبْتُ رُبًا — مِنْ شِدَّةِ الْحَزْمِ لَا مِنْ شَدَّةِ الْحُزُمِ
units.en: They are, on the backs of their steeds, as it were, trees on hills, by reason of the firmness of courage, not through stringency of girths.
units.en2: on their horses' backs they are like trees on the hills — held firm by courage, not by tight saddle-straps.

units.ar: طَارَتْ قُلُوبُ الْعِدَا مِنْ بَأْسِهِمْ فَرَقًا — فَمَا تُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ الْبَهْمِ وَالْبُهَمِ
units.en: The hearts of the enemies sank with dismay at their onset; so that thou couldst not distinguish whether they were a flock of lambs or an army of warriors.
units.en2: The enemies' hearts sank in terror at their charge, so you could not tell a flock of lambs from an army of men.

units.ar: وَمَنْ تَكُنْ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ نُصْرَتُهُ — إِنْ تَلْقَهُ الْأُسْدُ فِي آجَامِهَا تَجِمِ
units.en: For whoso hath his stay in the Apostle of God, if lions meet him in their thickets, they are struck mute and motionless.
units.en2: Whoever has his refuge in the Messenger of God — if lions meet him in their thickets, they fall silent and still.

units.ar: وَلَنْ تَرَى مِنْ وَلِيٍّ غَيْرَ مُنْتَصِرٍ — بِهِ وَلَا مِنْ عَدُوٍّ غَيْرَ مُنْقَصِمِ
units.en: Thou wilt never see one of his friends unsuccoured by him, nor one enemy unbroken!
units.en2: You will never see a friend of his left unaided, nor an enemy of his left unbroken.

units.ar: أَحَلَّ أُمَّتَهُ فِي حِرْزِ مِلَّتِهِ — كَاللَّيْثِ حَلَّ مَعَ الْأَشْبَالِ فِي أَجَمِ
units.en: He hath caused his people to camp in the protection of his religion, even as the lion lays him down with his whelps in the thickets!
units.en2: He has lodged his community in the safety of his religion, as a lion beds down with its cubs in the thicket.

units.ar: كَمْ جَدَّلَتْ كَلِمَاتُ اللَّهِ مِنْ جَدِلٍ — فِيهِ وَكَمْ خَصَمَ الْبُرْهَانُ مِنْ خَصِمِ
units.en: How many disputants concerning him have the words of God confounded; and how many adversaries has the Demonstration overcome in argument!
units.en2: How many arguers the Word of God has silenced over him; how many opponents the Proof has overwhelmed in debate!

units.ar: كَفَاكَ بِالْعِلْمِ فِي الْأُمِّيِّ مُعْجِزَةً — فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَالتَّأْدِيبِ فِي الْيُتُمِ
units.en: Let science in the "Illiterate One," in a time of universal ignorance [of God], and education in the "Orphan," suffice thee as a miracle!
units.en2: Let it be miracle enough for you: such knowledge in the Unlettered One, in an age of ignorance, and such nurture in the Orphan.

audio.title: Chapter 8: On the Prophet's Jihad ﷺ

sections.heading: On Seeking Intercession Through the Prophet ﷺ
sections.note: Verses 140–151

units.ar: خَدَمْتُهُ بِمَدِيحٍ أَسْتَقِيلُ بِهِ — ذُنُوبَ عُمْرٍ مَضَى فِي الشِّعْرِ وَالْخِدَمِ
units.en: I have given him my service in a panegyric, by which I seek pardon for the sins of a lifetime passed in poetry and services,
units.en2: I have offered him service with this praise-poem, seeking pardon for the sins of a life spent in poetry and in favours,

units.ar: إِذْ قَلَّدَانِيَ مَا تُخْشَى عَوَاقِبُهُ — كَأَنَّنِي بِهِمَا هَدْيٌ مِنَ النَّعَمِ
units.en: Which have placed on my neck that of which the results are to be feared; as though I were, through them, a victim from among cattle.
units.en2: which have hung around my neck things whose consequences are to be feared — as if I were, through them, a sacrificial animal.

units.ar: أَطَعْتُ غَيَّ الصِّبَا فِي الْحَالَتَيْنِ وَمَا — حَصَلْتُ إِلَّا عَلَى الْآثَامِ وَالنَّدَمِ
units.en: In both those occupations I have obeyed the seductions of youth; and I have earned nothing, save through sins and regret.
units.en2: In both I obeyed the temptations of youth, and earned nothing but sins and regret.

units.ar: فَيَا خَسَارَةَ نَفْسٍ فِي تِجَارَتِهَا — لَمْ تَشْتَرِ الدِّينَ بِالدُّنْيَا وَلَمْ تَسُمِ
units.en: O what loss to a soul, in its traffic, that has not purchased religion with the world [as its price], and has not made a bid [for future happiness]!
units.en2: What a loss for a soul whose trading never bought religion with the world, and never even made a bid!

units.ar: وَمَنْ يَبِعْ آجِلًا مِنْهُ بِعَاجِلِهِ — يَبِنْ لَهُ الْغَبْنُ فِي بَيْعٍ وَفِي سَلَمِ
units.en: And whoso selleth his future for the present, there becomes manifest for him a being cheated in the sale, and in the prepayment!
units.en2: Whoever sells his hereafter for his present life will see the fraud in the bargain and in the payment.

units.ar: إِنْ آتِ ذَنْبًا فَمَا عَهْدِي بِمُنْتَقِضٍ — مِنَ النَّبِيِّ وَلَا حَبْلِي بِمُنْصَرِمِ
units.en: If I have committed a sin, my compact is not broken away from the Prophet, nor my cable sundered;
units.en2: Even if I have sinned, my covenant with the Prophet is not broken, nor my rope to him cut;

units.ar: فَإِنَّ لِي ذِمَّةً مِنْهُ بِتَسْمِيَتِي — مُحَمَّدًا وَهْوَ أَوْفَى الْخَلْقِ بِالذِّمَمِ
units.en: For verily I hold a safeguard from him through my being named Muhammad; and he is the most true of men to his bond.
units.en2: for I hold a protection from him in bearing the name Muḥammad — and he is the truest of people to his bond.

units.ar: إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي مَعَادِي آخِذًا بِيَدِي — فَضْلًا وَإِلَّا فَقُلْ يَا زَلَّةَ الْقَدَمِ
units.en: If, in my resurrection, there be not one to take me by the hand out of goodness, then, otherwise, say thou [of me]: "Alas, the footslip!"
units.en2: If at my resurrection he does not take me by the hand in kindness, then say of me: alas for the slip!

units.ar: حَاشَاهُ أَنْ يَحْرِمَ الرَّاجِي مَكَارِمَهُ — أَوْ يَرْجِعَ الْجَارُ مِنْهُ غَيْرَ مُحْتَرَمِ
units.en: Be it not imagined of him that he will frustrate of his generosities the expectant one, or that the refugee will return from him other than treated with honour.
units.en2: Never let it be thought that he would disappoint the hopes of one who seeks his generosity, or turn a refugee away dishonoured.

units.ar: وَمُنْذُ أَلْزَمْتُ أَفْكَارِي مَدَائِحَهُ — وَجَدْتُهُ لِخَلَاصِي خَيْرَ مُلْتَزِمِ
units.en: And ever since I have devoted my thoughts to his praiseworthy qualities, I have found him the best of sureties for my salvation.
units.en2: Ever since I devoted my thoughts to his praiseworthy qualities, I have found him the best guarantor of my salvation.

units.ar: وَلَنْ يَفُوتَ الْغِنَى مِنْهُ يَدًا تَرِبَتْ — إِنَّ الْحَيَا يُنْبِتُ الْأَزْهَارَ فِي الْأَكَمِ
units.en: Wealth from him will never fail a hand pinched with poverty: verily the rain maketh the flowers to grow on the hills!
units.en2: His bounty never fails a hand worn thin by poverty — the rain makes flowers bloom on the barren hills.

units.ar: وَلَمْ أُرِدْ زَهْرَةَ الدُّنْيَا الَّتِي اقْتَطَفَتْ — يَدَا زُهَيْرٍ بِمَا أَثْنَى عَلَى هَرِمِ
units.en: And I have not desired the glory of the world, which the hands of Zuhayr [the poet] grasped through what he sang in praise of Harim.
units.en2: And I want no worldly glory such as Zuhayr's hands grasped through his praise of Hārim.

audio.title: Chapter 9: On Seeking Intercession Through the Prophet ﷺ

sections.heading: On Intimate Supplication and the Presenting of Needs
sections.note: Verses 152–161

units.ar: يَا أَكْرَمَ الْخَلْقِ مَا لِي مَنْ أَلُوذُ بِهِ — سِوَاكَ عِنْدَ حُلُولِ الْحَادِثِ الْعَمِمِ
units.en: O thou most noble of the creation! I have not any one [beside thee] to whom to betake me, on the occurrence of the universal event [of death and resurrection].
units.en2: Most noble of creation! I have no one but you to flee to when the overwhelming Event comes;

units.ar: وَلَنْ يَضِيقَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ جَاهُكَ بِي — إِذَا الْكَرِيمُ تَجَلَّى بِاسْمِ مُنْتَقِمِ
units.en: And thy dignity, O Apostle of God! will not be narrowed through me when the All-Generous God shall manifest Himself in His name of an Avenger.
units.en2: and your honour, Messenger of God, will not be diminished on my account when the All-Generous reveals Himself as the Avenger —

units.ar: فَإِنَّ مِنْ جُودِكَ الدُّنْيَا وَضَرَّتَهَا — وَمِنْ عُلُومِكَ عِلْمَ اللَّوْحِ وَالْقَلَمِ
units.en: For the world and its fellow [future life] exist out of thy bounty; and out of thy science exists the science of the Tablet and of the Pen!
units.en2: for this world and the next are from your bounty, and the knowledge of the Tablet and the Pen is from your knowledge.

units.ar: يَا نَفْسُ لَا تَقْنَطِي مِنْ زَلَّةٍ عَظُمَتْ — إِنَّ الْكَبَائِرَ فِي الْغُفْرَانِ كَاللَّمَمِ
units.en: O Flesh! despair thou not by reason of a footslip that was great: verily deadly sins, in the divine forgiveness, are as venial offences.
units.en2: O my soul! Do not despair over a great slip — even deadly sins are small ones beside God's forgiveness.

units.ar: لَعَلَّ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّي حِينَ يَقْسِمُهَا — تَأْتِي عَلَى حَسَبِ الْعِصْيَانِ فِي الْقِسَمِ
units.en: Maybe that the grace of my Lord, when He shall share it out, will come, in the shares, in proportion to the transgressions.
units.en2: Perhaps my Lord's mercy, when He apportions it, will come in shares matching our transgressions.

units.ar: يَا رَبِّ وَاجْعَلْ رَجَائِي غَيْرَ مُنْعَكِسٍ — لَدَيْكَ وَاجْعَلْ حِسَابِي غَيْرَ مُنْخَرِمِ
units.en: O my Lord [God], let not my hope be reversed in Thy counsel; and judge Thou not my reckoning deficient!
units.en2: My Lord, do not let my hope be overturned in Your decree, and do not find my account lacking!

units.ar: وَالْطُفْ بِعَبْدِكَ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ إِنَّ لَهُ — صَبْرًا مَتَى تَدْعُهُ الْأَهْوَالُ يَنْهَزِمِ
units.en: And deal Thou graciously with Thy servant: verily he hath a fortitude, which, when terrors call for it, is put to flight.
units.en2: Deal gently with Your servant — his courage flees whenever terrors call it forth.

units.ar: وَأْذَنْ لِسُحْبِ صَلَاةٍ مِنْكَ دَائِمَةٍ — عَلَى النَّبِيِّ بِمُنْهَلٍّ وَمُنْسَجِمِ
units.en: And grant Thou that showers of benedictions from Thee [may be] perpetual upon the Prophet, copious and continuous;
units.en2: And grant that showers of Your blessings pour upon the Prophet, abundant and unceasing,

units.ar: وَعَلَى الْآلِ وَالصَّحْبِ ثُمَّ التَّابِعِينَ فَهُمْ — أَهْلُ التُّقَى وَالنَّقَى وَالْحِلْمِ وَالْكَرَمِ
units.en: And upon the family and the companions; then upon the successors of these, the men of piety, and virtue, and forbearance, and generosity;
units.en2: and upon his Family and Companions, and upon those who follow them — people of piety, virtue, forbearance and generosity —

units.ar: مَا رَنَّحَتْ عَذَبَاتِ الْبَانِ رِيحُ صَبًا — وَأَطْرَبَ الْعِيسَ حَادِي الْعِيسِ بِالنَّغَمِ
units.en: While the breath of the zephyr waves the branches of the moringa, and the camel-leader enlivens the camels with chants.
units.en2: as long as the breeze stirs the branches of the moringa, and the cameleer cheers his camels with song.

audio.title: Chapter 10: On Intimate Supplication and the Presenting of Needs

works.author: Various artists
works.description_en: A collection of devotional performances captured on commercial 78rpm discs in Cairo, Kazan, and Paris between 1901 and 1921 — tawshīḥ, qasā'id, and Quranic recitation by some of the earliest recorded voices of the gramophone era. These discs were published before 1926 and are in the public domain.

audio.title: Tawshīḥ: Fātanā shurub al-hanā
audio.label: Favorite 1-55584
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Harvard Loeb Music Library, Arabic 78 Collection.
audio.description: A tawshīḥ — a devotional poem in praise of the Prophet ﷺ sung to a measured melody — recorded in Cairo in 1905 for the Favorite label, in the very first years of commercial Arabic recording.

audio.title: Tawshīḥ: Yā ghazālān
audio.label: Favorite 1-55585
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Harvard Loeb Music Library, Arabic 78 Collection.
audio.description: A second tawshīḥ in praise of the Prophet ﷺ by Aḥmad al-Ajamī, from the same 1905 Cairo sessions for the Favorite label.

audio.title: Qasîda A-lâ fî sabîl Allâh (Pt 1)
audio.label: Favorite 2-55515
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Harvard Loeb Music Library, Arabic 78 Collection.
audio.description: The first side of a qaṣīda by the celebrated Egyptian reciter Saʿīd al-Saftī, recorded in Cairo in 1905. The poem runs across both sides of the disc — part 2 completes it.

audio.title: Qasîda A-lâ fî sabîl Allâh (Pt 2)
audio.label: Favorite 2-55519
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Harvard Loeb Music Library, Arabic 78 Collection.
audio.description: The second side of Saʿīd al-Saftī's qaṣīda — together with part 1 it makes up the complete recording, cut in Cairo in 1905.

audio.title: Qaṣīdat Allāhu akbar
audio.label: Baida 200a
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Harvard Loeb Music Library, Arabic 78 Collection.
audio.description: A qaṣīda opening with the takbīr, recorded around 1907–1911 for Baidaphon — the Beirut-based label whose discs circulated across the eastern Mediterranean.

audio.title: Hayyamatnī / Ṭayyamatnī
audio.label: Baida 245
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Harvard Loeb Music Library, Arabic 78 Collection.
audio.description: A further devotional disc by Aḥmad al-Mīr from the same Baidaphon period, around 1907–1911.

audio.title: Sūrat Yūsuf (Pt 1)
audio.label: Victor 73429-A
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Harvard Loeb Music Library, Arabic 78 Collection.
audio.description: Recitation from Sūrat Yūsuf by the Egyptian mezzo-soprano al-Sitt Wadūdah al-Minyalāwī — the label styles her 'Set Wedouda el Menialaweya, Cairo' — recorded for Victor in Cairo in 1915 (label 73429-A, marked 'Mezzo-Soprano Arabic-Syrian'). Harvard's Loeb Music Library describes her disc as a rare surviving example of a commercially released Quranic recording by a woman in the 78rpm era. Part 2 carries the second side.
audio.note: The label gives no verse numbers — only 'Part 1'. The recitation begins at verse 4 (Joseph's dream) and runs to verse 8; the Arabic text and Pickthall's translation are shown alongside.

text.title: Text and translation
text.translation_credit: Translation: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930). Public domain.

units.ar: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَجِدِينَ
units.en: When Joseph said unto his father: O my father! Lo! I saw in a dream eleven planets and the sun and the moon, I saw them prostrating themselves unto me.

units.ar: قَالَ يَبُنَىَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُءْيَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا۟ لَكَ كَيْدًا ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَنَ لِلْإِنسَنِ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
units.en: He said: O my dear son! Tell not thy brethren of thy vision, lest they plot a plot against thee. Lo! Satan is for man an open foe.

units.ar: وَكَذَلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَآ أَتَمَّهَا عَلَىٰٓ أَبَوَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ إِبْرَهِيمَ وَإِسْحَقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
units.en: Thus thy Lord will prefer thee and will teach thee the interpretation of events, and will perfect His grace upon thee and upon the family of Jacob as He perfected it upon thy forefathers, Abraham and Isaac. Lo! thy Lord is Knower, Wise.

units.ar: لَّقَدْ كَانَ فِى يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِۦٓ ءَايَتٌۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
units.en: Verily in Joseph and his brethren are signs (of Allah's Sovereignty) for the inquiring.

units.ar: إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِى ضَلَلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
units.en: When they said: Verily Joseph and his brother are dearer to our father than we are, many though we be. Lo! our father is in plain aberration.

audio.title: Sūrat Yūsuf (Pt 2)
audio.label: Victor 73429-B
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Harvard Loeb Music Library, Arabic 78 Collection.
audio.description: The second side of Wadūdah al-Minyalāwī's 1915 Victor recording of Sūrat Yūsuf (label 73429-B; the Arabic label reads سورة يوسف (قرآن) ٢, 'Sūrat Yūsuf (Qur'an), 2').
audio.note: The second side, labelled 'Part 2' — the recitation runs from verse 9 (the brothers' plot) to verse 15 (the pit, and God's word to Joseph); the Arabic text and Pickthall's translation are shown alongside.

text.title: Text and translation
text.translation_credit: Translation: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930). Public domain.

units.ar: ٱقْتُلُوا۟ يُوسُفَ أَوِ ٱطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضًۭا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا صَلِحِينَ
units.en: (One said): Kill Joseph or cast him to some (other) land, so that your father's favour may be all for you, and (that) ye may afterward be righteous folk.

units.ar: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ يُوسُفَ وَأَلْقُوهُ فِى غَيَبَتِ ٱلْجُبِّ يَلْتَقِطْهُ بَعْضُ ٱلسَّيَّارَةِ إِن كُنتُمْ فَعِلِينَ
units.en: One among them said: Kill not Joseph but, if ye must be doing, fling him into the depth of the pit; some caravan will find him.

units.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَٓأَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأْمَ۫نَّا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَنَصِحُونَ
units.en: They said: O our father! Why wilt thou not trust us with Joseph, when lo! we are good friends to him?

units.ar: أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًۭا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَفِظُونَ
units.en: Send him with us to-morrow that he may enjoy himself and play. And lo! we shall take good care of him.

units.ar: قَالَ إِنِّى لَيَحْزُنُنِىٓ أَن تَذْهَبُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَأَخَافُ أَن يَأْكُلَهُ ٱلذِّئْبُ وَأَنتُمْ عَنْهُ غَفِلُونَ
units.en: He said: Lo! in truth it saddens me that ye should take him with you, and I fear less the wolf devour him while ye are heedless of him.

units.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَىِٕنْ أَكَلَهُ ٱلذِّئْبُ وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّخَسِرُونَ
units.en: They said: If the wolf should devour him when we are (so strong) a band, then surely we should have already perished.

units.ar: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَأَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَن يَجْعَلُوهُ فِى غَيَبَتِ ٱلْجُبِّ ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُم بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
units.en: Then, when they led him off, and were of one mind that they should place him in the depth of the pit, We inspired in him: Thou wilt tell them of this deed of theirs when they know (thee) not.

audio.title: Qur'an: Sūras 1, 112, 114 & 110
audio.label: Archives de la Parole (Pathé) 296
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica) — Archives de la Parole, Université de Paris. Public domain.
audio.description: Short chapters of the Qur'an recited in Paris in 1921 for the Archives de la Parole — the Sorbonne's sound archive, which documented the languages and recitation traditions of the time.

text.title: Text and translation
text.source: Qur'an — Sūrat al-Fātiḥa (The Opening, 1), the chapter heard on this recording; the reciter announces it by name at the start.
text.translation_credit: Translation: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930). Public domain.

units.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
units.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

units.ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
units.en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,

units.ar: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
units.en: The Beneficent, the Merciful.

units.ar: مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
units.en: Master of the Day of Judgment,

units.ar: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
units.en: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.

units.ar: ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
units.en: Show us the straight path,

units.ar: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
units.en: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.

audio.note: The label lists sūras 1, 112, 114 and 110, but this 30-second transfer contains the Fātiḥa only; the remaining sūras are not present in the surviving audio.

audio.title: Biaini
audio.label: Archives de la Parole I.188
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica) — Archives de la Parole, Université de Paris. Public domain.
audio.description: An Arabic love song on an Egyptian melody — “Ḥabībī illī jāraḥ ʿaynī” (“My beloved who wounded my eyes”) — sung by Alexis (Abdullah) Ben Kori, born in Tripoli (then Ottoman Syria), at the Sorbonne’s Archives de la Parole on 28 January 1914; the session sheet names engineer Ravenet and director Ferdinand Brunot.

audio.title: Sūrat al-Fātiḥa
audio.label: Archives de la Parole I.189
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Bibliothèque nationale de France (Gallica) — Archives de la Parole, Université de Paris. Public domain.
audio.description: Sūrat al-Fātiḥa, the opening chapter of the Qur'an, recited in Paris in 1914 for the Archives de la Parole, continuing into the opening verses of Sūrat al-Baqarah (to 2:5).

text.title: Text and translation
text.source: Qur'an — Sūrat al-Fātiḥa (The Opening, 1) and Sūrat al-Baqarah (The Cow, 2:1-5).
text.translation_credit: Translation: Marmaduke Pickthall, The Meaning of the Glorious Koran (1930). Public domain.

units.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
units.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful.

units.ar: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
units.en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds,

units.ar: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
units.en: The Beneficent, the Merciful.

units.ar: مَـٰلِكِ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
units.en: Master of the Day of Judgment,

units.ar: إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ
units.en: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help.

units.ar: ٱهْدِنَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
units.en: Show us the straight path,

units.ar: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
units.en: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray.

units.ar: الٓمٓ
units.en: Alif. Lam. Mim.

units.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ هُدًۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
units.en: This is the Book whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off (evil).

units.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَيُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
units.en: Who believe in the Unseen, and establish worship, and spend of that We have bestowed upon them;

units.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيْكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبْلِكَ وَبِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
units.en: And who believe in that which is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) and that which was revealed before thee, and are certain of the Hereafter.

units.ar: أُو۟لَـٰئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدًۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَأُو۟لَـٰئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
units.en: These depend on guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.

audio.title: Taravīḥ — Ramadan night-prayer chant
audio.label: E. Berliner's Gramophone 24023
audio.credit: Public-domain recording (1901). Transfer courtesy of Excavated Shellac (Jonathan Ward).
audio.note: Among the oldest Islamic devotional recordings known to survive — captured at Fred Gaisberg's Kazan sessions, June 1901.
audio.description: A tarawīḥ prayer chant recorded in Kazan in June 1901 during Fred Gaisberg's recording expedition for the Gramophone Company — among the oldest Islamic devotional recordings known to survive.

audio.title: Qaṣīda: Ilzam Bāb Rabbak (Pt 1)
audio.label: Baidaphon 135018
audio.credit: Historic recording courtesy of the Harvard Loeb Music Library, Arabic 78 Collection.
audio.description: Devotional qaṣīda ('Cling to the Door of Thy Lord') performed by Al-Shaykh Aḥmad al-Shaykh on the historic Baidaphon label.

audio.title: Qaṣīda: Sāḥī al-Jufūn (Pt 1)
audio.label: Gramophone Concert 012015
audio.credit: Gramophone Concert Record (Cairo, 1909). Public domain. Transfer courtesy of Excavated Shellac.
audio.description: A classical devotional vocal improvisation (qaṣīda) in Maqām Rāst by Egypt's revered master of the Khedivial golden era, Shaykh Yūsuf al-Manyalāwī (1847–1911), accompanied by takht masters Muḥammad al-ʿAqqād (qānūn), ʿAlī ʿAbduh Ṣāliḥ (nāy), and Ibrāhīm Sahlūn (kamānja).

audio.title: Qaṣīda: Jaddidī Yā Nafsu Ḥuznā (Pt 1)
audio.label: Gramophone Monarch 012061
audio.credit: Gramophone Monarch Record (Cairo, c. 1910). Public domain. Transfer courtesy of Excavated Shellac.
audio.description: Shaykh Yūsuf al-Manyalāwī in a soaring rendition of 'Jaddidī Yā Nafsu Ḥuznā' ('Renew thy grief, O soul'), captured on a 12-inch Gramophone Monarch disc shortly before his death in 1911.
